WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, avg_stats.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5') GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS avg_stats ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = avg_stats.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_courses) AS avg_courses FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses, CASE WHEN i.total_courses > a.avg_courses * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_DEPT' WHEN i.total_courses < a.avg_courses * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_DEPT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_size_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergraduate_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units, sc.undergraduate_subjects, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE sc.undergraduate_subjects > 0.6 * sc.total_subjects

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS num_historical_records, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, num_historical_records, total_assignable_area, (total_assignable_area * 1.0 / num_historical_records) AS avg_assignable_area_per_record FROM inner_cte WHERE total_assignable_area > (SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT department_name, department_full_name, COUNT(student_full_name) AS num_graduate_students, MAX(school_code_dense_rank) AS highest_school_code_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, department_full_name ORDER BY department_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_with_high_unit ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_with_high_unit.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7') SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 50 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(icte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Qualifying_Room_Count, AVG(icte.AREA) AS Avg_Room_Area, org_stats.Most_Represented_Organization, org_stats.Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT icte2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Represented_Organization, COUNT(icte2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(icte2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS icte2 GROUP BY icte2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_stats ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = org_stats.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND org_stats.rn = 1 GROUP BY icte.BUILDING_NAME, org_stats.Most_Represented_Organization, org_stats.Room_Count ORDER BY Qualifying_Room_Count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.building_type_name, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geometric_mean_area, AVG(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.building_type_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, ic.subject_rank_in_department FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT AVG(avg_total_units) IS NULL) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_stddev FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.total_departments, CASE WHEN tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < 5 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' WHEN tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 50 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_organization_number, VARIANCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS var_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL AND NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY fodk.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.avg_organization_number, ic.var_organization_number, COUNT(fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk ON ic.DLC_KEY = fodk.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL AND NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History') AND NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.avg_organization_number, ic.var_organization_number
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, ic.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TOTAL_UNITS = stats.max_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.max_lecture_units, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.LECTURE_UNITS = icte.max_lecture_units ORDER BY icte.max_lecture_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), avg_org_count AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, AVG(organization_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.organization_count, i.min_organization_number FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_org_count AS a ON i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = a.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME WHERE i.organization_count > a.avg_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, MAX(num_subjects) AS max_num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_DURATION = 'Full Term Subject' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.num_subjects) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) AS total_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(inner_cte.record_count_variance) IS NULL ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(variance_square_footage) AS highest_variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE), year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ys.units_range, ys.units_variance, ys.units_stddev, CASE WHEN ys.units_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ys.units_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM year_stats AS ys CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(units_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM year_stats) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_total_units, icte.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte AS icte WHERE icte.avg_lecture_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18')

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS max_subj ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.num_unique_subject_titles, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units_cte AS a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH building_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas AS bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area) SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area, COALESCE(SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA), 0) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TERM_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_ID), SubjectTextbook AS (SELECT DISTINCT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td), SubjectWithTextbook AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, 'Has Textbook' AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SubjectTextbook AS st ON ic.TERM_CODE = st.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = st.SUBJECT_ID), SubjectWithoutTextbook AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, 'No Textbook' AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectTextbook AS st ON ic.TERM_CODE = st.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = st.SUBJECT_ID WHERE st.TERM_CODE IS NULL), AllSubjects AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS subject_textbook_status, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subject_textbook_status, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_total_units))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM (SELECT * FROM SubjectWithTextbook UNION ALL SELECT * FROM SubjectWithoutTextbook UNION ALL SELECT * FROM AllSubjects) AS t GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subject_textbook_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL AND NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_textbook_status
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) LIKE 'H%'

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE) AS subjects_in_same_term FROM inner_cte AS i
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_lecture_units, stats.avg_lecture_units, stats.stddev_lecture_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units >= stats.avg_lecture_units + stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units <= stats.avg_lecture_units - stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, STDDEV(total_lecture_units) AS stddev_lecture_units FROM inner_cte) AS stats
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.num_unique_subjects, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units_cte AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term_code) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort) = term_code THEN NULL ELSE term_code END AS term_code, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, TERM_CODE AS term_code, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT, cd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT, cd.COURSE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_course, COUNT(ic.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_subject_codes_per_course DESC LIMIT 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, ic.range_dept_budget_code, ic.var_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, ic.range_dept_budget_code, ic.var_dept_budget_code ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, AVG(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, AVG(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020)) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '17') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, CASE WHEN inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%mit.edu%' THEN 'MIT_EMAIL' ELSE 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' END AS email_type FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units_per_year AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, deviation_from_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < 10 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_dense_rank, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fr.AREA > 50 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.AREA, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.room_dense_rank, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_course_number_ascii, var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_course_number_ascii > (SELECT AVG(avg_course_number_ascii) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subject_ranks AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ic.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, sr.SUBJECT_CODE AS top_subject_code, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sr.TOTAL_UNITS AS top_subject_total_units FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN subject_ranks AS sr ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID, MAX(avg_org_number) AS max_avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS term_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(term_lecture_units) AS highest_term_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.assignable_organization_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count > 5 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.assignable_organization_count < 3 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS dlc_size_category FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.assignable_organization_count >= 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER () AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptCounts AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCounts AS dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts AS dc) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2000) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, overall.avg_geomean, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units > overall.avg_geomean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_GEOMEAN' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units < overall.avg_geomean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_GEOMEAN' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS geomean_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geomean FROM inner_cte) AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_budget AS (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_budget AS a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.max_units > inner_cte.avg_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_YEAR' WHEN inner_cte.max_units < inner_cte.avg_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT_YEAR' END AS unit_year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC
