WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS max_minus_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY max_minus_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), avg_enrollment_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, (i.total_enrollment - a.avg_total_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment_cte AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY academic_term_parameter, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND NOT SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) OR (SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) ORDER BY academic_term_parameter, SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DepartmentStats AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_subjects, ds.avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats AS ds UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ds.total_subjects) AS total_subjects, AVG(ds.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM DepartmentStats AS ds ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER () AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_stddev, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.enrollment_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY min_warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > 9 ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(num_courses) AS highest_num_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.total_units_variance, y.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN year_stats AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ic.subject_count AS School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ranked ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.subject_count = ranked.max_subject_count WHERE (SELECT SUM(subject_count) FROM inner_cte AS ic2 WHERE ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR) > 5 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(stddev_enrolled_students) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, RoomCourseCounts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS RoomCourseCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = RoomCourseCounts.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_NUMBER = 'W85' AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'), FloorCounts AS (SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER) SELECT i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, f.BUILDING_NUMBER, f.total_floors AS window_column FROM FloorCounts AS f ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.dept_avg_total_units > s.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE, c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), dept_benchmark AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_cip_code, i.COURSE, i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, CASE WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > d.avg_cip_code * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE < d.avg_cip_code * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_benchmark AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_avg AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN math_avg AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_benchmark AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark FROM (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_benchmark AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, msd.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS year_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, sc_count.Course_Count, latest_course.Latest_COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Course_Count DESC LIMIT 10) AS sc_count JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON sc_count.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND sc_count.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME = icte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME AND sc_count.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME = icte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS Latest_COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY COURSE_LEVEL DESC, COURSE_DESCRIPTION DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COURSE_LEVEL DESC) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_course ON sc_count.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = latest_course.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND sc_count.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME = latest_course.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME AND sc_count.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME = latest_course.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc_count.Course_Count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_variance > (SELECT VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS Most_Enrolled_Course, top_course.max_enrollment AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics')) AS top_course ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND top_course.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM (SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub)) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.max_enrollment_variance, ic.max_enrollment_stddev, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.max_enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, cte.avg_total_units, cte.total_units_variance, cte.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > cte.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ccso.TOTAL_UNITS < cte.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE JOIN inner_cte AS cte ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, ic.total_enrolled_students, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrolled_subject_students FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%') AS sos ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_subjects_offered DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS sub) AS overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT <> '18') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), SubjectStats AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LENGTH(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_length FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subject_code_length) AS avg_subject_code_length, MAX(subject_code_length) - MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY = scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL) AS subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students FROM student_counts AS sc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT department_name, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING num_course_materials > 0) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_course_materials, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_course_materials ORDER BY icte.num_course_materials DESC, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.BUILDING_NUMBER, ic.row_num_window FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM inner_cte WHERE BUILDING_NUMBER LIKE '%2' GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) AS orgs ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orgs.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE ic.BUILDING_NUMBER LIKE '%2'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, subj_count.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.max_enrollment, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, imf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Most_Frequent_Instructor, imf.Terms_Taught FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(max_enrollment) AS max_enrollment, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID) AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Terms_Taught, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS imf ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = imf.SUBJECT_ID AND imf.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING num_course_materials > 0) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(num_course_materials) AS highest_num_course_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.SCHOOL_NAME = i.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = c.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_courses ORDER BY i.num_courses DESC LIMIT 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.cip_code_variance ORDER BY ic.cip_code_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.AREA, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%')) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR, COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, SUM(AREA) AS total_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.avg_total_units = (SELECT MAX(avg_total_units) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, spt.TERM_CODE, spt.num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms)), ranked_terms AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_subjects, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_subjects DESC, icte.TERM_CODE) AS term_rank FROM inner_cte AS icte), agg_stats AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(icte.num_subjects) - MIN(icte.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(icte.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(icte.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.range_num_subjects, a.variance_num_subjects, a.stddev_num_subjects, r.TERM_CODE AS term_with_most_subjects, r.num_subjects AS num_subjects_in_term FROM agg_stats AS a JOIN ranked_terms AS r ON a.DEPARTMENT_CODE = r.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND r.term_rank = 1 ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT d.SCHOOL_CODE IN (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7') GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY school_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT d_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d_stats.avg_total_units, d_stats.stddev_total_units, s_stats.Most_Prominent_School, s_stats.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS d_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, Subject_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_dept = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_dept := DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) AS s CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') AS vars ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Subject_Count DESC) AS s_stats ON d_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s_stats.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY d_stats.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_crosslisted_courses FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ccc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.total_units ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, BUILDING_NUMBER, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' UNION ALL SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, BUILDING_NUMBER, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'), group_avgs AS (SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.CAMPUS_SECTOR, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN group_avgs AS g ON i.BUILDING_TYPE = g.BUILDING_TYPE AND i.CAMPUS_SECTOR = g.CAMPUS_SECTOR WHERE i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > g.avg_assignable_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'), RollupResults AS (SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) AS total_max_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_num_of_rooms_3rows) > 0) SELECT rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, rr.total_max_num_of_rooms FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.BUILDING_TYPE, rr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE AND ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, sso.Most_Offered_School, sso.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Offered_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS sso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subjects FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS t GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS maxs ON sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = maxs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sso.Subject_Count = maxs.Max_Subjects ORDER BY ic.avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) AS o ORDER BY i.stddev_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
