WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.assignable_organization_count, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AS department_code FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY AND fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.DLC_KEY, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS num_historical_records, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.num_historical_records, ic.total_assignable_area, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD AS max_assignable_area_period, fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA = (SELECT MAX(fbh2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh2 WHERE fbh2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) WHERE ic.total_assignable_area = (SELECT MAX(total_assignable_area) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_total_units, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, msd.OFFICE_LOCATION, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(student_count) AS max_students_in_office, MIN(min_office_phone) AS min_office_phone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), eng_budget_avg AS (SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, CASE WHEN c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > e.avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < e.avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN eng_budget_avg AS e
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL >= 4 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, org_counts.total_orgs FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DLC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.DLC_NAME = org_counts.DLC_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DLC_NAME, org_counts.total_orgs ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_students_variance) AS highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects_above_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s2 WHERE s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology'))
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept.Graduate_Student_Count, subj.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Common_Subject_Code, subj.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(t2.FULL_NAME) AS Graduate_Student_Count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Graduate_Student_Count DESC LIMIT 10) AS dept LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS subj ON dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subj.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept.Graduate_Student_Count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7')) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > 12 THEN 'ABOVE_12' ELSE 'BELOW_12' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_2, STDDEV_SAMP(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) / AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON mdh.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME HAVING AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) > 0) SELECT department_hierarchy_level_2, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1), DepartmentStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolRollup AS (SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS range_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, range_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, total_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, range_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, total_enrolled_students FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_var_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var_cte AS a ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH schools_with_ps AS (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), subject_units AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN (SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_subjects ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ORDER BY ic.total_enrolled DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) AS dept_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, MIN(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA, MAX(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS MAX_NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, EXT_GROSS_AREA ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN CIP AS t2 ON inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE = t2.PROGRAM_TITLE WHERE t2.CATEGORY_CODE = 11
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, dmax.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dmax.avg_total_units AS Top_Department_Avg_Units FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10) AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dmax ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmax.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmax.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0) SELECT ic.CITY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, ic.stddev_assignable_area / ic.avg_assignable_area AS coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_assignable_area FROM (SELECT CITY, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, avg_assignable_area, stddev_assignable_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CITY ORDER BY avg_assignable_area DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ic.rn = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students - inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students) AS avg_minus_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled_students) AS highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT department, max_organization_number, space_unit_name FROM inner_cte WHERE max_organization_number > 50000 ORDER BY department
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_units, cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(cso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, MAX(CASE WHEN LECTURE_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) FROM inner_cte AS ic2 WHERE ic2.ACTIVITY_TITLE = inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE ELSE NULL END) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.AREA, AVG(i.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY i.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_area_window FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_floor_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE) AS favg ON i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE = favg.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE WHERE i.AREA > favg.avg_floor_area ORDER BY i.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, i.AREA
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.course_description_count, ic.min_cip_program_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage, MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) - MIN(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_range, VARIANCE(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building_type_name) OVER (ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort) = building_type_name THEN NULL ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_name, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, num_of_rooms_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector_sort, building_type_name, VARIANCE(num_of_rooms_variance) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(num_of_rooms_stddev) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY building_type_name, campus_sector WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH total_assignable AS (SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable AS ta CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_assignable_area, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_clearing_cost_collector, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, gt.Most_Common_Grade_Type, gt.Grade_Type_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE AS Most_Common_Grade_Type, COUNT(*) AS Grade_Type_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND at2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at2.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso2.GRADE_TYPE) AS sub)) AS gt ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.TERM_CODE = gt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, num_zoe_grad_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_zoe_grad_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN inner_cte ON msd.DEPARTMENT = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT AND msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_subjects FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ict.SCHOOL_NAME, ict.avg_total_units, ict.var_total_units, ict.stddev_total_units, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10) AS ict LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ict.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ict.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.COURSE = scd.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID IS NULL AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(organization_name) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort) = organization_name THEN NULL ELSE organization_name END AS organization_name, hr_department_name, avg_department_id, department_id_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE organization_name END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE hr_department_name END AS hr_department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(organization_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(hr_department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE hr_department_name END AS dept_sort, organization_name, AVG(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS avg_department_id, VARIANCE(HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS department_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY organization_name, hr_department_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY org_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fwr.FLOOR, fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), floor_stats AS (SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(*) AS num_floors, MAX(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG), max_floor AS (SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR AS max_assignable_area_floor, ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS m ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA = m.max_area) SELECT fs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fs.num_floors, fs.assignable_area_range, fs.assignable_area_variance, mf.max_assignable_area_floor, mf.max_assignable_area FROM floor_stats AS fs LEFT JOIN max_floor AS mf ON fs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = mf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fs.num_floors DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, STDDEV(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_stddev, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dmc.Course_Count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_cip_code, cip_code_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 10) AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dmc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dmc.SCHOOL_NAME AND dmc.Course_Count = (SELECT MAX(sub.Course_Count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c2 ON s2.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.COURSE WHERE c2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub) ORDER BY ic.avg_cip_code DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fdlk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT fo.MAJOR_ORG IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY, fo.MAJOR_ORG) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dlc_key) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, dlc_key, major_org_sort) = dlc_key THEN NULL ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, major_org, org_count_range, org_count_variance, org_count_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE dlc_key END AS dlc_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dlc_key) = 0 AND GROUPING(major_org) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE major_org END AS major_org_sort, major_org, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dlc_key, major_org WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dlc_key_sort, major_org_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.avg_org_number, i.org_number_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_org_number > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' WHEN i.avg_org_number < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG_ORG_NUMBER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_org_number_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_org_number) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte) AS o ORDER BY i.org_number_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Department_With_Highest_Subject_Code_Variance, stats.subject_code_variance, stats.subject_code_stddev FROM (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance, STDDEV(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(subject_code_variance) AS max_variance FROM (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SIGNED)) AS subject_code_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS maxvar ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = maxvar.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.subject_code_variance = maxvar.max_variance ORDER BY stats.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), avg_cip AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cip AS a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(icte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_course_number_ascii) AS highest_avg_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 50 THEN 'LARGE_BUILDING' ELSE 'SMALL_BUILDING' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) > (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME)) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ata.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS ata ON ic.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_per_subject FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, AVG(icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft, VARIANCE(icte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS sqft_variance, max_room.Largest_Room_Name, max_room.Largest_Room_Square_Footage FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS Largest_Room_Name, ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS Largest_Room_Square_Footage FROM (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS max_room ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = max_room.SPACE_USAGE GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, max_room.Largest_Room_Name, max_room.Largest_Room_Square_Footage ORDER BY sqft_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_departments, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0) SELECT BUILDING_NAME_LONG, POSTAL_CODE, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.cip_code_range, inner_cte.cip_code_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE
