WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), floor_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ffl ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ffl.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM floor_room_areas) SELECT fra.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fra.FLOOR, fra.total_room_area, (fra.total_room_area - stats.mean_area) AS deviation_from_avg FROM floor_room_areas AS fra CROSS JOIN stats WHERE fra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18') SELECT c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.TERM_CODE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lr ON so.TERM_CODE = lr.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND NOT lr.SUBJECT_ID IS NULL AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, MAX(inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_distinct_catalog_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE) SELECT ic.BUILDING_USE, ic.area_variance, bh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_with_largest_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS bh ON ic.BUILDING_USE = bh.BUILDING_USE AND bh.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS lib ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON c.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM CIP AS c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE) SELECT CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(num_courses) - MIN(num_courses) AS course_count_range, VARIANCE(num_courses) AS course_count_variance, AVG(num_courses) AS avg_courses_per_four_digit_program FROM inner_cte GROUP BY CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY course_count_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT icte.FULL_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.window_column, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = icte.STUDENT_YEAR AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = icte.COURSE_LEVEL) AS num_students_same_level FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.FULL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT') SELECT ic.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.BUILDING_TYPE = fb.BUILDING_TYPE WHERE fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY num_rooms_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, CASE WHEN ic.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5') AS oa
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled_students, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = (SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, h.NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev, AVG(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_non_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL AND (NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrolled AS Department_Total_Enrolled, subj_enroll.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, subj_enroll.subject_enrolled AS Top_Subject_Enrolled FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_enroll LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, total_enrolled AS subject_enrolled FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS subj_enroll ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrolled DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance, SUM(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING ON inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE = FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'), avg_rooms_cte AS (SELECT AVG(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC') SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, i.CITY, i.STATE, i.POSTAL_CODE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_USE, i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows, (i.max_num_of_rooms_3rows - a.avg_num_of_rooms) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_rooms_cte AS a ORDER BY i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.FISCAL_PERIOD
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)), RollupResults AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_units) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark AS v
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS unique_hr_department_names FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_avg AS d CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.var_total_units, y.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN year_stats AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, MIN(scd.DEPARTMENT) AS min_department_number, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ((scd.DEPARTMENT BETWEEN 5 AND 22) OR (scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE >= 110102)) AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE IN ('E', 'Z') AND NOT scd.DEPARTMENT IN (5, 7) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT, inner_cte.min_department_number, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code > 120000 * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code < 120000 * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.department, ic.academic_year, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.academic_year ORDER BY ic.department, ic.academic_year
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > 20 ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT MAX(organization_count) AS highest_organization_count, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATERIALS FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 WHERE scd2.SCHOOL_NAME = inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G') AS num_courses_in_same_school FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS overall ON inner_cte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_subject_titles, ic.min_total_units, stc.max_subject_title, stc.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_subject_title, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)) AS stc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = stc.SUBJECT_CODE AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.num_unique_subject_titles DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE'), stats_cte AS (SELECT BUILDING_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(AREA) AS area_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME), major_use_counts AS (SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS use_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, MAJOR_USE_DESC), ranked_major_use AS (SELECT m.BUILDING_NAME, m.MAJOR_USE_DESC, m.use_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY m.use_count DESC) AS rn FROM major_use_counts AS m) SELECT s.BUILDING_NAME, s.avg_area, s.area_variance, s.area_stddev, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS most_common_major_use, r.use_count AS major_use_room_count FROM stats_cte AS s LEFT JOIN ranked_major_use AS r ON s.BUILDING_NAME = r.BUILDING_NAME AND r.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.area_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coeff_var FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32) SELECT inner_cte.ROOM_NUMBER, inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, (inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE - avg_stats.avg_sqft) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, ic2.COURSE AS course_with_max_units, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Course_Enrollment FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC LIMIT 5) AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS i2 ON i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled) AS c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrolled DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024), dept_avg AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_graduate_students) AS total_graduate_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_graduate_students) > 0) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_graduate_students FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS dept_code, i.area_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_cip_code, ic.total_degree_courses, sc.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, sc.Course_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS Course_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME) AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2008%' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), SubjectStats AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(ic.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(cip_code_range) AS total_cip_code_range, SUM(cip_code_variance) AS total_cip_code_variance FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(cip_code_range) IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, total_cip_code_range, total_cip_code_variance FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AS highest_units_subject_code, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) AS ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc2 WHERE ccc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccc2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS ic1) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.academic_year ORDER BY inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_total_units >= 9 ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) > (SELECT SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.department_name = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY) AS sd ON inner_cte.department_name = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.department_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, t.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9) SELECT inner_cte.administrative_department, inner_cte.academic_department, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.subject_title_with_max_units, subj_count.num_subjects_2024 FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.min_academic_year, i.avg_total_units, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_NUMBER = 'W85' AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT') SELECT i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, i.window_column, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS total_building_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building_name) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort) = building_name THEN NULL ELSE building_name END AS building_name, num_floors, total_assignable_area, ext_gross_area FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME END AS building_name, COUNT(num_floors) AS num_floors, SUM(total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area, MAX(ext_gross_area) AS ext_gross_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY building_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS highest_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_cip_code_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.COST_CENTER_CODE = fbh.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 100000 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT') SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY max_assignable_area DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE) AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.enrolled_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE), building_totals AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_NAME), max_building AS (SELECT bt.BUILDING_TYPE, bt.BUILDING_NAME FROM (SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, MAX(total_area) AS max_area FROM building_totals GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE) AS bmax JOIN building_totals AS bt ON bt.BUILDING_TYPE = bmax.BUILDING_TYPE AND bt.total_area = bmax.max_area) SELECT ic.building_type_name, ic.geometric_mean_area, mb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_with_largest_total_room_area FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN max_building AS mb ON ic.building_type_name = mb.BUILDING_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, MAX(MIT_ID) AS highest_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, term_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, term, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, term_sort
