WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), Top10DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, d.total_units_variance FROM Top10DeptSubjectCount AS t JOIN DeptUnitsVariance AS d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), PoliticalScienceGradCourses AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.range_total_units, d.var_total_units, psc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, psc.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, psc.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, psc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, psc.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, psc.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, psc.COURSE_LEVEL, psc.course_level_dense_rank FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS d JOIN PoliticalScienceGradCourses AS psc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = psc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, psc.course_level_dense_rank
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH StdDevTotalUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), CoeffOfVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdt.total_units_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM StdDevTotalUnits AS sdt LEFT JOIN CoeffOfVariation AS cov ON sdt.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdt.total_units_stddev DESC
WITH DepartmentStddevUnits AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ChemistryTipDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') SELECT dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsu.stddev_total_units, ctd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ctd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ctd.TERM_CODE, ctd.SUBJECT_ID, ctd.SUBJECT_TITLE, ctd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ctd.max_total_units FROM DepartmentStddevUnits AS dsu JOIN ChemistryTipDetails AS ctd ON dsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ctd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ctd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
WITH ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance FROM ChemistrySubjects AS cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance AS duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC
WITH TermStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE), FallStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev, fs.avg_total_units, fs.stddev_total_units FROM TermStats AS ts JOIN FallStats AS fs ON ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = fs.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE
WITH TermStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE), YearStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.total_units_range AS term_total_units_range, ts.total_units_variance AS term_total_units_variance, ts.total_units_stddev AS term_total_units_stddev, ys.total_units_range AS year_total_units_range, ys.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance FROM YearStats AS ys JOIN TermStats AS ts ON ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE
WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), DepartmentCoefficientVariation AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), DepartmentTotalUnits AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dtu.total_units FROM DepartmentCoefficientVariation AS dcv JOIN DepartmentTotalUnits AS dtu ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH math_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_max_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_subjects_max_units AS (SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units AS dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, d.max_total_units, d.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM math_subjects AS m JOIN dept_subjects_max_units AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH OrgGeometricMean AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), AcademicBuildingStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgGeometricMean AS ogm JOIN AcademicBuildingStats AS abs ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = abs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, abs.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH TopMathAdminDepts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10), MathDeptCourseStats AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT tmad.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tmad.admin_dept_count, mdcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mdcs.avg_total_units, mdcs.total_units_variance, mdcs.total_units_stddev FROM TopMathAdminDepts AS tmad JOIN MathDeptCourseStats AS mdcs ON tmad.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tmad.admin_dept_count DESC, mdcs.total_units_variance DESC
WITH units_stats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_stats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, u.units_range, u.units_variance, e.enrolled_students_variance FROM units_stats AS u JOIN enrollment_stats AS e ON u.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY u.units_range DESC
WITH ChemSubjects AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials, tso.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10), DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.num_course_materials, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM ChemSubjects AS cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH OrgGeometricMean AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), AcademicBuildingStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation, ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean FROM AcademicBuildingStats AS abs JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS org ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN OrgGeometricMean AS ogm ON org.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ogm.geometric_mean DESC

WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), math_subjects_2024 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.window_column FROM dept_enrollment_stats AS des JOIN math_subjects_2024 AS ms ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subject_info AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_student_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT si.SUBJECT_ID, si.SUBJECT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_NUMBER, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, si.SUBJECT_TITLE, si.LECTURE_UNITS, si.LAB_UNITS, si.TOTAL_UNITS, si.GRADE_TYPE, si.GRADE_RULE, si.min_total_units_by_dept, ds.student_count, ds.unique_student_years FROM subject_info AS si LEFT JOIN dept_student_stats AS ds ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.DEPARTMENT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_ID
WITH MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SchoolCourseCounts AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept, scc.total_courses FROM MathSubjects AS ms LEFT JOIN SchoolCourseCounts AS scc ON ms.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathDeptStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus UNION ALL SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code, 'MathStats' AS Reason FROM MathDeptStats AS mds) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_dept_budget_code, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason
WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), ChemistryCourseMaterials AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.num_reserved_materials, c.min_academic_year FROM DeptEnrolledStats AS d JOIN ChemistryCourseMaterials AS c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY c.num_reserved_materials DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.total_units_range AS regular_term_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance AS regular_term_units_variance, subq2.total_units_range AS post_2010_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance AS post_2010_units_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH IAPMaxEnrollStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), MathSubjectUnits AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE), CombinedMathStats AS (SELECT ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS max_total_units_3rows, ims.avg_max_enrollment, ims.stddev_max_enrollment, 'IAPMaxEnrollStats' AS Source FROM IAPMaxEnrollStats AS ims UNION ALL SELECT msu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msu.SUBJECT_CODE, msu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msu.SUBJECT_TITLE, msu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msu.TERM_CODE, msu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msu.max_total_units_3rows, NULL AS avg_max_enrollment, NULL AS stddev_max_enrollment, 'MathSubjectUnits' AS Source FROM MathSubjectUnits AS msu) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, max_total_units_3rows, avg_max_enrollment, stddev_max_enrollment, Source FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Source, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, TERM_CODE
