WITH DeptUnits2022FA AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.avg_total_units, d2022.total_units_range, d2022.total_units_variance, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2022FA Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnits2022FA AS d2022 UNION ALL SELECT d2021.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, d2021.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d2021.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2021FA Max' AS Reason FROM DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS d2021) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), TopDeptSubjects AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units, t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.subject_count FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d JOIN TopDeptSubjects AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), math_subjects_2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_subjects_2022 AS ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH math_2024_12unit_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.window_column, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM math_2024_12unit_subjects AS m LEFT JOIN dept_units_stats AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), EECS_Subjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.window_column FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN EECS_Subjects AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column
WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_dept_subjects AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.range_num_subjects, dss.variance_num_subjects, dss.stddev_num_subjects, tds.subject_count FROM dept_subject_stats AS dss JOIN top_dept_subjects AS tds ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectGeometricMean AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT pssgm.SUBJECT_CODE, pssgm.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pssgm.geometric_mean_students, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectGeometricMean AS pssgm JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON pssgm.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pssgm.geometric_mean_students DESC, des.avg_enrolled_students DESC
WITH YearlyMathStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CurrentYearMathStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), CombinedMathStats AS (SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_total_units, y.range_total_units, y.var_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'Yearly' AS Reason FROM YearlyMathStats AS y UNION ALL SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, c.total_units_variance, c.total_units_stddev, 'CurrentTerm' AS Reason FROM CurrentYearMathStats AS c) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason
WITH dept_admin_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), math_subjects_2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM dept_admin_stats AS das JOIN math_subjects_2022 AS ms ON das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptMaxUnits AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_enrolled, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, 'Enrolled' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolled AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_enrolled, d2.max_total_units, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, 'MaxUnits' AS Reason FROM DeptMaxUnits AS d2) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), AcademicTermStats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cs.max_enrolled_students, ats.academic_term_parameter, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.avg_total_units, ats.var_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjects AS cs JOIN AcademicTermStats AS ats ON cs.TERM_CODE = ats.academic_term_parameter
WITH department_units_cv AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_total_enrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20) SELECT duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.coefficient_of_variation, dte.total_enrolled_students FROM department_units_cv AS duc JOIN department_total_enrolled AS dte ON duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH TopDepartments AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3), DepartmentGeometricMean AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.num_courses, dgm.geometric_mean_cip FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean AS dgm ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgm.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.num_courses DESC, dgm.geometric_mean_cip DESC
WITH dept_units_cv AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), political_science_students AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT pss.FULL_NAME, pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank, ducv.coefficient_of_variation FROM political_science_students AS pss LEFT JOIN dept_units_cv AS ducv ON pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ducv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pss.FULL_NAME
WITH DeptUnitsCV AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM DeptUnitsCV AS dcv JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS des ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH DeptMinAvg AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptMaxEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dminavg.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dminavg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dminavg.min_num_enrolled_students, dminavg.avg_total_units, dmaxenr.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dmaxenr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptMinAvg AS dminavg JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled AS dmaxenr ON dminavg.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmaxenr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dminavg.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CASE WHEN AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) = 0 OR AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) END AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s2.coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH StddevTotalUnits AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10), CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.stddev_total_units, c.coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM StddevTotalUnits AS s JOIN CoefficientOfVariation AS c ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH DeptStddevStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.stddev_total_units, mds.avg_total_units, mds.total_units_variance, mds.total_units_stddev FROM DeptStddevStats AS dss LEFT JOIN MathDeptUnitStats AS mds ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH MathDeptStddev AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptStddev2022 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_2022_stddev_total_units FROM MathDeptStddev AS mds JOIN DeptStddev2022 AS dsd ON mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.avg_total_units, ays.var_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.min_academic_year, ts.avg_total_units AS term_avg_total_units FROM AcademicYearStats AS ays JOIN TermStats AS ts ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ts.min_academic_year ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.TERM_CODE
WITH DepartmentUnitsCV AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.coefficient_of_variation, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, ms.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, ms.AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM DepartmentUnitsCV AS duc JOIN MathSubjects AS ms ON duc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC), MathDeptUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_stddev, m.total_units FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d JOIN MathDeptUnits AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrollment_stddev DESC
WITH DeptStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), PoliSciSubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_CODE, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.window_column FROM DeptStats AS d JOIN PoliSciSubjects AS p ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = p.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), PoliSciStudents AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM PoliSciStudents AS ps LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.FULL_NAME
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), LibraryReserveStats AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, lrs.min_academic_year, lrs.sum_total_units FROM AcademicYearStats AS ays CROSS JOIN LibraryReserveStats AS lrs WHERE ays.total_units_variance > 0 AND lrs.sum_total_units > 0 ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.TOTAL_UNITS, mc.GRADE_TYPE, mc.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, duv.total_units_variance FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN DeptUnitsVariance AS duv ON mc.DEPARTMENT = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, dstat.avg_students_per_year, dstat.range_students_per_year, dstat.var_students_per_year FROM DeptSubjects2021 AS ds21 JOIN dept_stats AS dstat ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dstat.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH dept_enroll_stddev AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC), math_subject_codes AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_stddev, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM dept_enroll_stddev AS des JOIN math_subject_codes AS msc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY msc.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptEnrollment AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, mde.total_enrolled FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus LEFT JOIN MathDeptEnrollment AS mde ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), CourseEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC) SELECT ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.enrolled_students_variance, ses.enrolled_students_stddev, ces.avg_enrollment, ces.enrollment_range, ces.enrollment_variance FROM SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses JOIN CourseEnrollmentStats AS ces ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ces.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ses.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ces.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ses.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH GeometricMean AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME), AvgVariance AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC) SELECT gm.SCHOOL_NAME, gm.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, av.avg_budget, av.budget_variance FROM GeometricMean AS gm JOIN AvgVariance AS av ON gm.SCHOOL_NAME = av.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH EnrolledStddev AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC), RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_stddev, r.avg_area, r.area_variance, r.area_stddev FROM EnrolledStddev AS e JOIN RoomAreaStats AS r ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d JOIN MathSubjects2022 AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH SchoolDeptBudgetStats AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_variance, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), PoliticalScienceGradCourses AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT psgc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, psgc.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, psgc.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, psgc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, psgc.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, psgc.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, psgc.COURSE_LEVEL, psgc.course_level_dense_rank, sdbs.dept_budget_code_variance, sdbs.dept_budget_code_stddev FROM PoliticalScienceGradCourses AS psgc LEFT JOIN SchoolDeptBudgetStats AS sdbs ON psgc.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME = sdbs.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY psgc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), dept_stats AS (SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_max_enroll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_max_subject AS (SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll AS dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.range_num_subjects, ds.variance_num_subjects, ds.stddev_num_subjects, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN dept_max_subject AS dms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.units_range, s1.units_variance, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.total_units_variance AS math_total_units_variance, s2.num_subjects_offered AS math_num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE), Top10Depts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptAgg AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.course_count, m.min_total_units FROM Top10Depts AS t LEFT JOIN MathDeptAgg AS m ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NULL), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18') SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN inner_cte2 AS c ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), subq2 AS (SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_stddev, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_stddev, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_units_stddev DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq2.total_units_stddev, subq2.num_math_subjects FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT total_units_range IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.total_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance, subq2.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subq2.total_subjects FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), school_geomean AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sg.geometric_mean FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN school_geomean AS sg ON dus.SCHOOL_NAME = sg.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolMaxAvgEnrolled AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled_students) AS highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), HGNAvg AS (SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE) SELECT sm.SCHOOL_NAME, sm.highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM SchoolMaxAvgEnrolled AS sm JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sm.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 AS i ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN HGNAvg AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY sm.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH iap_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, iap_stats.avg_max_enrollment, iap_stats.stddev_max_enrollment, enrollment_stats.enrolled_students_variance, enrollment_stats.enrolled_students_stddev, enrollment_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM iap_stats JOIN enrollment_stats ON iap_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = enrollment_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH engineering_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, min_enrolled, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte), degree_granting_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, variance_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE variance_total_units > (SELECT AVG(variance_total_units) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ee.min_enrolled, ee.total_enrolled, dgv.variance_total_units, dgv.stddev_total_units FROM engineering_enrollment AS ee JOIN degree_granting_variance AS dgv ON ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dgv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_count) AS max_admin_dept_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > 12 THEN 'ABOVE_12' ELSE 'BELOW_12' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_admin_dept_count, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.course_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.unit_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS t), math_units_cv AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT es.SCHOOL_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, mucv.coefficient_of_variation, mucv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM enrollment_stats AS es LEFT JOIN math_units_cv AS mucv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mucv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.SCHOOL_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, s1.num_distinct_courses, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME), math_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_clearing_cost AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_clearing_cost_collector) AS highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.SUBJECT_CODE, mc.subject_course_count, scc.highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM math_courses AS mc JOIN school_clearing_cost AS scc ON mc.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY mc.subject_course_count DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.geometric_mean_students, s1.total_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

LENGTH(REPLACE(ccso.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')) END) AS avg_num_equivalent_subjects FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.stddev_num_enrolled_students) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.max_total_units, mus.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mus.SUBJECT_TITLE, ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ls.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.avg_num_equivalent_subjects FROM MaxUnitsSubjects AS mus JOIN LibraryStats AS ls ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY END AS SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, CASE WHEN GROUPING(COURSE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COURSE END AS COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units) SELECT s1.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, s1.COURSE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.total_units, s2.total_units AS department_total_units, s2.num_courses_latest_year FROM subq1 WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats), subq2 AS SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) AS max_sub ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND
