subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_enrolled_students, subq1.benchmark, subq1.department_size_category, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.subject_with_max_enrollment, subq2.subject_title_with_max_enrollment, subq2.max_enrollment FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), CourseTotals AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SCHOOL_NAME, ic1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic2.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic2.running_sum_dept_budget_code > 200000 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM CourseTotals AS ct ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS SUBJECT_TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.avg_total_units DESC
WITH course_stats AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), filtered_courses AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_units FROM course_stats WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM course_stats)), dept_unit_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT fc.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, fc.COURSE, fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fc.subject_count, fc.total_units, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM filtered_courses AS fc JOIN dept_unit_stats AS dus ON fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fc.total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte1 AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME), cte1_with_school AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), cte2_with_school AS (SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte2 AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte2) AS s) SELECT cte1_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1_with_school.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_with_school.cip_code_variance, cte2_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cte1_with_school.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1_with_school.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) GROUP BY WITH student_info AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict'), top_departments AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3), top_departments_undergrad_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM top_departments AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.window_column, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_admin_department_name, tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tduc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name, tduc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_admin_department_name, tduc.num_undergrad_courses FROM student_info AS si JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT JOIN top_departments_undergrad_courses AS tduc ON tduc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = si.DEPARTMENT
WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats), SchoolDeptCounts AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolDeptStats AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts AS sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptGeomMeanStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units, avg_stats.avg_geom_mean, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units > avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_DEPT' WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units < avg_stats.avg_geom_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_DEPT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte2) AS avg_stats) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.num_degree_granting_departments, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.avg_students_per_year, dgs.geometric_mean_total_units, dgs.avg_geom_mean, dgs.unit_category FROM SchoolDeptStats AS sds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptGeomMeanStats AS dgs ON sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS avg_geom_mean, NULL AS unit_category FROM SchoolDeptCounts AS sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), cte1 AS (SELECT i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT c1.LAST_NAME, c1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, c1.STUDENT_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.window_column, c1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c2.total_enrolled_students FROM cte1 AS c1 JOIN inner_cte2 AS c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.department, inner_cte1.academic_year, inner_cte1.subject_count, inner_cte1.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte1.academic_year), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, s2.earliest_term_start_date, s2.latest_term_start_date FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year
WITH PeterMathStudents AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), PeterMathStudentsFull AS (SELECT i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM PeterMathStudents AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptUnitsStddev AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), MathDeptUnitsStddevFull AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_stddev, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MathDeptUnitsStddev AS i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT p.LAST_NAME, p.EMAIL_ADDRESS, p.STUDENT_YEAR, p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.window_column, p.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, p.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, m.units_stddev, m.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME FROM PeterMathStudentsFull AS p JOIN MathDeptUnitsStddevFull AS m ON p.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY p.LAST_NAME, p.EMAIL_ADDRESS
WITH clearing_cost_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top5_eng_dept_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, smax.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, smax.max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5) AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') AND (sos.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) IN (SELECT MAX(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS), scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos2.TERM_CODE = '2016FA' AND sos2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS smax ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = smax.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC) SELECT t5e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t5e.avg_total_units, t5e.stddev_total_units, t5e.subject_with_max_units, t5e.max_total_units, ccs.clearing_cost_collector_range, ccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ccs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ccs.num_admin_departments FROM top5_eng_dept_units AS t5e LEFT JOIN clearing_cost_stats AS ccs ON t5e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t5e.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME), top5_depts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_avg_units ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5), dept_stats AS (SELECT ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte1 JOIN top5_depts AS t5 ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ic GROUP BY ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), max_subjects AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS FROM (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 JOIN top5_depts AS t5 ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte2.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, ms.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.stddev_enrolled_students, des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN max_subjects AS ms ON ds.DEPT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units), AcademicYearEnrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, total_enrollment AS highest_total_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, total_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1), CombinedAcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, ays.earliest_term_start_date, ays.latest_term_start_date, aye.TERM_CODE, aye.TERM_DESCRIPTION, aye.highest_total_enrollment FROM AcademicYearStats AS ays LEFT JOIN AcademicYearEnrollment AS aye ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aye.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT aye.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units, NULL AS earliest_term_start_date, NULL AS latest_term_start_date, aye.TERM_CODE, aye.TERM_DESCRIPTION, aye.highest_total_enrollment FROM AcademicYearEnrollment AS aye LEFT JOIN AcademicYearStats AS ays ON aye.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, coefficient_of_variation_total_units, earliest_term_start_date, latest_term_start_date, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, highest_total_enrollment FROM CombinedAcademicYearStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.stddev_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS stddev_total_units, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, s1.avg_enrolled, s1.enrolled_variance, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, NULL AS avg_enrolled, NULL AS enrolled_variance, 'UnitsAndLibraryStats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_YEAR, stddev_total_units, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_math_subjects_in_library_reserve, avg_enrolled, enrolled_variance, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, Source

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), AcademicYearDeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance, year_sort, dept_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - WITH inner_cte_courses AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING), math_courses_summary AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte_courses GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING), inner_cte_dept AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_budget AS (SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), math_dept_budget_summary AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.department_count, i.min_budget_code FROM inner_cte_dept AS i, avg_budget AS a WHERE i.min_budget_code > a.avg_budget_code) SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, mcs.total_courses, mdbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdbs.department_count, mdbs.min_budget_code FROM math_courses_summary AS mcs LEFT JOIN math_dept_budget_summary AS mdbs ON mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev, subq1.subject_with_max_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, subq2.BUILDING_ROOM, subq2.AREA, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS ROOM_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_units_range DESC, subq2.window_column
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_units_stats AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dc.num_distinct_courses FROM math_units_stats AS mus JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_courses AS dc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mus.total_units_variance DESC, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dc.GRADUATE_LEVEL
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), Subquery1 AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_stddev, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, CASE WHEN ic.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5') AS oa) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.units_stddev, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.range_total_units, s2.var_total_units, s2.unit_category FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.units_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - m.subject_count_in_dept FROM math_subjects_2024 AS m LEFT JOIN dept_highest_avg_enrollment AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.term_description, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.AREA, (ic.AREA - avg_floor_area.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR) AS avg_floor_area ON ic.FLOOR = avg_floor_area.FLOOR) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.BUILDING_NUMBER, s1.POSTAL_CODE, s1.row_num_window, s2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.AREA AS s2_AREA, s2.area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NUMBER = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.AREA
WITH dept_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_info AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ee_courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), eng_budget_avg AS (SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT di.DEPARTMENT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, di.SCHOOL_NAME, di.avg_clearing_cost_collector, di.clearing_cost_collector_variance, di.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, CASE WHEN ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > eba.avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < eba.avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM dept_info AS di LEFT JOIN ee_courses AS ec ON di.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN eng_budget_avg AS eba ORDER BY di.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR (DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL))) AS t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), eng_budget_avg AS (SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, CASE WHEN c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > e.avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN c.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < e.avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN eng_budget_avg AS e) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.range_total_units, s1.var_total_units, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s2.budget_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_academic_year, s1.sum_total_units, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), Total_Chemistry AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), filtered_depts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, variance_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 WHERE variance_total_units > (SELECT AVG(variance_total_units) FROM inner_cte2)) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic1.window_column, tc.Total_Chemistry_Subjects, fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fd.variance_total_units, fd.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN Total_Chemistry AS tc ON 1 = 1 JOIN filtered_depts AS fd ON ic1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = fd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH IAP_MaxEnroll_Stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DegreeDept_SubjectCode_Stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC) SELECT ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ims.avg_max_enrollment, ims.stddev_max_enrollment, dds.subject_code_count_variance, dds.subject_code_count_stddev, dds.avg_subject_code_count FROM IAP_MaxEnroll_Stats AS ims JOIN DegreeDept_SubjectCode_Stats AS dds ON ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH math_admin_dept_rank AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), top_departments_2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, ROUND(t.subject_count / NULLIF(m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, 0), 2) AS normalized_subjects_per_admin_dept_rank FROM top_departments_2022 AS t LEFT JOIN math_admin_dept_rank AS m ON t.SCHOOL_NAME = m.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH OrgGeoMean AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, ogm.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, bs.BUILDING_NAME, bs.area_range, bs.area_variance, bs.area_stddev, bs.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, bs.DATE_BUILT FROM OrgGeoMean AS ogm JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingStats AS bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, bs.area_range DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.subject_code_count, sq1.min_dept_budget_code, sq1.unique_course_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject, 'DepartmentSubjectStats' AS Source FROM subq1 AS sq1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS subject_code_count, NULL AS min_dept_budget_code, NULL AS unique_course_count, sq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sq2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject, 'DeptEnrolledRangeStats' AS Source FROM subq2 AS sq2) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, subject_code_count, min_dept_budget_code, unique_course_count, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_range_per_subject, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) = DEPARTMENT_CODE THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_CODE END AS department_code, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC) SELECT s1.department_code, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, s1.department_phone AS subject_department_phone, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.units_range, s2.units_variance, s2.department_phone AS math_department_phone FROM subq1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 AS s2
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18'), avg_units1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_courses_above_avg AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN avg_units1 AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.highest_avg_total_units, mca.SUBJECT_CODE, mca.TOTAL_UNITS AS MATH_COURSE_TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_courses_above_avg AS mca ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mca.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mca.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL AND (NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0))), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aca.TERM_CODE HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentUnitsEnriched AS (SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), SchoolClearingCostStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT due.DEPARTMENT_NAME, due.avg_total_units, due.range_total_units, due.var_total_units, due.SCHOOL_NAME, due.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sccs.total_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentUnitsEnriched AS due LEFT JOIN SchoolClearingCostStats AS sccs ON due.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY due.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_max_avg_org AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, AVG(t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_CODE ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_SORT) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = 'School of Science' AND LOWER(t0.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID, MAX(avg_org_number) AS max_avg_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, DLC_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_ID), org_area_stddev AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS dept_code, i.area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.DLC_CODE, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_ID, d.max_avg_org_number, o.area_stddev FROM dept_max_avg_org AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON d.ORGANIZATION_ID = fo.ORGANIZATION_ID JOIN org_area_stddev AS o ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.DLC_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH TopDepartments AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10), EngineeringDepartments2021FA AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_courses_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, ed.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ed.num_courses_offered, ed.total_enrolled_students, ed.avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN EngineeringDepartments2021FA AS ed ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY td.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, ed.num_courses_offered DESC

SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH
