s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.units_range, s1.units_variance, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.num_subjects, s2.avg_enrollment FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), subq1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.COURSE, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_enrollment, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.COURSE
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, dept_subjects.subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, subject_count, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, 'Mathematics Units' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS subject_count, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, SCHOOL_NAME, 'Non-Biology Enrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1), DepartmentVarianceStats AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.variance_num_enrolled_students, i.stddev_num_enrolled_students, v.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.variance_num_enrolled_students < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark AS v), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(inner_cte2.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte2.num_subjects) > 0) SELECT dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dvs.variance_num_enrolled_students, dvs.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dvs.avg_variance, dvs.variance_category, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dss.total_subjects FROM DepartmentVarianceStats AS dvs JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND WITH MathGradCourses AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, adc.Course_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adc.Course_Count DESC) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS adc ON ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), HighAvgEnrollmentDepts AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) SELECT mgc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.SCHOOL_NAME, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.Course_Count, mgc.admin_dept_dense_rank, hae.avg_enrolled_students, hae.stddev_enrolled_students FROM MathGradCourses AS mgc JOIN HighAvgEnrollmentDepts AS hae ON mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mgc.Course_Count DESC, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - WITH dept_units_grad_students AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_unit_category AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dugs.avg_total_units, dugs.stddev_total_units, dugs.num_grad_students, msuc.SUBJECT_TITLE, msuc.TOTAL_UNITS, msuc.SCHOOL_NAME, WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS ps JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS du ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'), student_info AS (SELECT inner_cte2.FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.geometric_mean_students, s.total_students, si.FULL_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.window_column FROM subject_code_stats AS s LEFT JOIN student_info AS si ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = si.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, si.FULL_NAME
WITH math_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ic.subject_count AS School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ranked ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.subject_count = ranked.max_subject_count WHERE (SELECT SUM(subject_count) FROM inner_cte AS ic2 WHERE ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR) > 5 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cs_rooms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 500 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN inner_cte.AREA >= 400 AND inner_cte.AREA < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_ROOM' ELSE 'SMALL_ROOM' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte) SELECT math_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, math_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, math_stats.stddev_total_units, math_stats.Most_Prominent_School, math_stats.School_Subject_Count, cs_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cs_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM, cs_rooms.AREA, cs_rooms.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs_rooms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS CS_ROOM_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cs_rooms.window_column, cs_rooms.room_size_category FROM math_stats JOIN cs_rooms ON math_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cs_rooms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY math_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cs_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), cte1 AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.max_cip_code, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = icte.max_cip_code JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.total_enrolled, cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte2.max_cip_code, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.total_enrolled DESC, cte2.max_cip_code DESC
WITH school_stddev AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(ic.stddev_total_units) AS school_stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) > 5 OR ic.SCHOOL_NAME = 'School of Science' ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME), dept_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ss.school_stddev_total_units FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN school_stddev AS ss ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.range_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), EngSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17') SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.avg_total_units, d.range_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, NULL AS num_subjects, 'DeptStats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, e.num_subjects, 'EngSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngSubjects AS e ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE) AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.cip_code_range, s1.cip_code_variance, s1.distinct_subject_codes, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg AS d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), MathSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, ays.earliest_term_start_date, ays.latest_term_start_date, mse.num_math_subjects, mse.SUBJECT_ID, mse.SUBJECT_TITLE, mse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, mse.deviation_from_avg FROM AcademicYearStats AS ays JOIN MathSubjectEnrollment AS mse ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mse.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mse.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_per_subject, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - WITH student_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte), units_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - WITH subq1_inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq1_avg_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM subq1_inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, a.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Fall%') SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year, s2.geometric_mean_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2'), DepartmentAdminStats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), DepartmentMathEnrollment AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.clearing_cost_collector_range, das.clearing_cost_collector_variance, das.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, das.num_admin_departments, dme.highest_term_enrollment FROM DepartmentAdminStats AS das LEFT JOIN DepartmentMathEnrollment AS dme ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE NOT das.clearing_cost_collector_range IS NULL ORDER BY das.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH top10_academic_buildings AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.room_count, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Major_Use_Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS Major_Use_Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.room_count DESC), academic_building_access2_rooms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.num_rooms, (ic.num_rooms - (SELECT AVG(num_rooms) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT t.BUILDING_NAME, t.room_count, t.Most_Common_Major_Use, t.Major_Use_Room_Count, a.num_rooms AS num_rooms_access_level_2, a.deviation_from_avg FROM top10_academic_buildings AS t LEFT JOIN academic_building_access2_rooms AS a ON t.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t.room_count DESC
WITH OrgGeometricMean AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME), AcademicBuildingStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, ogm.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, abs.BUILDING_NAME, abs.area_range, abs.area_variance, abs.area_stddev, abs.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgGeometricMean AS ogm JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN AcademicBuildingStats AS abs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = abs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, abs.area_range DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), max_enrolled_depts AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_stats_depts AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled, inner_cte2.range_enrolled, inner_cte2.var_enrolled, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled, inner_cte2.range_enrolled, inner_cte2.var_enrolled), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT md.DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS avg_enrolled, NULL AS range_enrolled, NULL AS var_enrolled, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'MaxEnrolled2019' AS Reason FROM max_enrolled_depts AS md UNION ALL SELECT esd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, esd.avg_enrolled, esd.range_enrolled, esd.var_enrolled, esd.total_subjects_offered, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM enrollment_stats_depts AS esd) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.stddev_total_units, s1.num_grad_students, s2.num_subjects_above_avg FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top10_eng_nonmit_depts AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.total_units, cc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, cc.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Course_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, dv.avg_total_units, dv.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, dv.variability_category, t10.total_units, t10.Top_Course_Title, t10.Top_Course_Units FROM dept_variability AS dv JOIN top10_eng_nonmit_depts AS t10 ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t10.total_units DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.department_name, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.var_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.num_grad_students FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.department_name, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students), eecs_students_mitid_category AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), avg_mit_id_per_year AS (SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year AS a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.MIT_ID) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.max_enrolled_students, esmc.MIT_ID, esmc.FULL_NAME, esmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, esmc.STUDENT_YEAR, esmc.mit_id_category FROM dept_enrollment_stats AS des CROSS JOIN eecs_students_mitid_category AS esmc
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.avg_enrolled, subq1.enrolled_variance, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.max_total_units, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM subq1 CROSS JOIN subq2 ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units FROM inner_cte), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_academic_year, s1.sum_total_units, NULL AS total_enrolled, NULL AS total_subjects, 'LibraryReserveFallU' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DepartmentMaterialStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(stddev_enrolled_students) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2) SELECT des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, dms.avg_enrolled_students, dms.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des LEFT JOIN DepartmentMaterialStats AS dms ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte1.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte1.AREA, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.AREA >= 500 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN inner_cte1.AREA >= 400 AND inner_cte1.AREA < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_ROOM' ELSE 'SMALL_ROOM' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1)) SELECT cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cte1.BUILDING_ROOM, cte1.AREA, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.window_column, cte1.room_size_category, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.num_enrolled_grad_students, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE = cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE cte1.AREA > 400 AND cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cte2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.row_num_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c2 WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c2.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.row_num_window FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptUnits AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathCoursesMax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = (SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.range_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.num_subjects_offered, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.num_courses FROM DeptUnits AS d LEFT JOIN MathCoursesMax AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count) > (SELECT SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5')) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, WITH degree_dept_courses AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c1 JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units) AS c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall) SELECT ddc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ddc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ddc.SCHOOL_NAME, ddc.num_unique_courses, ddc.total_units, ddc.max_units_subject_code, ddc.max_subject_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, des.enrollment_category FROM degree_dept_courses AS ddc JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON ddc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ddc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), mathematics_stats AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN inner_cte1 AS m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), top_subjects AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.avg_total_units, ic2.var_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ts.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units, ms.mathematics_subject_code_count, ms.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, ms.deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 AS ic2 LEFT JOIN top_subjects AS ts ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ts.rn = 1 CROSS JOIN mathematics_stats AS ms ORDER BY ic2.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH dept_units_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) <= 0.1 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'CONSISTENT' WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 0.3 * NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) THEN 'VARIABLE' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS variability_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.avg_total_units, duv.stddev_total_units, duv.variability_category, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.SCHOOL_NAME FROM dept_units_variability AS duv JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE), year_max_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) AS max_units_per_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, max_units_per_term FROM year_max_units WHERE max_units_per_term > (SELECT AVG(max_units_per_term) FROM year_max_units)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), subj_count AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, subj_count.total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 JOIN subj_count ON inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.max_units_per_term, s2.coefficient_of_variation, s2.total_subjects FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentStats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_total_units, inner_cte1.range_total_units, inner_cte1.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), SubjectCodeCounts AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeCounts GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.total_subject_codes FROM DepartmentStats AS ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN RollupResults AS rr ON ds.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE), budget_info AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN avg_budget AS a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, f.SCHOOL_NAME, f.window_column,
