WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units), cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte2.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.highest_total_units, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.var_enrolled_students, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) AS overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y')) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.min_total_units, s1.max_total_units, s1.deviation_from_overall_avg, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.deviation_from_overall_avg DESC, s2.stddev_total_units DESC

icte.COURSE_LEVEL) AS num_students_same_level FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, WITH student_dept_budget_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department_name, avg_budget, budget_range, budget_variance, department_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), dept_subject_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT sdbs.student_year, sdbs.department_name, sdbs.avg_budget, sdbs.budget_range, sdbs.budget_variance, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_range, dsu.total_units_variance, dsu.highest_avg_total_units FROM student_dept_budget_stats AS sdbs LEFT JOIN dept_subject_units_stats AS dsu ON sdbs.department_name = dsu.department_name AND sdbs.department_code = dsu.department_code ORDER BY sdbs.student_year, sdbs.department_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(variance_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte2) SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i1.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i1.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i2.variance_num_enrolled_students, i2.stddev_num_enrolled_students, vb.avg_variance, CASE WHEN i2.variance_num_enrolled_students > vb.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i2.variance_num_enrolled_students < vb.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i1 JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON 1 = 1 JOIN inner_cte2 AS i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN variance_benchmark AS vb ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY i1.total_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), rollup_cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.total_unique_subjects, r1.min_total_units, ic2.avg_office_phone, ic2.stddev_office_phone, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM rollup_cte1 AS r1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND NOT msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE NOT r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR (r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND NOT r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL) GROUP BY r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.total_unique_subjects, r1.min_total_units, ic2.avg_office_phone, ic2.stddev_office_phone ORDER BY r1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH highest_avg_enrollment_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), stddev_total_units_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.highest_avg_enrollment, s.stddev_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM highest_avg_enrollment_cte AS h JOIN stddev_total_units_cte AS s ON h.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY h.highest_avg_enrollment DESC, h.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH political_science_students AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte), department_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS prev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.total_students_in_department, dus.avg_total_units_2022, dus.var_total_units_2022, dus.avg_diff_from_2021 FROM political_science_students AS ps JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_coeff AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient FROM inner_cte1), variation_result AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i CROSS JOIN avg_coeff AS a), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT v.DEPARTMENT_NAME, v.coefficient_of_variation, v.variation_category, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variation_result AS v LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS i ON v.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON v.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY v.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000), SchoolSummary AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, MAX(max_cip_code) AS max_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolDeptCIP AS (SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.max_cip_code FROM SchoolSummary AS ss LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 AS ic ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.max_cip_code FROM SchoolSummary AS ss), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolDeptAvgUnits AS (SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.dept_avg_total_units > s.school_avg_total_units) SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdc.max_cip_code, sda.dept_avg_total_units FROM SchoolDeptCIP AS sdc JOIN SchoolDeptAvgUnits AS sda ON sdc.SCHOOL_NAME = sda.SCHOOL_NAME AND sdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sda.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC) SELECT subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.area_stddev, subq2.DLC_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON subq1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk ON sd.DLC_KEY = fodk.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN subq2 ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY subq2.area_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 AS inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), building_dept_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units, academic_year FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), dept_year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s2 WHERE s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology'))) SELECT bds.building, bds.dept, bds.course_count, bds.avg_total_units, bds.min_total_units, bds.max_total_units, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units AS dept_min_total_units, bds.academic_year FROM building_dept_stats AS bds JOIN dept_year_stats AS dys ON bds.academic_year = dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND bds.dept = dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY bds.building, bds.dept
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.num_subjects_offered, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(var_cip_program_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1), variance_stats AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_cip_program_code, i.range_cip_program_code, i.var_cip_program_code, CASE WHEN i.var_cip_program_code > v.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.var_cip_program_code < v.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark AS v), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), enrollment_stats AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.avg_cip_program_code, vs.range_cip_program_code, vs.var_cip_program_code, vs.variance_category, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN enrollment_stats AS es ON vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_subject_code_count, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0), math_subjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, ds.num_grad_students, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column, ms.unit_category FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN math_subjects AS ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH total_enrolled_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)), coefficient_variation_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tec.total_enrolled_students, cvc.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM total_enrolled_cte AS tec JOIN coefficient_variation_cte AS cvc ON tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cvc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NULL), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ds.avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte2) ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MAX(f.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS max_organization_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY organization_count DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) SELECT s1.DLC_NAME, s1.organization_count, s1.max_organization_id, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, s2.max_dense_rank FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_NAME = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), top_subjects AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.record_count_variance, ts.TOTAL_UNITS, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_units_stats AS dus CROSS JOIN top_subjects AS ts
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.avg_enrolled_students, ic2.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic1.num_hass_elective_subjects FROM inner_cte2 AS ic2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 AS ic1 ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolSummary AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptEngineeringSummary AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.num_departments, ss.total_courses, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, des.highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM SchoolSummary AS ss JOIN DeptEngineeringSummary AS des ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = des.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ss.total_courses DESC, des.highest_single_subject_enrollment DESC
WITH dept_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) AS overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.num_subjects_offered, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, ms.min_total_units, ms.max_total_units, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN math_stats AS ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_units_subject_title, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.range_total_units, s1.var_total_units, s1.max_units_subject_title, s1.max_total_units, s2.min_num_enrolled_students, s2.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS undergraduate_level, Total_Courses.Total_Undergrad_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.undergraduate_level, s1.Total_Undergrad_Courses, s1.avg_enrollment, s1.enrollment_variance, s1.enrollment_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.max_total_units_3rows, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.TERM_CODE
WITH geometric_mean_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), subject_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.subject_count, gmc.geometric_mean FROM subject_count_cte AS scc LEFT JOIN geometric_mean_cte AS gmc ON scc.SCHOOL_NAME = gmc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), DepartmentHighestEnrollment AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), DepartmentYearUnitsStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dyus.total_units_variance, dyus.total_units_stddev, dhe.highest_term_enrollment FROM DepartmentYearUnitsStats AS dyus JOIN DepartmentHighestEnrollment AS dhe ON dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dhe.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dyus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dyus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, total_units_range, total_units_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT total_units_range IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_total_units_3rows, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_units_above_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_avg AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dua.total_units, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_above_avg AS dua JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 AS i ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN math_avg AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = ic.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.total_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.max_total_units, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM (SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub)), cte2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.total_enrollment FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.var_enrolled_students, d.max_enrolled_students, r.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.total_subjects FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d LEFT JOIN RollupResults AS r ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.TERM_DESCRIPTION
WITH clearing_cost_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_clearing_cost_collector, clearing_cost_collector_variance, clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_clearing_cost_collector > (SELECT AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18') ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC), max_course_offers AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(offer_count) AS max_offer_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ccs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, mco.COURSE_NUMBER, mco.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mco.SUBJECT_TITLE, mco.max_offer_count FROM clearing_cost_stats AS ccs LEFT JOIN max_course_offers AS mco ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mco.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ccs.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC, mco.max_offer_count DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING), subq1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_budget AS (SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), subq2 AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.department_count, i.min_budget_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i, avg_budget AS a WHERE i.min_budget_code > a.avg_budget_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, s1.total_courses, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS department_count, NULL AS min_budget_code, 'Courses' AS Source FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, NULL AS total_courses, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.department_count, s2.min_budget_code, 'Departments' AS Source FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), MathStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL AND (NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0))), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), SchoolStats AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), SchoolAgg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments FROM SchoolStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolAggWithTotal AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_coefficient_of_variation, num_departments FROM SchoolAgg UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, SUM(num_departments) FROM SchoolAgg GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.total_units_range, ms.total_units_variance, sa.avg_coefficient_of_variation, sa.num_departments FROM MathStats AS ms LEFT JOIN SchoolAggWithTotal AS sa ON ms.SCHOOL_NAME = sa.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, sa.avg_coefficient_of_variation
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, MAX(num_subjects) AS max_num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.num_subjects, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.variance_num_subjects, s2.stddev_num_subjects, s2.max_num_subjects FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, s1.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS num_courses_offered, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_courses_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.num_courses_offered, s2.total_enrolled_students, s2.avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, s2.num_courses_offered DESC
WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - dept_stats.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.Total_Courses, mcs.course_number, mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS AS math_course_total_units, mcs.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, mcs.min_total_units AS math_min_total_units, mcs.max_total_units AS math_max_total_units, mcs.deviation_from_avg AS math_deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs ON dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC, mcs.deviation_from_avg DESC

inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Undergrad_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), subject_units_by_year AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.total_units_variance, y.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category, i.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN year_stats AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), WITH math_max_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6), chem_reserved_materials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, a.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(ic.num_reserved_materials) AS total_reserved_materials, MIN(ic.min_academic_year) AS min_academic_year, tc.max_term_code AS term_code_with_most_reserved, tc.max_reserved_materials AS reserved_materials_in_term FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE AS max_term_code, num_reserved_materials AS max_reserved_materials FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, num_reserved_materials, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_reserved_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS tc ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = tc.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tc.max_term_code, tc.max_reserved_materials ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT mmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mmu.max_total_units, mmu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mmu.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, mmu.TERM_CODE AS MATH_TERM_CODE, crm.SUBJECT_TITLE, crm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, crm.total_reserved_materials, crm.min_academic_year, crm.term_code_with_most_reserved, crm.reserved_materials_in_term FROM math_max_units AS mmu LEFT JOIN chem_reserved_materials AS crm ON mmu.TERM_CODE = crm.term_code_with_most_reserved
