WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_academic_year, s1.sum_total_units, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.graduate_student_count, ROUND(s1.sum_total_units / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_sum, ROUND(s1.sum_total_units / NULLIF(s2.graduate_student_count, 0), 2) AS units_per_grad_student FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_units_sum DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_var_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte2) SELECT i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i1.min_enrolled, i1.total_enrolled, i2.total_units_variance, i2.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i2.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i2.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i1 JOIN inner_cte2 AS i2 ON i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN avg_var_cte AS a ORDER BY i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.range_total_units, cte2.var_total_units, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_school_phone AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dsp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM political_science_subjects GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0) AS ps LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN department_school_phone AS dsp ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE), HighestAvgEnrollmentPerTerm AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DeptEnrollmentStatsWithLibraryReserve AS (SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students) SELECT h.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, h.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.var_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students FROM HighestAvgEnrollmentPerTerm AS h JOIN DeptEnrollmentStatsWithLibraryReserve AS d ON h.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.department ORDER BY h.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, h.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC
WITH inner_cte_1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq1 AS (SELECT inner_cte_1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte_1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte_1.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte_1.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte_1.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte_1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS prev ON inner_cte_1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte_2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte_2 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units_2022, s1.var_total_units_2022, s1.avg_diff_from_2021, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.avg_enrollment FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.department, ic.academic_year, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.academic_year), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.academic_year, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_term_start_date, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.stddev_total_units, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.department = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.academic_year
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR), cte2 AS (SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t3 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t3.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.num_unique_courses, s2.total_units AS dept_total_units, s2.num_unique_subject_codes FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic1.STUDENT_YEAR, ic1.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) LIKE 'H%' ORDER BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.STUDENT_YEAR, ic2.window_column
WITH dept_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), eecs_courses AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.COURSE = scd.COURSE) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, de.num_unique_subjects, ec.COURSE, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPT_NAME, ec.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column, ec.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM dept_enrollment AS de JOIN eecs_courses AS ec ON de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.subject_count_range, inner_cte1.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.subject_count_range, cte1.subject_count_variance, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.total_units, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_avg AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_subject_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC) SELECT dbc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dbc.SCHOOL_NAME, dbc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbc.avg_dept_budget_code, dbc.budget_category, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_variance FROM dept_budget_category AS dbc JOIN dept_subject_units_stats AS dsu ON dbc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND dbc.SCHOOL_NAME = dsu.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING), math_courses_rollup AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, SUM(num_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), dept_budget_category AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT mcr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcr.SCHOOL_NAME, mcr.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, mcr.total_courses, dbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dbc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbc.avg_dept_budget_code, dbc.budget_category FROM math_courses_rollup AS mcr LEFT JOIN dept_budget_category AS dbc ON mcr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dbc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mcr.SCHOOL_NAME = dbc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY mcr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcr.SCHOOL_NAME, mcr.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dbc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE), subq1 AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg1 AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_avg2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), overall_avg2 AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrollment_category, s2.dept_avg_units, s2.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_2, STDDEV_SAMP(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) / AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON mdh.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME HAVING AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) > 0), cte_high_cv AS (SELECT department_hierarchy_level_2, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte_high_cv.department_hierarchy_level_2, cte_high_cv.coefficient_of_variation, MAX(inner_cte2.org_unit_count) AS max_org_unit_count, MIN(inner_cte2.min_department_id) AS min_department_id FROM cte_high_cv JOIN inner_cte2 ON cte_high_cv.department_hierarchy_level_2 = inner_cte2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME GROUP BY cte_high_cv.department_hierarchy_level_2, cte_high_cv.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY cte_high_cv.department_hierarchy_level_2
WITH AcademicYearMathStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, dept.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Offered_Department, dept.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept.dept_rank = 1), DepartmentMaxEnrollment2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT aym.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aym.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aym.total_units_range, aym.total_units_variance, aym.Most_Offered_Department, aym.Subject_Count, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.highest_enrollment FROM AcademicYearMathStats AS aym LEFT JOIN DepartmentMaxEnrollment2022 AS dme ON aym.Most_Offered_Department = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY aym.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_budget_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE - s.avg_dept_budget_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS s ON d.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), eng_dept_max_phone AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.deviation_from_avg, e.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM dept_budget_deviation AS d LEFT JOIN eng_dept_max_phone AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.department_name ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic.num_courses >= 5 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN dept_courses AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column
WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats AS cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment AS hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH dept_budget_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE - s.avg_dept_budget_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS s ON d.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), math_enrollment_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(enrolled_students_variance) AS highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.deviation_from_avg, m.highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM dept_budget_deviation AS d LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_variance AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (NOT m.highest_enrolled_students_variance IS NULL) ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = (SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.num_courses FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), top_subjects AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.record_count_variance, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.record_count_variance, ts.TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units_stats AS dus JOIN top_subjects AS ts ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.record_count_variance DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE END AS department_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.COURSE_NUMBER = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON scd.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.department_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.course, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.SCHOOL_NAME AS s1_school_name, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.stddev_enrolled_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME AS s2_school_name, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.department_code, s1.course
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT 'Department_Statistics' AS result_type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Subject_Details' AS result_type, NULL AS academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, s2.term_description, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY result_type, academic_year, department_name, term_description, subject_code
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, gt.Most_Common_Grade_Type, gt.Grade_Type_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE AS Most_Common_Grade_Type, COUNT(*) AS Grade_Type_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND at2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at2.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso2.GRADE_TYPE) AS sub)) AS gt ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.TERM_CODE = gt.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_total_units >= 9) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s1.Most_Common_Grade_Type, s1.Grade_Type_Count, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccs.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s1.num_students, s2.total_enrolled, s2.num_unique_subject_titles WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DegreeDeptStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_enrollment > 20) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_CODE, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, dds.avg_enrollment, dds.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des JOIN DegreeDeptStats AS dds ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC

school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, mcs.distinct_course_options FROM school_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN math_course_stats AS mcs
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE, c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), dept_benchmark AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_cip_code, i.COURSE, i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, CASE WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > d.avg_cip_code * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE < d.avg_cip_code * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category, ic2.avg_total_units, ic2.var_total_units, ic2.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_benchmark AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE

SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT AVG(avg_total_units) IS NULL), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)), CourseCounts2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr1.SCHOOL_NAME, rr1.avg_total_units, rr1.total_units_variance, rr1.total_units_stddev, ic2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc2.NUM_COURSES FROM RollupResults1 AS rr1 LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN CourseCounts2 AS cc2 ON rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, SUM(cc2.NUM_COURSES) FROM CourseCounts2 AS cc2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME
WITH stddev_max_enrollment_per_year AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), avg_total_units_per_year AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS sub) AS overall) SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.stddev_max_enrollment, s.department_phone, s.school_name, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, a.load_category FROM stddev_max_enrollment_per_year AS s JOIN avg_total_units_per_year AS a ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC
WITH student_cte AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), student_final AS (SELECT i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT sf.LAST_NAME, sf.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sf.STUDENT_YEAR, sf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sf.SCHOOL_NAME, sf.window_column, sf.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sf.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ec.total_enrolled_students FROM student_final AS sf JOIN enrollment_cte AS ec ON sf.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE
