WITH BuildingRoomArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000), BuildingPeriods AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods AS bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0), AcademicBuildingArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32') SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea AS bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea AS aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.highest_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.coefficient_of_variation AS library_total_units_coefficient_of_variation, cte2.avg_subject_enrollment FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptCounts AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.num_departments, ic.avg_total_units, ic.range_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN DeptCounts AS dc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = dc.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL, dc.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, dc.num_departments, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM DeptCounts AS dc), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), MathVarianceRollup AS (SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units FROM (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP) AS ic WHERE NOT ic.variance_total_units IS NULL) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.num_departments, rr.avg_total_units, rr.range_total_units, rr.var_total_units, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mv.variance_total_units FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MathVarianceRollup AS mv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7') SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_course_number_ascii, var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_course_number_ascii > (SELECT AVG(avg_course_number_ascii) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats), SchoolDeptCounts AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolDeptStats AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts AS sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.num_degree_granting_departments, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.avg_course_number_ascii, sq1.var_course_number_ascii, sds.avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats AS sds JOIN Subquery1 AS sq1 ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), dept_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_range, inner_cte1.enrolled_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_dept_unit_stats AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL) AS t) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.enrolled_stddev, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sds.avg_total_units, sds.range_total_units, sds.var_total_units FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN school_dept_unit_stats AS sds ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = sds.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020)) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID), math_subjects AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_stats AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.min_num_enrolled_students, ms.avg_lecture_units, ms.total_terms, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.var_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, ds.num_grad_students FROM math_subjects AS ms LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ms.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL) AS subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_avg_total_units, NULL AS variance_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, 'MathHighestAvgTotalUnits' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS highest_avg_total_units, s2.variance_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, 'DeptVarianceStddev' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, highest_avg_total_units, variance_total_units, stddev_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE COURSE IN (SELECT COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE COURSE_LEVEL = 'G')) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.max_cip_code_variance, subq1.min_cip_code_variance, subq2.COURSE, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH SchoolGeometricMean AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS s ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units, sgm.avg_geometric_mean, sgm.comparison_to_average, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev FROM SchoolGeometricMean AS sgm JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON sgm.SCHOOL_NAME = des.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME

MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.enrolled_stddev, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcs.avg_subject_code_length, dcs.range_subject_code_length, dcs.var_subject_code_length FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN dept_code_stats AS dcs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM (SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrollment, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.total_units_variance, ic2.total_units_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS CC_DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrollment, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.total_units_variance, ic2.total_units_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic2.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), RollupResults AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), GraduateProgramSizes AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' END AS grad_program_size FROM inner_cte2) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled, gps.total_graduate_students, gps.grad_program_size FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN GraduateProgramSizes AS gps ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gps.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.variance_total_units FROM (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP) AS ic WHERE NOT ic.variance_total_units IS NULL ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.variance_total_units, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_students DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units, s1.num_courses_latest_year, s2.unique_students, s2.benchmark, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.unique_students DESC, s1.total_units DESC
WITH building_dept_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, building, dept_sort) = building THEN NULL ELSE building END AS building, dept, course_count, avg_total_units, min_total_units, max_total_units, department_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY END AS building, CASE WHEN GROUPING(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS course_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY building_sort, dept_sort), degree_dept_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c1 JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units) AS c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT b.building, b.dept, b.course_count, b.avg_total_units, b.min_total_units, b.max_total_units, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.num_unique_courses, d.total_units, d.max_units_subject_code, d.max_subject_total_units FROM building_dept_course_stats AS b JOIN degree_dept_course_stats AS d ON WITH student_year_dept_budget_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department_name, avg_budget, budget_range, budget_variance, department_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), math_dept_subject_stats AS (WITH SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s.student_year, s.department_name, WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cv), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation AS cv_2024, s1.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS avg_cv_2024, s1.variation_category, s2.coefficient_of_variation AS cv_regular_terms FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subject_units_stats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, sus.total_units_variance, sus.total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN subject_units_stats AS sus ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sus.DEPARTMENT) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_students_per_year > (SELECT AVG(avg_students_per_year) FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxUnitsPoliticalScience AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), DepartmentCourseCount AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dcc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentCourseCount AS dcc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanCIP AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC), DeptSubjectUnitStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.geometric_mean_cip, dsus.avg_total_units, dsus.total_units_range, dsus.total_units_variance FROM GeometricMeanCIP AS gmc JOIN DeptSubjectUnitStats AS dsus ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmc.geometric_mean_cip DESC), avg_variance_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_cip, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_VARIANCE' WHEN i.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_variance_cte AS a ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_cip DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ChemEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), DeptCourseNumberStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC) SELECT ces.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ces.avg_enrollment, ces.enrollment_variance, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii FROM ChemEnrollmentStats AS ces JOIN DeptCourseNumberStats AS dcs ON ces.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.avg_course_number_ascii, icte.var_course_number_ascii, mc.Most_Common_Course_Number, mc.Course_Number_Frequency FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER AS Most_Common_Course_Number, COUNT(*) AS Course_Number_Frequency FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d2 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY s2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS sub)) AS mc ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10

AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC), Subquery3 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(cd.COURSE) AS total_courses, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, s2.avg_subject_codes, s2.stddev_subject_codes, s3.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE JOIN Subquery3 AS s3 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s3.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_CODE = s3.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY i.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FallTermMathStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), RegularTermMathStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso regular_avg_total_units, r.range_total_units AS regular_range_total_units, r.var_total_units AS regular_var_total_units FROM RegularTermMathStats AS r JOIN FallTermMathStats AS f ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = f.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.fall_avg_total_units, ic.fall_var_total_units, ic.fall_stddev_total_units, COALESCE(fall_req.fall_required_textbook_count, 0) AS fall_required_textbook_count, ic.regular_avg_total_units, ic.regular_range_total_units, ic.regular_var_total_units, COALESCE(reg_req.regular_required_textbook_count, 0) AS regular_required_textbook_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS fall_required_textbook_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON ccso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS fall_req ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = fall_req.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS reg_req ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = reg_req.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR

coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID), chem_subjects_with_materials AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students_variance, (icte.enrolled_students_variance - avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students_variance) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY icte.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, icte.stddev_enrolled_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.window_column, sd2.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_subject_school_name FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') AS ms ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedStats AS (SELECT icte.administrative_department, icte.academic_department, icte.max_total_units, icte.subject_title_with_max_units, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT administrative_department, academic_department, max_total_units, subject_title_with_max_units, avg_enrolled_students, range_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM (SELECT administrative_department, academic_department, max_total_units, subject_title_with_max_units, avg_enrolled_students, range_enrolled_students, var_enrolled_students FROM CombinedStats UNION ALL SELECT administrative_department, academic_department, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS subject_title_with_max_units, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(range_enrolled_students) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(var_enrolled_students) AS var_enrolled_students FROM CombinedStats GROUP BY administrative_department, academic_department WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT administrative_department IS NULL AND NOT academic_department IS NULL) OR (NOT administrative_department IS NULL AND academic_department IS NULL)) AS final ORDER BY administrative_department, academic_department

JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT lm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lm.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS avg_units_status, 'LibraryMathematics' AS Reason FROM LibraryMathematics AS lm UNION ALL SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS avg_units_status, 'DepartmentEnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des), AvgUnitsByDept AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), OverallAvgUnits AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, aud.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN aud.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_UNITS' WHEN aud.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG_UNITS' WHEN aud.avg_total_units IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_status, ic.Reason FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN AvgUnitsByDept AS aud ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = aud.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN OverallAvgUnits AS oa ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.Reason
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_total_units_3rows FROM (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS s1 JOIN (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = CONCAT(s2.SUBJECT_CODE, '.', s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.max_total_units_3rows, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget AS a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avg_budget, budget_variance, CASE WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code > avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code < avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), Department_CV AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), Political_Science_Students AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank, pss.DEPARTMENT FROM Department_CV AS dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students AS pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank, sub_count.subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = sub_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column) = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation, abs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS ogm JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0) AS abs ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = abs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptCoeffVar AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(des.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN DeptCoeffVar AS dc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.normalized_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.normalized_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS grad_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_units AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT td.ISBN IS NULL), ranked_courses AS (SELECT cu.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cu.SUBJECT_ID, cu.SUBJECT_TITLE, cu.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cu.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY cu.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM course_units AS cu) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.grad_student_count, rc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, rc.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Course_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN ranked_courses AS rc ON ic.DEPARTMENT = rc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND rc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.grad_student_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DeptCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT LIKE '%Mathematics%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCostStats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), coefficient_variation AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), math_dept_info AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, c.coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation AS c JOIN math_dept_info AS m ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_units.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS avg_units ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = avg_units.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), PoliSciHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), DeptHGNCount AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.HGN_CODE) AS unique_hgn_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS unique_hgn_count, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS unique_hgn_count, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats AS p UNION ALL SELECT h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, h.unique_hgn_count, 'DeptHGNCount' AS Source FROM DeptHGNCount AS h ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), EECS_Subjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT icte.FIRST_NAME, icte.LAST_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN EECS_Subjects AS es ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY icte.LAST_NAME, es.SUBJECT_ID

min_dept_budget_code FROM MathDeptSubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0) SELECT jr.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, jr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, jr.SCHOOL_NAME, RollupTotals AS rt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE

AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >=
