MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN UnitsStatistics AS us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, max_stats.max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(sub.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS max_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH bio_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), math_units_stats AS (WITH term_units AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, m.units_range, m.units_variance, m.units_stddev FROM bio_enrollment_stats AS b LEFT JOIN math_units_stats AS m ON b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, ic.units_stddev, sd_math.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, ad_math.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS math_department_phone, sd_bio.SCHOOL_NAME AS bio_school_name FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd_math ON sd_math.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad_math ON sd_math.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad_math.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd_bio ON sd_bio.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1), DeptTotalSubjects AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME <> 'Non-MIT' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrollment, d1.enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'Avg/Var' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, d2.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'CoeffVar' AS Reason FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS d2 UNION ALL SELECT d3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, d3.total_subjects_offered, 'TotalSubjects' AS Reason FROM DeptTotalSubjects AS d3) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), subject_units_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptSubjectRollup AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN subject_units_stats AS sus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(dsr.subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count, MIN(dsr.min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, MAX(dsr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(dsr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range_variance FROM DeptSubjectRollup AS dsr GROUP BY dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(dsr.subject_code_count) > 0 ORDER BY dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsCV AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), DeptCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV AS dcv LEFT JOIN DeptCIPStats AS dcs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dcs.cip_program_code_variance, dcs.cip_program_code_stddev FROM DeptCIPStats AS dcs LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsCV AS dcv ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation, cip_program_code_variance, cip_program_code_stddev, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), Department_CV AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), Math_Departments AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.avg_dept_budget_code, dc.coefficient_of_variation, dc.avg_total_units FROM Department_CV AS dc JOIN Math_Departments AS md ON dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = md.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = md.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.coefficient_of_variation, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, (s.TOTAL_UNITS - i.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AND NOT s.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY window_column DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCourseNumberStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptCourseUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.avg_course_number_ascii, d1.var_course_number_ascii, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCourseNumberStats AS d1 JOIN DeptCourseUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count_range, icte.subject_count_variance, icte.subject_count_stddev, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Bio_Enrolled_Stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Math_Units_Stats AS (WITH term_units AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev, AVG(total_units_per_term) AS avg_units_per_term FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, m.units_range, m.units_variance, m.units_stddev, m.avg_units_per_term FROM Bio_Enrolled_Stats AS b JOIN Math_Units_Stats AS m ON b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students > inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students < inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, ss_min_units.min_total_units_window FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS min_total_units_window FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss) AS ss_min_units ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss_min_units.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Physics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte AS c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9), ClearingCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SubjectCount2024 AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT m.administrative_department, m.academic_department, m.max_total_units, m.subject_title_with_max_units, c.avg_clearing_cost_collector, c.clearing_cost_collector_variance, c.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, s.num_subjects_2024 FROM inner_cte AS m JOIN ClearingCostStats AS c ON m.academic_department = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SubjectCount2024 AS s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY m.administrative_department, m.academic_department

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, ms2.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS ms2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ms2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE

BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), TopDeptCourses AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political des.enrolled_students_stddev, des.avg_enrolled_students FROM TopDeptCourses AS tdc LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS des ON tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tdc.course_count DESC, tdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS overall_avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, icte.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN icte.avg_enrolled_students > oa.overall_avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN icte.avg_enrolled_students < oa.overall_avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY icte.course_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_enrolled_students, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS subject_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY icte.num_subjects_offered DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_avg_var_excl_bio AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg_range_var_excl_chem AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrolled_students, d1.var_enrolled_students, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled FROM dept_avg_var_excl_bio AS d1 JOIN dept_avg_range_var_excl_chem AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, icte.avg_enrolled, icte.range_enrolled, icte.var_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'

MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tus.avg_total_units, tus.var_total_units, tus.stddev_total_units, es.enrollment_range, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(tus.avg_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrollment_range, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_enrollment_range, ROUND(es.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(tus.var_total_units, 0), 2) AS enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio FROM EnrollmentStats AS es JOIN TotalUnitsStats AS tus ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_enrollment_range DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.avg_units_per_enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_subject_enrollment_number FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.avg_units_per_enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio ORDER BY icte.avg_units_per_enrollment_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), top_materials AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tm.material_count, de.total_enrolled FROM top_materials AS tm JOIN dept_enrollment AS de ON tm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tm.material_count DESC) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, icte.total_enrolled, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), TopDeptSubjects AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tds.subject_count, dus.avg_total_units FROM TopDeptSubjects AS tds JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, dus.avg_total_units DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.avg_total_units, COALESCE(COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME), 0) AS grad_student_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.avg_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), SubjectCodeWindow AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS min_enrollment_by_subject_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS min_enrollment_windowed FROM inner_cte AS i), SchoolOfScienceEnrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_enrolled, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS science_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT scw.min_enrollment_by_subject_code FROM WindowedEnrollment AS w JOIN SubjectCodeWindow AS scw ON w.SUBJECT_TITLE = scw.SUBJECT_TITLE AND w.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = scw.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND w.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = scw.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SchoolOfScienceEnrollment AS sse ON w.SUBJECT_ID = sse.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sse.science_enrolled >= 0.6 * sse.total_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS - ict.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte AS ict ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ict.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), MathDeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitsStats AS mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER = c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND (d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8') GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON m.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE AND m.SUBJECT_NUMBER = c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, tsc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, tsc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') AS tsc JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tsc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), HighUnitDepartments AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units_per_course FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT icte.COURSE, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, hud.total_units, hud.avg_units_per_course FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN HighUnitDepartments AS hud ON icte.DEPARTMENT = hud.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), TopDepartmentAdmins AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.department_count, inner_cte.min_budget_code, tda.admin_dept_count FROM inner_cte JOIN TopDepartmentAdmins AS tda ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tda.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathematicsUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), MathStudentCounts AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_math_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = '18' WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' AND sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units, msc.num_math_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats AS mus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathStudentCounts AS msc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH geometric_mean_materials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), avg_var_units AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmm.geometric_mean_record_count, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM geometric_mean_materials AS gmm JOIN avg_var_units AS avu ON gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_record_count, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, COALESCE(lib.subjects_with_reserve, 0) AS num_subjects_with_library_reserve FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT atall.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_reserve FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS atall ON ccso.TERM_CODE = atall.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atall.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS lib ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(e.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN enrollment AS e ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = e.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), HGN_Rollup AS (SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.HGN_CODE, MAX(p.max_lecture_units) AS total_max_lecture_units FROM PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS p GROUP BY p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.HGN_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT MAX(p.max_lecture_units) IS NULL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS p ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = p.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, h.HGN_CODE, h.total_max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HGN_Rollup AS h ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE NOT h.HGN_CODE IS NULL ORDER BY total_units_range DESC, max_lecture_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), AvgEnrolled AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_students_variance, es.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS es JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS gm ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled AS ae ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ae.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptUnitsAvgVar AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.variance_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, da.avg_total_units, da.var_total_units FROM DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS dv JOIN DeptUnitsAvgVar AS da ON dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = da.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY variability_category DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME), school_avg_units AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < s.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg_units AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), SubjectTermGroup AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall & Spring' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring' ELSE 'Other' END AS term_group, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CASE WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall & Spring' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall' WHEN cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring' ELSE 'Other' END), RollupResults AS (SELECT stg.term_group, SUM(stg.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(stg.total_units) AS total_units FROM SubjectTermGroup AS stg GROUP BY stg.term_group WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(stg.num_subjects) > 0) SELECT ic.FULL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.student_year_rank, rr.term_group, rr.num_subjects, rr.total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY ic.student_year_rank, ic.FULL_NAME, rr.term_group

geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjects AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.TERM_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjectCounts AS (SELECT ss.FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM StudentSubjects AS ss GROUP BY ss.FULL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sc.subject_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN StudentSubjectCounts AS sc ON s.FULL_NAME = sc.FULL_NAME JOIN StudentSubjects AS ss ON s.FULL_NAME = ss.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sc.subject_count DESC, s.LAST_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_status_p, icte.var_total_units AS var_total_units_status_p, icte.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_status_p, reg.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular, reg.range_total_units AS range_total_units_regular, reg.var_total_units AS var_total_units_regular, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS reg ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = reg.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, reg.avg_total_units, reg.range_total_units, reg.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units, rc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, rc.SUBJECT_TITLE, rc.subject_total_units ORDER BY icte.total_units DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AcademicYearUnitsRange AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), HighLectureYears AS (SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS t)), AvgLectureUnits AS (SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS t2) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, hly.total_lecture_units, (hly.total_lecture_units - alu.avg_lecture_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN HighLectureYears AS hly ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = hly.ACADEMIC_YEAR CROSS JOIN AvgLectureUnits AS alu
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StddevTotalUnits AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), EnrolledStudentsStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev FROM StddevTotalUnits AS s JOIN EnrolledStudentsStats AS e ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students_in_library_subject FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS SD ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SD.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = LSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS TSO ON LSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND TSO.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' WHERE SD.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev
