stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, me.TERM_CODE, dcc.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcc.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, me.avg_enrollment, me.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptClearingCost AS dcc LEFT JOIN MathEnrollment AS me ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = me.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY department_name, term_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, term, avg_clearing_cost_collector, stddev_clearing_cost_collector, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS department_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE term_code END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(term_code) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE term_code END AS term_sort, department_name, term_code, AVG(avg_clearing_cost_collector) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(stddev_clearing_cost_collector) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, term_code WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY department_sort, term_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC), MathSubjects2005FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), MathSubjectsRollup AS (SELECT ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ms.window_column, SUM(ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_math_subject_enrollment FROM MathSubjects2005FA AS ms GROUP BY ms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ms.window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND SUM(ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) OR (ms.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL)) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, msr.SUBJECT_TITLE, msr.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msr.window_column, CASE WHEN msr.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL THEN msr.total_math_subject_enrollment ELSE NULL END AS total_math_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN MathSubjectsRollup AS msr ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.total_enrolled_students DESC, msr.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), PoliticalScienceUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_program_code, icte.stddev_cip_program_code, psu.avg_total_units, psu.total_units_range, psu.total_units_variance, psu.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN PoliticalScienceUnits AS psu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = psu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, dstat.avg_students_per_year, dstat.range_students_per_year, dstat.var_students_per_year FROM DeptSubjects2021 AS ds21 JOIN dept_stats AS dstat ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dstat.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.avg_students_per_year, icte.range_students_per_year, icte.var_students_per_year, sc.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year, sc.num_students AS Student_Year_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.num_subjects_offered DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), faculty_dept_counts AS (SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.max_enrolled_students, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Responsible_Faculty_Department, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.max_enrolled_students, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ranked_faculty_dept AS (SELECT fdc.*, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_subject = fdc.SUBJECT_TITLE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_subject := fdc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT * FROM faculty_dept_counts ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, Subject_Count DESC) AS fdc CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_subject := '') AS vars), AcademicTermStats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE) SELECT rfd.SUBJECT_TITLE, rfd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rfd.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, rfd.TERM_CODE, rfd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rfd.max_enrolled_students, rfd.Most_Prominent_Responsible_Faculty_Department, rfd.Subject_Count, ats.academic_term_parameter, ats.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ats.avg_total_units, ats.var_total_units FROM ranked_faculty_dept AS rfd JOIN AcademicTermStats AS ats ON rfd.TERM_CODE = ats.academic_term_parameter WHERE rfd.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY rfd.max_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment_stddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), dept_subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM dept_enrollment_stddev AS des JOIN dept_subject_code_stats AS dscs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(stddev_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_subject_codes, ic.stddev_subject_codes, CASE WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students > evb.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students < evb.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS enrollment_variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN enrollment_variance_benchmark AS evb
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, stats.avg_total_units, stats.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE NOT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT sd.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) >= 15), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT d.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.student_count, ic.latest_student_load, dss.subject_count_range, dss.subject_count_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS dss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), UnitsStats AS (SELECT sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sos.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT e.TERM_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats AS e JOIN UnitsStats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND e.TERM_CODE = u.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, MAX(enrolled_range) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance, MAX(total_units_range) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), HighUnitDepartments AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units_per_course FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT eec.COURSE, eec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eec.SCHOOL_NAME, eec.window_column, hud.total_units, hud.avg_units_per_course FROM inner_cte AS eec JOIN HighUnitDepartments AS hud ON eec.DEPARTMENT = hud.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY eec.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), dept_cv AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), polsci_programs AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME) AS window_column FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17') SELECT pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pcv.coefficient_of_variation, pp.PROGRAM_TITLE, pp.CATEGORY_TITLE, pp.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pp.window_column FROM dept_cv AS pcv JOIN polsci_programs AS pp ON pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = pp.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE, inner_cte.CATEGORY_TITLE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SCHOOL_NAME), RangeAndVariance AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.SCHOOL_NAME, cov.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, rav.total_units_range, rav.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN RangeAndVariance AS rav ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rav.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rav.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND cov.SCHOOL_NAME = rav.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, ms.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS gm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d2 ON t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ms ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC), BioStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS bio_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, BioStats.coefficient_of_variation, BioStats.bio_subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN BioStats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = BioStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), SubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC), MostFrequentSubjectCode AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS offering_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON scd.COURSE = s.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, scs.subject_code_count_variance, scs.subject_code_count_stddev, mfsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS most_frequent_subject_code, mfsc.offering_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SubjectCodeStats AS scs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostFrequentSubjectCode AS mfsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mfsc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC LIMIT 10
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPT_NAME, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept, ms.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus LEFT JOIN MathSubjects2022 AS ms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.var_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, syc.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year, syc.Student_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS Student_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_dept := sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_dept := '') AS vars GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, Student_Count DESC) AS syc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = syc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND syc.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_grad_students AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), all_grad_students AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_grad_students AS (SELECT AVG(total_graduate_students) AS avg_grad_students FROM all_grad_students) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, mgs.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN mgs.total_graduate_students > ags.avg_grad_students THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN mgs.total_graduate_students < ags.avg_grad_students THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS grad_student_status FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN math_grad_students AS mgs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN avg_grad_students AS ags ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), dept_max_enroll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subjects_per_term AS spt JOIN dept_terms AS dt ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_max_enroll AS dme ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.range_num_subjects, inner_cte.variance_num_subjects, inner_cte.stddev_num_subjects, inner_cte.max_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM inner_cte JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.FULL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TotalUnitsStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), EnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tus.avg_total_units, tus.var_total_units, tus.stddev_total_units, es.enrollment_range, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(tus.avg_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrollment_range, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_enrollment_range, ROUND(es.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(tus.var_total_units, 0), 2) AS enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio FROM EnrollmentStats AS es JOIN TotalUnitsStats AS tus ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tus.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tus.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(var_total_units) AS var_total_units, SUM(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, SUM(enrollment_range) AS enrollment_range, SUM(enrollment_variance) AS enrollment_variance, SUM(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(avg_units_per_enrollment_range) AS avg_units_per_enrollment_range, SUM(enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio) AS enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(var_total_units) IS NULL) SELECT rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.avg_total_units, rr.var_total_units, rr.stddev_total_units, rr.enrollment_range, rr.enrollment_variance, rr.enrollment_stddev, rr.avg_units_per_enrollment_range, rr.enrollment_variance_to_units_variance_ratio FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > s.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < s.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_enrollment_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StddevTotalUnits AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), EnrolledStudentsStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev FROM StddevTotalUnits AS s JOIN EnrolledStudentsStats AS e ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS SD ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SD.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SD.DEPARTMENT_CODE = LSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS TSO ON LSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TSO.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND TSO.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.student_year_rank, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, des.avg_enrolled, des.range_enrolled, des.var_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS des ON icte.DEPARTMENT = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.student_year_rank, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC) SELECT gmd.SCHOOL_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avb.avg_budget, avb.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS gmd JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget AS avb ON gmd.SCHOOL_NAME = avb.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY gmd.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptAvgBudget AS (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry') AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptRanked AS (SELECT dab.SCHOOL_NAME, dab.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dab.dept_avg_budget, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dab.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dab.dept_avg_budget DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptAvgBudget AS dab) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, icte.avg_budget, icte.budget_variance, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department, dr.dept_avg_budget AS top_department_avg_budget FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN DeptRanked AS dr ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = dr.SCHOOL_NAME AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_stddev, d2.max_enrollment, d2.TERM_START_DATE, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) AS d2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' AND t2.COURSE_NUMBER = '18' AND t2.TERM_CODE = (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') AND t2.SUBJECT_ID = d2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY i.enrolled_stddev DESC
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT LSO.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrollment, STDDEV(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT), MathDeptStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS min_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 24)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.subject_count, d.max_enrollment, d.min_enrollment, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS max_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS sum_total_units, 'DeptSubjectStats' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.subject_count, m.max_enrollment, m.min_enrollment, m.enrollment_stddev, m.max_num_enrolled_students, m.sum_total_units, 'MathDeptStats' AS Source FROM MathDeptStats AS m) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, subject_count, max_enrollment, min_enrollment, enrollment_stddev, max_num_enrolled_students, sum_total_units, Source FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN > 10), DeptAvgStdEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY DeptAvgStdEnrolled AS dase ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dase.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.stddev_enrolled_students,
