WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), DeptTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, NULL AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, d.total_subjects FROM DeptTotals AS d ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentCourseCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, COUNT(*) AS course_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses FROM DepartmentCourseCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.FLOOR, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), avg_access AS (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY FLOOR) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_access AS a ON i.FLOOR = a.FLOOR WHERE i.ACCESS_LEVEL > a.avg_access
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS i2 ON i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled ORDER BY i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS earliest_material_key, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS latest_material_key FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, activity_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, activity_title, material_count, earliest_material_key, latest_material_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_DESCRIPTION) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(earliest_material_key) AS earliest_material_key, MAX(latest_material_key) AS latest_material_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, activity_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN ds.avg_total_units > os.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ds.avg_total_units < os.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS avg_total_units_category FROM dept_stats AS ds CROSS JOIN overall_stats AS os ORDER BY ds.total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_academic_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count > (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count < (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS record_count_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg FROM TIME_QUARTER AS t0 JOIN TIME_MONTH AS t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.FY_QUARTER_CODE, inner_cte.QUARTER_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_YEAR, inner_cte.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, inner_cte.window_avg, CASE WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH > inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH < inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AT_AVERAGE' END AS month_vs_window FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'H%'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, SPACE_USAGE, floor_count, total_room_counter FROM inner_cte WHERE total_room_counter > (SELECT AVG(total_room_counter) FROM (SELECT SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY) AS sub)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE = subj_count.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), subject_code_avg AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subject_code_avg AS a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), RollupResults AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subject_codes, min_dept_budget_code FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.code_range, ic.code_variance, ic.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.code_range, ic.code_variance, ic.DLC_NAME ORDER BY ic.code_range DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TERM_PARAMETER, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS year_range, VARIANCE(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS year_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year, MIN(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE GROUP BY TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT TERM_PARAMETER, year_range, year_variance, CASE WHEN max_year - min_year >= 5 THEN 'EXPANDED' WHEN max_year - min_year <= -5 THEN 'CONTRACTED' ELSE 'STABLE' END AS year_status FROM inner_cte ORDER BY year_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, cc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_with_max_units, cc.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cc.TOTAL_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c2 WHERE c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND NOT c2.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) ORDER BY ic.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, t1.BUILDING_USE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE') SELECT BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, AVG(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL ORDER BY BUILDING_USE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, s.COURSE_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, ata.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_organizations FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME) SELECT DLC_NAME, num_organizations, avg_org_level, org_level_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DLC_NAME, SUM(num_organizations) AS num_organizations, AVG(avg_org_level) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(avg_org_level) AS org_level_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_active_grad_students) AS highest_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance, SUM(SSU.SQFT) AS total_sqft, SUM(SSU.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS SU ON inner_cte.department_name = SU.SPACE_UNIT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS SSU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SSU.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.supervisee_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), SchoolSubjectCounts AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' THEN 'Engineering' ELSE 'Other' END AS school_type, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' THEN 'Engineering' ELSE 'Other' END) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, school_type, subject_code_count FROM SchoolSubjectCounts UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS school_type, SUM(subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count FROM SchoolSubjectCounts GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, school_type
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, avg_floor FROM inner_cte WHERE FLOOR > avg_floor
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM (SELECT AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS yearly) AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) AS max_level3_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON ic.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO'))
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students > overall.avg_all_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students < overall.avg_all_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrolled FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.avg_enrolled, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s2 WHERE s2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS > 1)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units < a.avg_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_counts AS a ON 1 = 1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, a.avg_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CLUSTER_TYPE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT SUBJECT_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME, b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, i.avg_room_area, i.room_area_range, i.room_area_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON i.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY i.room_area_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_variance AS department_units_variance, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS > d.total_units_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS < d.total_units_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS o ON c.COURSE = o.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN inner_cte AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE o.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS num_unique_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, inner_cte.reserve_count, avg_stats.avg_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count > avg_stats.avg_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count < avg_stats.avg_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS status_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(reserve_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.reserve_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_non_current_term_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON td.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON lso.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.math_non_current_term_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td2 ON td2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance > (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance < (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume FROM inner_cte GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_KEY) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_enrollment, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS soss ON sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = soss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE soss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog') SELECT CLUSTER_TYPE, CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY CLUSTER_TYPE, CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ASSIGNABLE_AREA > (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150) SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, d.TERM_CODE, COUNT(d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_material_count, MIN(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS min_record_counter FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, d.TERM_CODE) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TERM_CODE, reserve_material_count, min_record_counter FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_material_count) AS reserve_material_count, MIN(min_record_counter) AS min_record_counter FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.units_range >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.units_range <= 2 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(major_use_desc) OVER (ORDER BY major_use_sort, org_sort) = major_use_desc THEN NULL ELSE major_use_desc END AS major_use_desc, organization_name, min_area, total_rooms FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MAJOR_USE_DESC) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MAJOR_USE_DESC END AS major_use_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MAJOR_USE_DESC) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MAJOR_USE_DESC) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MAJOR_USE_DESC END AS major_use_desc, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MAJOR_USE_DESC) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, MIN(min_area) AS min_area, SUM(total_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY major_use_sort, org_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, 'Grand Total') AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), org_avg_area AS (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_avg_area AS a ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND r.AREA > a.avg_area
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, MAX(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) - MIN(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ROOMS.AREA IS NULL AND NOT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, SUM(FCLT_FLOOR.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ON FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_range > (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
