WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), dept_benchmark AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS benchmark FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(i.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY i.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACCESS' WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACCESS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS access_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_benchmark AS d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE), enrollment_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > e.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < e.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN enrollment_benchmark AS e
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.dept_code_stddev, AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_code, CASE WHEN i.dept_code_stddev > AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.dept_code_stddev < AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY i.dept_code_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY num_unique_subjects DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION SEPARATOR ',') AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON AS sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY), avg_var AS (SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var AS a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300) SELECT CITY, MAX(AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY CITY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_organizations FROM inner_cte WHERE total_organizations > (SELECT AVG(total_organizations) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, su_counts.total_space_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS su_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = su_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.code_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_with_more_than_10_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, s_max.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, s_max.max_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 5) AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment) AS s_max ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s_max.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.avg_enrolled_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.TERM_CODE >= '2011' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND TERM_CODE >= '2011') ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT, i.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.enrolled_students_variance > a.avg_variance ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012), dept_stats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, d.total_subjects, d.avg_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'POPULAR' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'UNPOPULAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS popularity_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), dept_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 10000 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.num_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, CASE WHEN ic.num_rooms > 50 THEN 'LARGE_BUILDING' WHEN ic.num_rooms < 10 THEN 'SMALL_BUILDING' ELSE 'MEDIUM_BUILDING' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.num_rooms

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_group FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.dept_group = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ORDER BY org_count_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') AS dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM (SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') AS all_courses)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_org_unit_id, icte.org_unit_id_variance, dept_stats.Most_Common_HR_Department, dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND NOT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT AND dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count = (SELECT MAX(sub_dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count) FROM (SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo2 ON su2.DLC_KEY = fo2.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou2 ON fo2.DLC_KEY = hou2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND NOT hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub_dept_stats WHERE sub_dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT) ORDER BY icte.org_unit_id_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrollment) AS highest_term_enrollment, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_sort, DLC_NAME) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, org_number_stddev, org_count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 OR GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1) AS tbl ORDER BY dlc_sort, DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area') SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Departments FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS Total_Departments FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' GROUP BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME) AS dept_counts ON dept_counts.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area'

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_totals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_totals AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM dept_totals)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(material_count_range) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count_variance) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count_stddev) AS material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(material_count_range) IS NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT), RoomCategory AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count, CASE WHEN room_count > 5 THEN 'Many Rooms' ELSE 'Few Rooms' END AS room_category FROM inner_cte) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_category, SUM(room_count) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCategory GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, room_category WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(room_count) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT, room_category
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, i.geometric_mean FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY i.geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t2.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t2.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY AS t2 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t2.CALENDAR_DATE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC), avg_rooms AS (SELECT AVG(total_rooms) AS avg_total_rooms FROM (SELECT COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS t) SELECT cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, cte.min_area, cte.total_rooms, CASE WHEN cte.total_rooms > a.avg_total_rooms THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.total_rooms < a.avg_total_rooms THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_count_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN avg_rooms AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT) SELECT ic.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ic.min_square_footage, ic.total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, SUM(fo.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS sum_org_id, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORG_PARENT = 'EXECVP' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.min_org_number, inner_cte.sum_org_id, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.min_org_number, inner_cte.sum_org_id
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, avg_org_unit_id, org_unit_id_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_unit_id > (SELECT AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL) ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, su.SPACE_UNIT AS max_space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS max_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su1.SPACE_UNIT, su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su1 JOIN (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS max_code FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS su2 ON su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su2.max_code) AS su ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.total_activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS term_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = term_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.dept_name = RoomCounts.dept_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS max_geom_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS max_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.geometric_mean_record_count = max_cte.max_geom_mean ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area') SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT o.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_avg, CASE WHEN i.org_number_stddev > AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_number_stddev < AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o JOIN inner_cte AS i ON o.DLC_NAME = i.DLC_NAME WHERE NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev ORDER BY i.org_number_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records, lrmd.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.min_material_status, i.total_records, lrmd.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON i.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON f.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.org_number_variance, avg_stats.avg_org_number, CASE WHEN i.org_number_variance > stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_number_variance < stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON f.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) AS avg_stats ON i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = avg_stats.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(org_number_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS stats ORDER BY i.org_number_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY icte.window_column DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC, SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte) AS o ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC
