WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), RollupResults AS (SELECT dlc_name, org_dlc_key, SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) AS total_min_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dlc_name, org_dlc_key WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) > 0) SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.organization_name, rr.dlc_name, rr.org_dlc_key, rr.total_min_space_unit_code FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON rr.dlc_name = ic.dlc_name AND rr.org_dlc_key = ic.org_dlc_key ORDER BY rr.dlc_name, rr.org_dlc_key
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years, td.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, status_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, material_status, min_record_count, total_academic_years, subject_count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY END AS status_sort, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS material_status, MIN(min_record_count) AS min_record_count, SUM(total_academic_years) AS total_academic_years, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY term_sort, status_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT SUBJECT_DEPT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_DEPT) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.GRADE_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.SUBJECT_DEPT = d.SUBJECT_DEPT WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_cip_code) AS highest_avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) = DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS major_use_description, BUILDING_ROOM, AREA, ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), dept_counts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE), term_avgs AS (SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(dept_subject_count) AS avg_subjects_per_dept FROM dept_counts GROUP BY TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.window_column, CASE WHEN d.dept_subject_count > t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.dept_subject_count < t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_subjects_status FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_counts AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE JOIN term_avgs AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.org_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), DepartmentSchoolStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSchoolStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS current_num_rooms, VARIANCE(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, STDDEV(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_stddev, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE f.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.current_num_rooms, i.num_rooms_variance, i.num_rooms_stddev, i.avg_hist_num_rooms, CASE WHEN i.current_num_rooms > i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.current_num_rooms < i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.avg_org_key FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME WHERE i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > d.avg_org_key ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NULL ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_depts JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1) AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > (SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC, total_library_subjects_offered DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t2.TERM_END_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, d.dept_subject_count, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Active_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so_stats.Subject_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_year = so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_year := so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS so_stats CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_year := 0) AS vars ORDER BY so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so_stats.Subject_Count DESC) AS dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY), avg_sqft AS (SELECT FLOOR_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_NAME) SELECT i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER, i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_sqft AS a ON i.FLOOR_NAME = a.FLOOR_NAME WHERE i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > a.avg_sqft ORDER BY i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.total_units) - MIN(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count, MIN(min_term_start_date) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, t0.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, t0.IS_PUBLIC, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, MIN(t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS min_mit_id FROM MOIRA_LIST AS t0 JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = t1.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE t0.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND t0.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(list_key) OVER (ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort) = list_key THEN NULL ELSE list_key END AS list_key, list_name, is_public, member_full_name, member_mit_id, last_update_date, min_mit_id FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_NAME END AS list_name_sort, MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name, MAX(IS_PUBLIC) AS is_public, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS member_full_name, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_mit_id, MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS last_update_date, MIN(min_mit_id) AS min_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year >= 2010 THEN 'RECENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year < 1980 THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, fo.DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.window_column, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) AS ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, CASE WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(var_space_unit_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.stddev_total_units DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.record_count_variance, (t.max_record_count - t.min_record_count) AS record_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_record_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS t ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY i.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives') SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(running_enrollment_sum) AS max_running_enrollment_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ss2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS ss2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT MAJOR_ORG, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records, MIN(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_load_date FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT min_material_status, total_records, earliest_load_date FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS m ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2009JA')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic.isbn_count, ic.min_faculty_mit_id, stc.Most_Common_Subject_Title, stc.Subject_Title_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Common_Subject_Title, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Title_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS stc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = stc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = stc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 WHERE l2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3) DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) AS s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER
