WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), RoomCounts AS (SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts AS rc ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150), RoomCounts AS (SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT), RollupResults AS (SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, total_rooms FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - window_column) AS deviation_from_min FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.AREA AS room_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS f ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.window_column, y.total_materials_per_year FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_materials_per_year FROM (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > (SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL) ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, num_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE num_reserve_materials > (SELECT AVG(num_reserve_materials) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS total_degree_years FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS min_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), avg_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT cte.SUBJECT_ID, cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN avg_units AS a ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, iap.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), DeptCounts AS (SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE), TopDept AS (SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subj_in_dept, icte.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE) SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.dept_count, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department FROM DeptCounts AS d LEFT JOIN TopDept AS t ON d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = t.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.rn = 1 ORDER BY d.dept_count DESC, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_tip_subjects) AS total_tip_subjects, MAX(total_library_enrollment) AS max_total_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(SPACE_UNIT) LIKE 'A%' AND room_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), SchoolTotals AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals AS s ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_UNITS' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE_UNITS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNITS' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), DeptAvg AS (SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS dept_avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE HAVING AVG(AREA) > 400) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_avg_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptAvg AS da ON ic.DEPT_CODE = da.DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td2 ON lso2.SUBJECT_ID = td2.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON td2.SUBJECT_ID = sos2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, AVG(t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, MAX(avg_num_of_rooms) AS max_avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME), dept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN dept_avg AS d
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column, DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department, student_count, avg_budget_code, school_name, department_phone_number FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department, COUNT(*) AS student_count, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code, MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name, MAX(DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS department_phone_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, total_active_grad_students, avg_office_phone FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, AVG(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE OFFICE_PHONE END) AS avg_office_phone FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m JOIN SE_PERSON AS s ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_isbn, (SELECT MAX(subject_count) FROM inner_cte) AS max_subject_count_over_all FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, COUNT(DISTINCT LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS unique_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS AT ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AT.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND AT.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS LRM ON LRM.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE AND LRM.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, school_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, school_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), isbn_counts AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_with_isbn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND NOT TIP_DETAIL.ISBN IS NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn FROM inner_cte JOIN isbn_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = isbn_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn >= 0.5 * inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_counts.num_subjects, ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_enroll JOIN (SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll) AS top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(s.FROM_TERM) AS latest_start_term, MAX(c.VERSION) AS highest_program_version FROM CIP AS c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE) SELECT ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.latest_start_term, ic.highest_program_version, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_active_department, dept_stats.course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS course_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM CIP AS c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ic.CATEGORY_TITLE = dept_stats.CATEGORY_TITLE AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS library_num_enrolled, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS tip_num_enrolled, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrd.TERM_CODE AS reserve_term_code FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, status, subject_count, avg_library_enrolled, reserve_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY END AS status_sort, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, AVG(library_num_enrolled) AS avg_library_enrolled, MIN(reserve_term_code) AS reserve_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key, MAX(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS max_org_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.DLC_CODE) AS unique_lvl3_dlc_codes FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m2 ON m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE = m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE AND m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY avg_org_key DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t0.IS_CANCELLED, t0.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'Y' ORDER BY ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, avg_room_sqft, stddev_room_sqft FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_room_sqft BETWEEN 100 AND 300 AND stddev_room_sqft > 50 ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER') SELECT sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count, MIN(d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS earliest_update FROM MOIRA_LIST AS m JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST HAVING COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1) SELECT inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, inner_cte.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, inner_cte.member_count, inner_cte.earliest_update, ml.IS_PUBLIC FROM inner_cte JOIN MOIRA_LIST AS ml ON inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, o.overall_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.avg_enrollment > o.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.avg_enrollment < o.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN overall_avg AS o ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = o.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, inner_cte.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, min_area, total_rooms FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.geometric_mean_total_units, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dmc.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dmc JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS dmax ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dmax.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dmc.Subject_Count = dmax.Max_Subject_Count JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_total_units DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ic.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, dept_stats.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count ORDER BY units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS provost_area_facility_orgs, m.DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.provost_area_facility_orgs FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN inner_cte ON m.DLC_NAME = inner_cte.DLC_NAME WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.avg_cip_code DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5), dept_avg AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.TERM_START_DATE, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.max_enrollment > d.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.max_enrollment < d.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS term_record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MAX(term_record_count_variance) AS highest_term_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY highest_term_record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.subject_count > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrollment * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, enrollment_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t2.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, CALENDAR_DATE, window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP'), avg_hist AS (SELECT t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY, AVG(t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 GROUP BY t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME, i.FISCAL_PERIOD, i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, (i.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - a.avg_assignable_area) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_hist AS a ON i.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = a.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS max_level3_code FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON i.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 3 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.section_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled, AVG(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS avg_lab_units FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.section_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS unique_dept_names FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY dept_code_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_FLOOR.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ON FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.assignable_area_stddev, COUNT(FCLT_FLOOR.FLOOR) AS total_floors FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ON FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.assignable_area_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.assignable_area_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.LECTURE_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, t1.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_subject_count) - MIN(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) AS tsc ON at.TERM_CODE = tsc.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count_range, ic.subject_count_variance, ic.subject_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(subject_count_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ic.subject_count_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.AREA DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ta.TERM_START_DATE, ta.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ta ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ta.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR, TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_CODE, TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH FROM TIME_QUARTER JOIN TIME_MONTH ON TIME_QUARTER.FISCAL_YEAR = TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE TIME_MONTH.CALENDAR_MONTH > 0), avg_months AS (SELECT FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE, AVG(CALENDAR_MONTH) AS avg_calendar_month FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FISCAL_YEAR, FY_QUARTER_CODE) SELECT i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(i.CALENDAR_MONTH))) AS geometric_mean_calendar_month FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_months AS a ON i.FISCAL_YEAR = a.FISCAL_YEAR AND i.FY_QUARTER_CODE = a.FY_QUARTER_CODE WHERE i.CALENDAR_MONTH > a.avg_calendar_month GROUP BY i.FISCAL_YEAR, i.FY_QUARTER_CODE ORDER BY geometric_mean_calendar_month DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), RankedSubjects AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte), DepartmentTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rs.SUBJECT_TITLE, rs.window_column FROM RankedSubjects AS rs UNION ALL SELECT dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dt.SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.total_subjects FROM DepartmentTotals AS dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.total_sqft, (inner_cte.total_sqft - (SELECT AVG(total_sqft) FROM inner_cte)) AS sqft_deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS reserved_material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_totals.total_reserved_materials, dept_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject, dept_subjects.reserved_material_count AS top_subject_reserved_count FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(reserved_material_count) AS total_reserved_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_totals JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, reserved_material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS dept_subjects ON dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_subjects.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dept_subjects.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_totals.total_reserved_materials DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), OrgUnitDetails AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails AS o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_record_count, total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_total_units_variance DESC
