WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE') SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, fo.DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS top_department, ic2.max_enrolled AS top_department_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_enrolled AS max_enrolled FROM (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS ic2 ON ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.max_enrolled HAVING SUM(ic.total_enrolled) > 100

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(icte.total_organizations) AS total_organizations, icte.DLC_KEY AS Most_Represented_DLC, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count FROM (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count, SUM(total_organizations) AS total_organizations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY) AS icte JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM HR_ORG_UNIT) AS dlc ON icte.DLC_KEY = dlc.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(DLC_Org_Count) AS max_count FROM (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY) AS sub GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS max_dlc ON icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_dlc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DLC_Org_Count = max_dlc.max_count GROUP BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count ORDER BY total_organizations DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled - (SELECT AVG(avg_enrolled) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(TIME_DAY.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS calendar_year_variance FROM TIME_MONTH JOIN TIME_DAY ON TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD = TIME_DAY.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL GROUP BY TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD, inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.calendar_year_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(calendar_year_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.calendar_year_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_subject_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_range, VARIANCE(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_variance, STDDEV(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aa ON a.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON at.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev ORDER BY ic.academic_year_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units_overall) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_overall FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) AS overall ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE), term_avg AS (SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(material_count) AS avg_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.material_count, CASE WHEN i.material_count > t.avg_material_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL' WHEN i.material_count < t.avg_material_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS material_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN term_avg AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.material_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_room_area, ic.room_area_range, ic.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.room_area_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units, MAX(su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS most_recent_load_date FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND NOT lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY highest_avg_enrolled_per_term DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.DAY_OF_WEEK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_variance, br.BUILDING_ROOM AS Largest_Building, br.Total_Building_Area FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM, SUM(r.AREA) AS Total_Building_Area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM) AS br ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = br.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND br.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), EnrollmentGroup AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, CASE WHEN total_enrollment >= 100 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_group FROM inner_cte), RollupResults AS (SELECT enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM EnrollmentGroup GROUP BY enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrollment) > 0) SELECT rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.subject_count, rr.total_enrollment FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price > 200 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price < 50 THEN 'CHEAP' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS price_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY total_activities DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_assignable) > 0 ORDER BY dept_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(s.FROM_TERM) AS latest_start_term, MAX(c.VERSION) AS highest_program_version FROM CIP AS c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE) SELECT i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.latest_start_term, i.highest_program_version, s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN CIP AS c ON i.CATEGORY_TITLE = c.CATEGORY_TITLE AND i.highest_program_version = c.VERSION JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AND s.FROM_TERM = i.latest_start_term WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) AS rnk FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rnk = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_range, inner_cte.budget_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_budget > (SELECT AVG(avg_budget) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.room_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(room_count) AS avg_room_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) AS sub) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.room_count > a.avg_room_count
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT DESCRIPTION, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND ASSIGNABLE = 1)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_unique_school_names FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL) SELECT inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_unique_school_names FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 ON scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON scd2.COURSE = ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE AND NOT ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.geometric_mean, avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ic.geometric_mean < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.8 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inner_cte AS ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub)) AS dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN (SELECT org_parent FROM (SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte AS ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_parents) ORDER BY ic.ORG_PARENT, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), DepartmentHassCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_electives FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, num_hass_electives FROM DepartmentHassCounts ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments_with_big_courses, MAX(ic.max_total_units) AS max_total_units_in_school FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.max_total_units > 9 GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) >= 2

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, (inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance - avg_variance.avg_max_enrollment_variance) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(max_enrollment_variance) AS avg_max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_variance ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_office_phone > inner_cte.avg_office_phone * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_office_phone < inner_cte.avg_office_phone * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subject_offered_key) OVER (ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort) = subject_offered_key THEN NULL ELSE subject_offered_key END AS subject_offered_key, subject_id, material_count, total_new_shelf_price, avg_used_shelf_price FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS subject_id_sort, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort
