WITH DeptEng2021Stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.subject_count, d1.total_enrollment, d2.enrolled_students_variance, d2.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptEng2021Stats AS d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.subject_count DESC, d2.enrolled_students_variance DESC
WITH OrgWindowRows AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), OrgAvgKey AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, owr.DESCRIPTION, owr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, owr.window_column AS org_window_row, oak.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS avg_hr_org_unit_title, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oak.window_column AS avg_org_key FROM OrgWindowRows AS owr JOIN OrgAvgKey AS oak ON owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oak.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY
WITH RecordCountStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountStats AS rcs JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subquery2 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, sq1.window_column, sq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sq2.reserved_materials FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON sq1.SUBJECT_ID = sq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sq1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), LibSubjStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits AS a LEFT JOIN LibSubjStats AS l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH department_enrollment_variance AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), admin_department_total_enrollment AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dev.enrolled_students_variance, adte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adte.total_enrolled FROM department_enrollment_variance AS dev CROSS JOIN admin_department_total_enrollment AS adte
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), DeptYearSubjects AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dys.subject_count, dys.min_start_date, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptYearSubjects AS dys LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), OrganizationStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment AS gmd JOIN OrganizationStats AS os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC
WITH org_dlc_stats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC), room_area_stats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, ods.org_count_range, ods.org_count_variance, ods.org_count_stddev FROM room_area_stats AS ras LEFT JOIN org_dlc_stats AS ods ON ras.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH dept_hierarchy_org_levels AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC), dept_room_area_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance FROM dept_hierarchy_org_levels AS dhol JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON dhol.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN dept_room_area_stats AS dras ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME GROUP BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance ORDER BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dras.area_range DESC
WITH harvard_cross_enrollment_top10 AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON so.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), department_units_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT hce.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, hce.num_subjects, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM harvard_cross_enrollment_top10 AS hce JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON hce.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptAgg AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, m.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.DLC_KEY), SpaceAgg AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column FROM DeptAgg AS d JOIN SpaceAgg AS s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY
WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomStats AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_min_access FROM OrgStats AS o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN RoomStats AS r ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY material_count DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptSubjects AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), BuildingStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SUBJECT_CODE, ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ds.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM DeptSubjects AS ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats AS bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH AcademicTermWindows AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT atw.TERM_CODE, atw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atw.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM AcademicTermWindows AS atw JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, NULL AS window_column, '2025FA Subjects' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.window_column, 'Engineering 6+ Units' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_start_date FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), Fall2024Subjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT fus.SUBJECT_ID, fus.SUBJECT_TITLE, fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fus.SCHOOL_NAME, fus.TOTAL_UNITS, fus.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fus.TERM_START_DATE, fus.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM Fall2024Subjects AS fus LEFT JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fus.SUBJECT_ID
WITH room_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC), space_unit_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC) SELECT rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.area_range, rs.area_variance, sus.code_range, sus.code_variance FROM room_stats AS rs LEFT JOIN space_unit_stats AS sus ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY rs.area_range DESC LIMIT 10
WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_ID, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS MAJOR_USE, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS min_area_per_major_use, 'OrgLevel5' AS Source FROM OrgLevel5 AS o UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_ID, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, NULL AS window_column, l.BUILDING_ROOM, l.FLOOR, l.ROOM, l.SPACE_ID, l.AREA, l.MAJOR_USE, l.DESCRIPTION AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, l.min_area_per_major_use, 'LargeRooms' AS Source FROM LargeRooms AS l) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAJOR_USE
WITH course_windowed AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), subject_dense_ranked AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT cw.course_number, cw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cw.SUBJECT_TITLE, cw.TOTAL_UNITS, cw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cw.window_column AS course_row_number, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank FROM course_windowed AS cw LEFT JOIN subject_dense_ranked AS sdr ON cw.SUBJECT_TITLE = sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cw.course_number
WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS gmmps JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC, astu.stddev_total_units DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS SUBJECT_KEY, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, s1.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH CurrentTermSubjects AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), AcademicYearTipStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC), CombinedAcademicStats AS (SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_record_count, ays.record_count_range, ays.record_count_variance FROM CurrentTermSubjects AS cts JOIN AcademicYearTipStats AS ays ON cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, total_enrollment, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_record_count, record_count_range, record_count_variance FROM CombinedAcademicStats ORDER BY TERM_CODE
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), TopReservedSubjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.reserved_materials, ROUND(t.reserved_materials / NULLIF(a.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS reserved_per_avg_unit FROM AvgVarUnits AS a JOIN TopReservedSubjects AS t ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_per_avg_unit DESC
WITH SpaceUnitOrgDenseRank AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC) SELECT sstats.SPACE_UNIT, sstats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sstats.org_number_variance, sstats.org_number_stddev, sdr.window_column FROM SpaceUnitOrgStats AS sstats JOIN SpaceUnitOrgDenseRank AS sdr ON sstats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sdr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY sstats.org_number_variance DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH dept_course_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.total_enrolled FROM dept_course_stats AS dcs JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column
WITH AcademicYearGeometricMean AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AcademicYearEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, agm.geometric_mean_total_units, aes.enrolled_range, aes.enrolled_variance FROM AcademicYearGeometricMean AS agm JOIN AcademicYearEnrolledStats AS aes ON agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY agm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, aes.enrolled_range DESC
WITH subject_lecture_units AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), top_departments_fall AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT slu.SUBJECT_ID, slu.SUBJECT_TITLE, slu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slu.window_column, tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name, tdf.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdf.subject_count FROM subject_lecture_units AS slu JOIN top_departments_fall AS tdf ON slu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY slu.SUBJECT_ID, tdf.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, d1.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, d1.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular_terms, d2.total_units_range AS total_units_range_regular_terms, d2.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_regular_terms FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
