WITH DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev FROM EngDegreeCourses AS e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), EngineeringTipMaterials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentAccessLevels AS (SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC), DepartmentSupervisees AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC) SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance FROM DepartmentAccessLevels AS dal JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN DepartmentSupervisees AS ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name ORDER BY dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC) SELECT o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev FROM OrgLevel5 AS o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS sus ON o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount AS gmr JOIN CoefficientOfVariation AS cov ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), ProvostDepts AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT rs.BUILDING_ROOM, rs.FLOOR, rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DLC_KEY, rs.window_avg_area, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column FROM RoomStats AS rs JOIN ProvostDepts AS pd ON rs.DLC_KEY = pd.DLC_KEY ORDER BY rs.BUILDING_ROOM, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), math_enrollment_row_number AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank AS a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number AS m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH EngCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), TermParams AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C') SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column AS eng_course_dense_rank, tp.TERM_PARAMETER, tp.TERM_CODE, tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tp.window_column AS term_param_running_sum FROM EngCourses AS ec JOIN TermParams AS tp ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tp.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH space_unit_info AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), org_coeff_var AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation FROM space_unit_info AS s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var AS o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
WITH SchoolEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC), DeptSchoolSubjectMaterialStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ses.avg_enrollment, ses.enrollment_stddev, dssms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dssms.subject_count, dssms.min_isbn FROM SchoolEnrollmentStats AS ses JOIN DeptSchoolSubjectMaterialStats AS dssms ON ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = dssms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WHERE ses.avg_enrollment > 5 ORDER BY ses.enrollment_stddev DESC, dssms.subject_count DESC
WITH SubjectOfferedInTerm AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), LibrarySubjectWithReserve AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM SubjectOfferedInTerm AS s JOIN LibrarySubjectWithReserve AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS JOIN_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_cip_code, s2.cip_code_range, s2.cip_code_variance FROM Sub1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.JOIN_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38') SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS access_level_window_row_number, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_area_window FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, en.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, en.enrolled_range, en.enrolled_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects AS es JOIN EnrolledStats AS en ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = en.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE), AccessLevelStats AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC), CombinedStats AS (SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, als.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, als.num_rooms_variance FROM RoomStats AS rs JOIN AccessLevelStats AS als ON rs.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = als.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), OrgDeptCodeVariation AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, odv.coefficient_of_variation FROM SpaceUnitStats AS sus JOIN OrgDeptCodeVariation AS odv ON sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME = odv.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
WITH DeptOrgStats AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgLevel5Details AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column FROM DeptOrgStats AS d JOIN OrgLevel5Details AS o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
WITH record_count_variance_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count FROM record_count_variance_cte AS rcv JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS gmr ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.record_count_variance DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.window_column, sq2.subject_code_count, sq2.min_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sq2.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH TermWindowStats AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.TERM_CODE, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.CALENDAR_DATE, tws.DAY_OF_WEEK, tws.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM TermWindowStats AS tws JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tws.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY tws.TERM_START_DATE
WITH math_courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), yearly_variation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM math_courses AS mc LEFT JOIN yearly_variation AS yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column
WITH RoomAreas AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300), DlcAreaStats AS (SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC) SELECT ra.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.AREA, ra.BUILDING_NUMBER, ra.CITY, ra.window_column, fod.DLC_KEY, das.avg_area, das.area_variance, das.area_stddev FROM RoomAreas AS ra JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fod ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN DlcAreaStats AS das ON fod.DLC_KEY = das.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ra.CITY, ra.window_column
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), subq2 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.offered_subject_count, subq2.min_enrolled_students FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.window_column
WITH DeptStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), SubjectEnroll AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnroll AS s JOIN DeptStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC
WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM MathCourses AS m JOIN PreviousTerms AS p ON m.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, TERM_START_DATE
WITH DeptUnitsRangeVariance2022 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), DeptAvgVarianceNonNullUnits AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.units_range, d1.units_variance AS units_range_variance_2022, d2.avg_units, d2.units_variance AS avg_units_variance_all FROM DeptUnitsRangeVariance2022 AS d1 JOIN DeptAvgVarianceNonNullUnits AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.units_range DESC
WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS lrm JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
WITH OrgAccessStats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), RoomDetails AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT rd.BUILDING_ROOM, rd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rd.FLOOR, rd.SPACE_USAGE, rd.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.window_column, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev FROM RoomDetails AS rd JOIN OrgAccessStats AS oas ON rd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = oas.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH MaterialStatsPerYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), TopYearsByUniqueMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, t.unique_materials FROM MaterialStatsPerYear AS m JOIN TopYearsByUniqueMaterials AS t ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY t.unique_materials DESC, m.material_count_range DESC
WITH DLCMechOrgs AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE'), AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedOrgs AS (SELECT d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, 'DLC_MECHE' AS Reason FROM DLCMechOrgs AS d UNION ALL SELECT a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS window_column, a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.hr_org_unit_count, a.total_department_id, 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' AS Reason FROM AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS a) SELECT * FROM CombinedOrgs ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, Reason
WITH TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), EnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.avg_record_count, tms.record_count_variance, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms JOIN EnrollmentStats AS es ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tms.record_count_variance DESC, es.enrollment_variance DESC
WITH EnrolledStudentsVariance AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), TotalUnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT esv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tuv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tuv.total_units_variance, esv.enrolled_students_variance FROM EnrolledStudentsVariance AS esv JOIN TotalUnitsVariance AS tuv ON esv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tuv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tuv.total_units_variance DESC
WITH dept_units_2022_cis AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), dept_units_regular_terms AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.units_range, d1.units_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM dept_units_2022_cis AS d1 JOIN dept_units_regular_terms AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.units_range DESC
WITH subject_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), department_enrollment_variance AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ses.subject_count, ses.min_total_units, dev.num_enrolled_variance, dev.num_enrolled_stddev FROM subject_enrollment_stats AS ses JOIN department_enrollment_variance AS dev ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.department
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER
WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.ISBN, lrm.SUBJECT_TITLE, lrm.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS lrm LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance AS srv ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Sub2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM Sub1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC), space_unit_402100 AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 AS s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees AS o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptEnrolledStats_Grad AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptEnrolledStats_SubjCode AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, s.enrolled_students_variance, s.enrolled_students_stddev, ROUND(g.enrolled_range / NULLIF(s.enrolled_students_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_range_by_stddev, ROUND(g.enrolled_variance / NULLIF(s.enrolled_students_variance, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance_ratio FROM DeptEnrolledStats_Grad AS g JOIN DeptEnrolledStats_SubjCode AS s ON g.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_range_by_stddev DESC
WITH Subjects2006FA AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subjects2016SP12Units AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s06.SUBJECT_TITLE, s06.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s06.TOTAL_UNITS, s06.window_column AS window_column_2006FA, s16.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2016SP, s16.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME_2016SP, s16.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, s16.window_column AS window_column_2016SP FROM Subjects2006FA AS s06 JOIN Subjects2016SP12Units AS s16 ON s06.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s16.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s06.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s06.SUBJECT_TITLE, s16.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), ActiveGradStudentsByDept AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, m.DEPARTMENT FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment, ags.total_active_grad_students FROM DeptSubjectEnrollment AS dse JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudentsByDept AS ags ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ags.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.avg_area, r.area_variance, r.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM RoomAreaStats AS r JOIN EngineeringCourses AS e ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY r.area_variance DESC, e.window_column
WITH SubjectStats2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), DeptMaxEnrollmentCurrentTerm AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, d.max_enrollment, d.TERM_START_DATE FROM SubjectStats2014FA AS s JOIN DeptMaxEnrollmentCurrentTerm AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH AreaRooms AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_TYPE, MIN(t1.FLOOR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 400), E_BuildingRooms AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT ar.BUILDING_ROOM, ar.FLOOR, ar.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ar.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ar.BUILDING_NAME, ar.BUILDING_TYPE, ar.window_column AS area_window_min_floor, NULL AS FCLT_ROOM_KEY, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS dlc_window_min_area, 'AreaRooms' AS Source FROM AreaRooms AS ar UNION ALL SELECT eb.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, eb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE, NULL AS area_window_min_floor, eb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, eb.AREA, eb.DEPT_CODE, eb.DLC_KEY, eb.window_column AS dlc_window_min_area, 'E_BuildingRooms' AS Source FROM E_BuildingRooms AS eb) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, area_window_min_floor, FCLT_ROOM_KEY, AREA, DEPT_CODE, DLC_KEY, dlc_window_min_area, Source FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM

WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 AS d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ORDER BY d2022.units_range DESC
WITH top_subjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), dept_enroll_stddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.enrolled_stddev FROM top_subjects AS ts LEFT JOIN dept_enroll_stddev AS des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.material_count DESC, des.enrolled_stddev DESC LIMIT 10
WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsRowNumber AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber AS mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.enrolled_students_variance, s2.enrolled_students_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subquery2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.window_column, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.subject_count, subq2.min_isbn FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.join_department_code
WITH MaterialStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sc.subject_count, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev, ROUND(sc.subject_count / NULLIF(ms.material_count_range, 0), 2) AS subject_count_to_material_range_ratio FROM SubjectCounts AS sc JOIN MaterialStats AS ms ON sc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_to_material_range_ratio DESC
WITH DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), SubjectSummary AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.window_column FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN SubjectSummary AS ss ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.window_column
WITH ProvostDepartments AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), LargeSpaceUnits AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT lsu.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, lsu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, lsu.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, lsu.window_column AS space_unit_sum_within_load_date, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area FROM LargeSpaceUnits AS lsu JOIN ProvostDepartments AS pd ON lsu.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column, lsu.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH subject_ranks AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), top_departments AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sr.window_column, td.subject_count FROM subject_ranks AS sr JOIN top_departments AS td ON sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS subject_rank, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, Source
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY), Sub2 AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000), Combined AS (SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.space_unit_count, s1.min_org_number, s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY AND s1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = s2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS srs ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ts.num_reserve_materials DESC, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count FROM RecordCountVariance AS rcv JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS gmr ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC
WITH LibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC), TermSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.TOTAL_UNITS, ts.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev FROM TermSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN LibraryStats AS ls ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH SubjectsIn2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectsIn2025FA AS s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID
WITH TipDetailWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), TopIAPActivities AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tdw.SUBJECT_ID, tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tdw.TERM_START_DATE, tdw.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tdw.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM TipDetailWindow AS tdw JOIN TopIAPActivities AS tia ON tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY tdw.SUBJECT_ID, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH Subjects2012 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012), HarvardSummer2012 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s2012.SUBJECT_KEY, s2012.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2012.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2012.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2012.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2012.window_column, hce2012.offering_count, hce2012.total_units FROM Subjects2012 AS s2012 JOIN HarvardSummer2012 AS hce2012 ON s2012.SUBJECT_KEY = hce2012.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2012.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2012.SUBJECT_KEY
WITH AdminDeptEnrolled AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), Subjects2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM AdminDeptEnrolled AS ade JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ade.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Subjects2025FA AS s ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID
