WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL), Sub2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), eng_tip_materials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_units_stats AS dus JOIN eng_tip_materials AS etm ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC
WITH HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON so.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), Subjects2012SU AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s.window_column FROM Subjects2012SU AS s WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts) ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_KEY
WITH DeptPhoneStats AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats AS dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH MaterialStats AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price, d.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, d.TERM_CODE), DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, c.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.PUBLISHER, ms.material_count, ms.min_used_price, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance FROM MaterialStats AS ms JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON ms.TERM_CODE = du.TERM_CODE
WITH DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.total_units_range, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS dtu JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtu.total_units_range > 0 AND NOT des.enrolled_students_variance IS NULL ORDER BY dtu.total_units_range DESC
WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), GeomMeanMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, ROUND(a.avg_total_units / NULLIF(g.geometric_mean_record_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_geom_material FROM AvgVarUnits AS a JOIN GeomMeanMaterials AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_geom_material DESC
WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.DLC_KEY), TopProvostDepts AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tpd.DLC_NAME, tpd.org_count, osu.ORGANIZATION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.space_unit_count, osu.min_org_number FROM TopProvostDepts AS tpd JOIN OrgSpaceUnits AS osu ON tpd.DLC_KEY = osu.DLC_KEY ORDER BY tpd.org_count DESC, osu.space_unit_count DESC
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses AS edc JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH space_unit_access_stats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC), space_unit_org_window AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM space_unit_access_stats AS s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window AS s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats AS e LEFT JOIN units_stats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC
WITH DeptClusterStats AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE), DeptUnitStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.CLUSTER_TYPE, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM DeptClusterStats AS dcs JOIN DeptUnitStats AS dus ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.subject_count DESC
WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'LibrarySubject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, s2.window_column, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'IAPActivity' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, Source
WITH material_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), unique_materials_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats AS um LEFT JOIN material_stats AS ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentYearStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, a.enrolled_students_variance, a.enrolled_students_stddev, ROUND(d.subject_count / NULLIF(a.enrolled_students_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_subject_count FROM DepartmentYearStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearStats AS a ON d.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY normalized_subject_count DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS s1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS s2_window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.TERM_CODE
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), TermSubjectOfferings AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.TERM_START_DATE, tso.TERM_END_DATE, tso.TERM_PARAMETER, tso.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TermSubjectOfferings AS tso JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID
WITH term_2025fa_subjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), engineering_subjects_window AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column FROM term_2025fa_subjects AS t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptCatalogKeyStats AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, MAX(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dcks.catalog_key_range, dcks.catalog_key_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DeptCatalogKeyStats AS dcks ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcks.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), eng_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, dv.total_units_variance FROM eng_subjects AS es LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dv.total_units_variance DESC, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC
WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), ProvostDepts AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_avg_area, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS window_column FROM RoomStats AS r UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, p.DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_avg_area, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column FROM ProvostDepts AS p) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DLC_KEY
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name_key FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.dept_name_key = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH iap_activities_windowed AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), iap_activities_dense_ranked AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iaw.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iaw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iaw.SUBJECT_TITLE, iaw.window_column AS activity_row_number, iadr.window_column AS activity_dense_rank FROM iap_activities_windowed AS iaw LEFT JOIN iap_activities_dense_ranked AS iadr ON iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iadr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND iaw.TERM_CODE = iadr.TERM_CODE

WITH AcademicTermWindow AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM'), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT atw.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, atw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, atw.TERM_START_DATE, atw.TERM_END_DATE, atw.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicTermWindow AS atw JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atw.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH DeptEng2021 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), DeptEnrollStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT de21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de21.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de21.subject_count, de21.total_enrollment, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, ROUND(de21.total_enrollment / NULLIF(des.enrolled_students_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_by_stddev FROM DeptEng2021 AS de21 JOIN DeptEnrollStats AS des ON de21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY normalized_enrollment_by_stddev DESC

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window_by_dept, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_window_by_subject_code FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH org_room_area_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT r.DEPT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC), org_hr_dept_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.DEPT_CODE, a.area_variance, a.area_stddev, b.avg_dept_code_old, b.var_dept_code_old FROM org_room_area_stats AS a LEFT JOIN org_hr_dept_stats AS b ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = b.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH SubjectTipStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC), SubjectDeptDescWindow AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT sts.SUBJECT_TITLE, sts.record_count_range, sts.record_count_variance, sts.record_count_stddev, sddw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sddw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sddw.window_column FROM SubjectTipStats AS sts JOIN SubjectDeptDescWindow AS sddw ON sts.SUBJECT_TITLE = sddw.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sts.record_count_range DESC, sddw.window_column ASC
WITH OrgHRStats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), RoomDLCStats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.AREA, r.DEPT_CODE, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column FROM OrgHRStats AS o JOIN RoomDLCStats AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DLC_KEY
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), subject_window_info AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT swi.SUBJECT_TITLE, swi.DEPARTMENT_NAME, swi.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, swi.window_column, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM subject_window_info AS swi LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON swi.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH dept_enroll_stats_grad AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM dept_enroll_stats_grad AS g JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc AS d ON g.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY g.enrolled_range DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_start_date, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH dept_summary AS (SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), space_unit_summary AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT ds.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ds.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.org_unit_count, ds.min_department_id, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column FROM dept_summary AS ds JOIN space_unit_summary AS sus ON ds.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), dept_course_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.units_range, dss.units_variance, dcs.total_units_range, dcs.total_units_variance, dcs.total_units_stddev FROM dept_subject_stats AS dss JOIN dept_course_stats AS dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.units_range DESC
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DegreeYearGeomMean AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT EnrolledStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, EnrolledStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EnrolledStats.enrolled_students_variance, EnrolledStats.enrolled_students_stddev, DegreeYearGeomMean.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM EnrolledStats JOIN DegreeYearGeomMean ON EnrolledStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR = DegreeYearGeomMean.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND EnrolledStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = DegreeYearGeomMean.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY EnrolledStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH DepartmentMaterialStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), TopDepartmentsBySubjects AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tds.subject_count, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev FROM TopDepartmentsBySubjects AS tds JOIN DepartmentMaterialStats AS dms ON tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, dms.material_count_range DESC
WITH TopSubjectsByMaterial AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT tsbm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tsbm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tsbm.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjectsByMaterial AS tsbm JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON tsbm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY tsbm.material_count DESC, des.num_enrolled_variance DESC
WITH SubjectLectureSums AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureSums AS s JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT s1.summary_subject_title, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.offered_summary_subject_title, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.window_column AS summary_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_subject_title, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS offered_offer_dept_name, s2.TOTAL_UNITS AS offered_total_units, s2.window_column AS offered_window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgSuperviseeStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM RoomStats AS rs LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats AS os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC
WITH material_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), engineering_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS at_academic_year_desc FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.SCHOOL_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.window_column FROM material_stats AS ms JOIN engineering_subjects AS es ON ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.at_academic_year_desc ORDER BY ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH IAP_Activities_Sessions AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), IAP_Activities_Rank AS (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.SESSION_TITLE, a.SESSION_LOCATION, a.SESSION_DATE, a.SESSION_START_TIME, a.SESSION_END_TIME, a.min_start_time_per_location, r.window_column FROM IAP_Activities_Sessions AS a JOIN IAP_Activities_Rank AS r ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = r.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a.SESSION_LOCATION
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s2.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH SubjectWindowed AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column, de.total_enrollment, ROUND(sw.window_column / NULLIF(de.total_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_window_enrollment FROM SubjectWindowed AS sw JOIN DeptEnrollment AS de ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_window_enrollment DESC
WITH dept_cip_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM dept_cip_stats AS dcs JOIN dept_units_stats AS dus ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH EmployeeDeptStats AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathSubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT eds.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, eds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eds.person_count, eds.min_mit_id, mss.SUBJECT_TITLE, mss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, mss.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, mss.max_total_units FROM EmployeeDeptStats AS eds JOIN MathSubjectStats AS mss ON eds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eds.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, eds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mss.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.TERM_CODE), Sub2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')), Combined AS (SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s1.isbn_count, s1.min_faculty_mit_id, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS window_column, 'Sub1' AS Source FROM Sub1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NULL AS isbn_count, NULL AS min_faculty_mit_id, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column, 'Sub2' AS Source FROM Sub2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, Source
WITH SubjectUnitsWindow AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), CourseTextbookWindow AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.window_column AS textbook_row_number FROM SubjectUnitsWindow AS s JOIN CourseTextbookWindow AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_NUMBER = c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_DESCRIPTION = c.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER
