WITH EngSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6), DeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), Combined AS (SELECT e.SUBJECT_CODE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM EngSubjects AS e JOIN DeptStats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
WITH SubjectsOffered2019FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), SubjectsWithUnits2019FA AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM SubjectsOffered2019FA AS s1 JOIN SubjectsWithUnits2019FA AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearlyVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN YearlyVariation AS yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), eng_tip_materials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM dept_units_stats AS d LEFT JOIN eng_tip_materials AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_variance DESC
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN TermJoin AS tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME
WITH AllActivitiesByCategory AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsActivitiesWithRowNum AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS category_dense_rank, m.window_column AS mathematics_row_number FROM AllActivitiesByCategory AS a JOIN MathematicsActivitiesWithRowNum AS m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), OrganizationStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT gm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gm.geometric_mean FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment AS gm JOIN OrganizationStats AS os ON gm.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gm.geometric_mean DESC
WITH OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC), RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, ods.org_count_range, ods.org_count_variance, ods.org_count_stddev FROM RoomAreaStats AS ras JOIN OrgDlcStats AS ods ON ras.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, d2.subject_count, d2.min_isbn FROM DeptEnrolledStats AS d1 JOIN DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC
WITH course_info AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), building_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT ci.COURSE, ci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ci.SCHOOL_NAME, ci.PROGRAM_CODE, ci.PROGRAM_TITLE, ci.CATEGORY_CODE, ci.CATEGORY_TITLE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ci.min_warehouse_load_date, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM course_info AS ci JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.SUBJECT_CODE = ci.COURSE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE JOIN building_stats AS bs ON bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ci.CATEGORY_CODE, bs.stddev_total_units DESC
WITH LargeRoomsByCity AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300), RoomAreaStatsByDLC AS (SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC) SELECT lr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, lr.BUILDING_ROOM, lr.AREA, lr.BUILDING_NUMBER, lr.CITY, lr.window_column, fod.DLC_KEY, ras.avg_area, ras.area_variance, ras.area_stddev FROM LargeRoomsByCity AS lr JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fod ON lr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN RoomAreaStatsByDLC AS ras ON fod.DLC_KEY = ras.DLC_KEY ORDER BY lr.CITY, lr.AREA DESC
WITH department_catalog_key_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), department_enrolled_stddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT dckv.DEPARTMENT, dckv.catalog_key_variance, desd.enrolled_stddev FROM department_catalog_key_variance AS dckv JOIN department_enrolled_stddev AS desd ON dckv.DEPARTMENT = desd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), hgn_subjects AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, hs.HGN_CODE, hs.max_lecture_units, hs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_enrollment_stats AS des JOIN hgn_subjects AS hs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC, hs.max_lecture_units DESC
WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), RoomAccessLevel1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM BuildingAreaStddev AS bal JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY bal.area_stddev DESC, ral1.FLOOR
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_PARAMETER = s2.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment AS e JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH YearlyTipStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), YearlyTotalMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > (SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS sub)) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats AS yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials AS ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ytm.total_materials DESC
WITH avg_stats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC), eo_materials AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT eo_materials.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eo_materials.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eo_materials.TERM_CODE, eo_materials.SUBJECT_ID, eo_materials.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER, eo_materials.window_column, avg_stats.avg_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.variance_materials_per_subject, avg_stats.stddev_materials_per_subject FROM eo_materials LEFT JOIN avg_stats ON eo_materials.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_stats.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY eo_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eo_materials.window_column
WITH OrgAccessStats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), DeptSpaceStats AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code, ROUND(oas.avg_access_level / NULLIF(dss.avg_space_unit_code, 0), 2) AS access_to_space_ratio FROM OrgAccessStats AS oas JOIN DeptSpaceStats AS dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_to_space_ratio DESC
WITH Subjects2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.window_column FROM Subjects2025FA AS s JOIN EngineeringSubjects AS e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = e.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC
WITH Subjects2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC) SELECT s2025.SUBJECT_ID, s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025.TERM_START_DATE, s2025.TERM_END_DATE, s2025.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, srms.reserved_material_range, srms.reserved_material_variance, srms.reserved_material_stddev FROM Subjects2025FA AS s2025 JOIN SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS srms ON s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE = srms.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s2025.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), DeptMaxUnits AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.units_range, dms.units_variance, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dms JOIN DeptMaxUnits AS dmu ON dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dms.units_range DESC
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_start_date, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON lso.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev FROM EnrolledStats AS e JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS d ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH AcademicYearUnitsVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), AcademicYearLibraryEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC) SELECT ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayuv.total_units_variance, ayls.enrolled_range, ayls.enrolled_variance FROM AcademicYearUnitsVariance AS ayuv JOIN AcademicYearLibraryEnrolledStats AS ayls ON ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ayls.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE ayuv.total_units_variance > 10 AND ayls.enrolled_range > 20 ORDER BY ayuv.total_units_variance DESC
WITH UnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), MaxUnitsSchool AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT us.DEPARTMENT_NAME, us.units_range, us.units_variance, mu.max_total_units, mu.SCHOOL_NAME, ROUND(us.units_range / NULLIF(mu.max_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_range_ratio FROM UnitsStats AS us JOIN MaxUnitsSchool AS mu ON us.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_range_ratio DESC
WITH RoomAreaByCity AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300), DeptOrgStats AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA, r.BUILDING_NUMBER, r.CITY, r.window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM RoomAreaByCity AS r JOIN DeptOrgStats AS d ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, r.CITY, r.AREA DESC
WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS dev ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), LibSubjStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits AS a JOIN LibSubjStats AS l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC
WITH SubjectUnitsStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC), Subjects2012SU AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s1.total_units_stddev FROM Subjects2012SU AS s2 LEFT JOIN SubjectUnitsStddev AS s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_TITLE = s1.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH eng_courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), term_params AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C') SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS ENG_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column AS ENG_DEPT_DENSE_RANK, tp.TERM_PARAMETER, tp.TERM_CODE, tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tp.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERED_DEPARTMENT_NAME, tp.window_column AS DEPT_RUNNING_SUM_ACAD_YEAR FROM eng_courses AS ec JOIN term_params AS tp ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tp.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH FallSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC) SELECT fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.TERM_CODE, fs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.avg_academic_year, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM FallSubjects AS fs JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS des ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN EngineeringDegreeCourses AS edc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, edc.window_column
WITH SubjectLectureUnits AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureUnits AS s JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID
WITH department_max_units AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), eecs_students_courses AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column FROM department_max_units AS dmu JOIN eecs_students_courses AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment AS gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate AS scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngDegreeCourses AS edc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH employee_type_department_g AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_regular_terms AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units FROM employee_type_department_g AS etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms AS msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name
WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance AS duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC
WITH dept_access_stats AS (SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC), space_unit_access_stats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC) SELECT sua.SPACE_UNIT, sua.avg_access_level, sua.access_level_stddev, das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.access_level_range, das.access_level_variance FROM space_unit_access_stats AS sua JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON sua.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON zr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hu ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hu.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN dept_access_stats AS das ON hu.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY sua.SPACE_UNIT, sua.avg_access_level, sua.access_level_stddev, das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.access_level_range, das.access_level_variance ORDER BY sua.access_level_stddev DESC, das.access_level_range DESC LIMIT 10
WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC), DLCOrgStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats AS srs JOIN DLCOrgStddev AS dos ON srs.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), SubjectUnitsWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, suw.SUBJECT_ID, suw.SUBJECT_TITLE, suw.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN SubjectUnitsWindow AS suw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = suw.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.units_range > 5 AND dus.units_variance > 2 ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, suw.SUBJECT_ID
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), Dept6CourseCIP AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT d6c.COURSE, d6c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d6c.SCHOOL_NAME, d6c.PROGRAM_CODE, d6c.PROGRAM_TITLE, d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.CATEGORY_TITLE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, d6c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, d6c.min_warehouse_load_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM Dept6CourseCIP AS d6c LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON d6c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d6c.CATEGORY_CODE, d6c.COURSE
WITH subject_code_ranks AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), building_units_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM subject_code_ranks AS scr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN building_units_stats AS bus ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH OrgHRStats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), RoomDLCStats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.AREA, r.DEPT_CODE, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column FROM OrgHRStats AS o JOIN RoomDLCStats AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DLC_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), IapActivityStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms JOIN IapActivityStats AS ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY tms.record_count_variance DESC
WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, e.course_number, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.course_subject_title, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, e.window_column AS course_row_number FROM SubjectStats AS s JOIN EngineeringCourses AS e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.course_number
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), GradStudentInfo AS (SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, gsi.FULL_NAME, gsi.EMAIL_ADDRESS, gsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, gsi.window_column FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN GradStudentInfo AS gsi ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gsi.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gsi.FULL_NAME
WITH subject_window_enrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'), person_role_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON AS p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.window_column, p.PERSON_ROLE, p.avg_max_enrollment, p.max_enrollment_range, p.max_enrollment_variance FROM subject_window_enrollment AS s CROSS JOIN person_role_enrollment_stats AS p

WITH reserve_materials_window AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), department_subjects_summary AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT rmw.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmw.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, rmw.TERM_CODE, rmw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rmw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rmw.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmw.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmw.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM reserve_materials_window AS rmw JOIN department_subjects_summary AS dss ON rmw.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH TotalLectureUnitsStats AS (SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS t)), LibrarySubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC) SELECT tlu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tlu.total_lecture_units, lses.avg_enrollment, lses.enrollment_variance, lses.enrollment_stddev FROM TotalLectureUnitsStats AS tlu JOIN LibrarySubjectEnrollmentStats AS lses ON tlu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lses.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tlu.total_lecture_units DESC, lses.enrollment_variance DESC

WITH EngineeringDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), FallSubjects AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column AS course_dense_rank, f.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, f.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, f.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f.window_column AS subject_rank FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses AS e JOIN FallSubjects AS f ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WITH top10_activity_materials AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), activity_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC) SELECT t10.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t10.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t10.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev FROM top10_activity_materials AS t10 LEFT JOIN activity_enrollment_stats AS aes ON t10.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH DeptOrgStats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC), Floor2Rooms AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT f2.BUILDING_ROOM, f2.SPACE_USAGE, f2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev, f2.window_column FROM Floor2Rooms AS f2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN DeptOrgStats AS d ON fo.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.DLC_NAME, f2.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), DepartmentUnits2022 AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2017JA AS s JOIN DepartmentUnits2022 AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.total_units_range DESC

WITH TermParamsC AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'), TermParamStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT tpc.TERM_PARAMETER, tpc.TERM_CODE, tpc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tpc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tpc.window_column, tps.total_units_variance, tps.total_units_stddev FROM TermParamsC AS tpc JOIN TermParamStats AS tps ON tpc.TERM_PARAMETER = tps.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY tpc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tpc.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH DeptHierarchyOrgLevelStats AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC), DLCAreaVariation AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT dhols.DLC_NAME, dhols.avg_org_level, dhols.org_level_stddev, dlcav.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptHierarchyOrgLevelStats AS dhols JOIN DLCAreaVariation AS dlcav ON dhols.DLC_KEY = dlcav.DLC_KEY ORDER BY dhols.org_level_stddev DESC, dlcav.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, s2.window_column AS course_row_number FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.course_number
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), SubjectStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, ss.reserved_material_range, ss.reserved_material_variance, ss.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN SubjectStats AS ss ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
