WITH DLC_CV AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), ORG_WINDOW AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT dc.DLC_KEY, dc.DLC_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column FROM DLC_CV AS dc JOIN ORG_WINDOW AS ow ON dc.DLC_KEY = ow.DLC_KEY
WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.subject_count, ss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM SubjectStats AS ss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS dev ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ss.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_by_budget_code, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS row_number_by_course_description FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.COURSE = s2.COURSE ORDER BY s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH Fall2022SubjectStats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3), DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC) SELECT fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fss.max_lecture_units, fss.TERM_START_DATE, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM Fall2022SubjectStats AS fss JOIN DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS dscs ON fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH EngineeringDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentSubjectUnitStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_variance, dsu.total_units_stddev FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses AS edc JOIN DepartmentSubjectUnitStats AS dsu ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH reserve_material_details AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), subject_record_count_variance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC) SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.SUBJECT_ID, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.ISBN, rmd.SUBJECT_TITLE, rmd.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM reserve_material_details AS rmd LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance AS srv ON rmd.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID
WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearDegreeStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_degree_year DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN YearDegreeStats AS yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH SubjectEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA'), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnrolledStats AS ses LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS dlu ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), RoomStats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200), CombinedStats AS (SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_column, 'OrgStats' AS Source FROM OrgStats AS o UNION ALL SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, 'RoomStats' AS Source FROM RoomStats AS r) SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hr_org_unit_count, total_department_id, BUILDING_ROOM, DLC_KEY, window_column, Source FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, Source, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH DepartmentVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s JOIN DepartmentVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), dept_enrollment AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM dept_units_stats AS dus JOIN dept_enrollment AS de ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH record_count_variance_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT v.ACADEMIC_YEAR, v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, v.record_count_variance, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM record_count_variance_per_year AS v JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS g ON v.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY v.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC
WITH org_hr_summary AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY), dept_subdept_stats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT AS h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY) AS sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT m.DLC_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments FROM org_hr_summary AS o JOIN dept_subdept_stats AS d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE
WITH dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), building_units_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM dept_subject_stats AS dss JOIN building_units_stats AS bus ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = bus.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, 'TopSubjects' AS Reason FROM TopSubjects AS ts UNION ALL SELECT s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS material_count, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column, 'Subjects2014FA' AS Reason FROM Subjects2014FA AS s2014) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH lib_subs AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'), tip_subs AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT lib_subs.SUBJECT_ID, lib_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS LIB_SUBJECT_TITLE, lib_subs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lib_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS LIB_TERM_DESCRIPTION, lib_subs.TERM_START_DATE, lib_subs.TERM_END_DATE, lib_subs.min_enrolled_per_dept, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tip_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS TIP_SUBJECT_TITLE, tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tip_subs.window_column FROM lib_subs JOIN tip_subs ON lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC) AS d1 JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) AS d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH dept_enrollments AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10), library_subjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrollments, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.subject_count, l.min_total_units FROM dept_enrollments AS d JOIN library_subjects AS l ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrollments DESC, l.subject_count DESC
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100), Sub2 AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC) SELECT s2.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.org_number_variance, s2.org_number_stddev FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s2.org_number_variance DESC
WITH DeptUnits AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), EECSStudents AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_variance FROM EECSStudents AS eecs LEFT JOIN DeptUnits AS du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column
WITH building_area_stddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC), rooms_access_level_1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT bas.BUILDING_NUMBER, bas.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM building_area_stddev AS bas JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON bas.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN rooms_access_level_1 AS ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH dept_org_stats AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), org_geom_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM dept_org_stats AS d LEFT JOIN org_geom_supervisees AS o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.organization_count DESC, o.geometric_mean_supervisees DESC
WITH department_units_variance AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), offering_dept_subjects AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, ods.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ods.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ods.subject_count, ods.min_isbn FROM department_units_variance AS duv JOIN offering_dept_subjects AS ods ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ods.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH org_windowed AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS'), org_space_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM org_windowed AS ow LEFT JOIN org_space_stats AS oss ON ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ow.window_column
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats AS es JOIN UnitsVariance AS uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC
WITH TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), IapActivityStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms JOIN IapActivityStats AS ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH material_status_stats AS (SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC), subject_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.TERM_CODE, ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ses.TOTAL_UNITS, ses.avg_enrolled_students FROM material_status_stats AS ms JOIN subject_enrollment_stats AS ses ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), material_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(material_count_range) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count_variance) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count_stddev) AS material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(material_count_range) IS NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(inner_cte2.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC) SELECT m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, s.avg_subject_codes, s.stddev_subject_codes FROM material_stats AS m LEFT JOIN subject_code_stats AS s ON m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.activity_count, s1.earliest_start_date, s1.latest_end_date, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s2.window_column
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, Total_Tip_Details.Total_Tip_Details FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS Total_Tip_Details FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Tip_Details ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Tip_Details.ACADEMIC_YEAR), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.Total_Tip_Details, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_DEPT_RANK, s2.Total_Subjects AS DEPT_TOTAL_SUBJECTS FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column AS subq1_dense_rank, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subq2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column AS subq2_dense_rank FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.window_column DESC, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.window_column, subq2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (LENGTH(i.FULL_NAME) - avg_len.avg_full_name_length) AS diff_from_avg_length FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(FULL_NAME)) AS avg_full_name_length FROM inner_cte) AS avg_len ON 1 = 1), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT s1.FULL_NAME, s1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.diff_from_avg_length, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.min_enrolled_students, s2.total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH category_stats AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME), category_stats_final AS (SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM category_stats AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC), subject_offerings AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, csf.avg_max_enrollment, csf.var_max_enrollment, csf.avg_minus_var, so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_START_DATE, so.TERM_END_DATE, so.TERM_PARAMETER, so.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM category_stats_final AS csf CROSS JOIN subject_offerings AS so ORDER BY csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6), cte_subjects AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0), cte_building_floors AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NULL) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, bf.total_coefficient_of_variation FROM cte_subjects AS s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN cte_building_floors AS bf ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
WITH dept_subjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC), reserve_materials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.total_enrolled_students, r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, r.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, r.TERM_CODE, r.SUBJECT_ID, r.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, r.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, r.ISBN, r.SUBJECT_TITLE, r.window_column, r.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS RES_MAT_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM dept_subjects AS d JOIN reserve_materials AS r ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad WITH RollupResults AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), YearTermCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0), DeptVariation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3) AS ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.offered_subject_count, subq1.min_enrolled_students, subq1.subject_with_max_enrollment, subq2.max_avg_total_units FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM subq2 AS s2 JOIN subq1 AS s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.deviation_from_avg DESC, s1.COURSE_LEVEL

SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), subject_code_avg AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, s2.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, s2.unique_subjects_offered, 'GeometricMeanAndUniqueSubjects' AS Reason FROM WITH academic_year_variation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drm.reserved_materials FROM academic_year_variation AS ayv LEFT JOIN dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS drm ON ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, day_of_week, date_count, avg_calendar_year, term_start_date, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DAY_OF_WEEK END AS day_sort, DAY_OF_WEEK AS day_of_week, COUNT(DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE) AS date_count, AVG(window_column) AS avg_calendar_year, MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DAY_OF_WEEK WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subject_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.total_enrolled_range, es.total_enrolled_variance, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_NAME, se.TERM_DESCRIPTION, se.avg_enrolled_students, se.enrollment_category FROM enrolled_stats AS es JOIN subject_enrollment AS se ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, se.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH ReservedMaterialStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.total_materials, subq2.Top_Subject, subq2.Top_Subject_Material_Count, subq1.department, MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.department_geometric_mean, du.department_avg_total_units, du.unit_category, dm.material_count_range, dm.material_count_variance, dm.material_count_stddev, dm.variance_category FROM dept_units AS du JOIN dept_materials AS dm ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY du.department_geometric_mean DESC, dm.material_count_range DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU')) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, s1.top_subject_title, s1.top_enrollment, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.enrolled_range DESC
WITH geometric_mean_by_status AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY), variance_by_year AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) variance_by_year AS vby ON gmbs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = vby.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmbs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmbs.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmbs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), org_stats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), org_group_stats AS (SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte2 AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG) AS mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, g.DLC_KEY, g.organization_count, g.min_organization_number, g.Most_Prominent_Major_Org, g.Major_Org_Count FROM org_stats AS o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN org_group_stats AS g ON fo.DLC_KEY = g.DLC_KEY AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = g.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
WITH iap_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NULL) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME), tip_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC) SELECT iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, iap_stats.avg_enrollment AS iap_avg_enrollment, iap_stats.enrollment_variance AS iap_enrollment_variance, iap_stats.enrollment_stddev AS iap_enrollment_stddev, tip_stats.avg_enrollment AS tip_avg_enrollment, tip_stats.enrollment_stddev AS tip_enrollment_stddev, tip_stats.enrollment_category FROM iap_stats LEFT JOIN tip_stats ON iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY iap_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH YearTermStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b), TermEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.term_count, yts.avg_term_count, yts.term_year_category, tes.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tes.max_enrollment_range, tes.max_enrollment_variance, tes.max_enrollment_stddev FROM YearTermStats AS yts JOIN TermEnrollmentStats AS tes ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY yts.term_count DESC, tes.max_enrollment_range DESC
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, highest_min_total_units, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS, 'HighestMinTotalUnits2024' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS highest_min_total_units, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, Total_Subjects, 'SubjectsWithMaterials' AS Reason FROM Subquery2) SELECT DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, highest_min_total_units, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TOTAL_SUBJECTS, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH GeometricMeanDepts AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC), TopVarianceOrgs AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT r.DEPT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.area_variance DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, gmd.geometric_mean_area, NULL AS area_variance, NULL AS area_stddev, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'HighGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDepts AS gmd UNION ALL SELECT tvo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, tvo.DEPT_CODE, NULL AS geometric_mean_area, tvo.area_variance, tvo.area_stddev, tvo.ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'TopVariance' AS Reason FROM TopVarianceOrgs AS tvo) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_CODE, geometric_mean_area, area_variance, area_stddev, ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME

SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE

WITH eng_dept_2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrollment) AS highest_term_enrollment, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_2019fa_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_totals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_totals AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM dept_totals)) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.highest_term_enrollment, e.max_subjects_offered, d.SUBJECT_ID, d.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM eng_dept_2022 AS e JOIN dept_2019fa_enrollment AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

avg_lecture AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.enrolled_students_variance, ays.department_name, ays.total_library_subjects_offered, hml.HGN_CODE, hml.max_lecture_units, hml.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM academic_year_stats AS ays JOIN hgn_max_lecture AS hml ON ays.department_name = hml.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.department_name, hml.HGN_CODE
