WITH DeptStats2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), LibResMatrlStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.subject_count, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, '2022 Degree-Granting Subjects' AS Reason FROM DeptStats2022 AS d UNION ALL SELECT l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, l.coefficient_of_variation, 'Library Reserve Materials' AS Reason FROM LibResMatrlStats AS l) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area'), subq1 AS (SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 AS inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY) SELECT s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_dense_rank, s1.DLC_NAME, s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_hr_dept_name, s2.window_column AS space_sum_within_load_date, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), EngineeringMaterialStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, ems.min_enrolled, ems.total_material_records FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des LEFT JOIN EngineeringMaterialStats AS ems ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ems.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC, des.avg_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3) AS ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), cte2 AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.offered_subject_count, c1.min_enrolled_students, c1.subject_with_max_enrollment, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.total_material_records, c2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 AS c1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c1.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 AS c2 ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0)), coefficient_of_variation_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cov.Top_Department, cov.Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS gme JOIN coefficient_of_variation_cte AS cov ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

WITH Subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), Subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.window_column AS DENSE_RANK_WINDOW, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.window_column AS ROW_NUMBER_WITHIN_ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.Total_Activities FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), prominent_major_org AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG), dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY) AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations) SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.organization_count, o.min_organization_number, pmo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, pmo.Major_Org_Count, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_count_range, d.org_count_variance, d.org_count_stddev, d.total_organizations FROM org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS o LEFT JOIN prominent_major_org AS pmo ON o.DLC_KEY = pmo.DLC_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = pmo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND pmo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.organization_count DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.join_dept_name FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.enrollment_range, ic.enrollment_variance, ic.enrollment_stddev, isd.TERM_CODE AS term_with_max_enrollment, td.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd ON ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE = isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT = ic.max_enrollment JOIN TIME_DAY AS td ON isd.TERM_CODE = td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL ORDER BY ic.enrollment_range DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT subq1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, subq1.enrollment_range, subq1.enrollment_variance, subq1.enrollment_stddev, subq1.term_with_max_enrollment, subq1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS prev_term_description, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS prev_academic_year, subq2.window_column AS prev_running_sum, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS prev_financial_aid_year FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.term_with_max_enrollment = subq2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subq1.enrollment_range DESC, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH activity_category_rank AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME), dept_year_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units) SELECT acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acr.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, acr.window_column, dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, dys.avg_enrolled_students FROM activity_category_rank AS acr CROSS JOIN dept_year_enrollment_stats AS dys
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_variance AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), SubjectCodeVisibility AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN NOT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1), RollupResults AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), SubjectCodeSummary AS (SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility) AS scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'), SubjectUnitsRank AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column FROM inner_cte2) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, sur.SUBJECT_ID, sur.TOTAL_UNITS, sur.window_column FROM SubjectCodeSummary AS scs LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SubjectUnitsRank AS sur ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = sur.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, sur.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH SubjectDemand AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10), HighReserveDepartments AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.reserved_materials, sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.demand_category, hd.reserved_materials AS dept_reserved_materials FROM SubjectDemand AS sd LEFT JOIN HighReserveDepartments AS hd ON sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = hd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.reserved_materials DESC
WITH MathCourses AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR)), YearStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, y.enrolled_range, y.enrolled_variance, y.variability_category FROM MathCourses AS m JOIN YearStats AS y ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.dept_avg_total_units, cte1.deviation_from_overall_avg, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.num_enrolled_variance, s2.num_enrolled_stddev, s2.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, s1.highest_num_enrolled_students FROM subq2 AS s2 JOIN subq1 AS s1 ON s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s2.TERM_CODE = s1.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE
WITH reserved_material_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE), dept_school_subject_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units) SELECT rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rms.SUBJECT_TITLE, rms.reserved_material_range, rms.reserved_material_variance, rms.reserved_material_stddev, dsss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsss.subject_count, dsss.min_total_units, dsss.max_num_enrolled_students FROM reserved_material_stats AS rms JOIN dept_school_subject_stats AS dsss ON rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dsss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.FLOOR, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), avg_access AS (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY FLOOR) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_access AS a ON i.FLOOR = a.FLOOR WHERE i.ACCESS_LEVEL > a.avg_access) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ROOM_COUNT, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS DEPT_DENSE_RANK FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM AND s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH SubjectCategoryStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR), RegularTermStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_total_units, scs.benchmark_lecture_units, scs.unit_category, rts.total_terms FROM SubjectCategoryStats AS scs LEFT JOIN RegularTermStats AS rts ON scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH DeptMaxEnroll AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME), TopDeptUnits AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.SCHOOL_NAME, dme.TERM_START_DATE, dme.total_max_enrollment, WITH IAP_Activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Activity_Count.Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Activity_Count ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Activity_Count.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TIP_MaterialVariance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.Total_Activities, tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tmv.max_record_count_variance, tmv.min_record_count_variance FROM IAP_Activities AS ia JOIN TIP_MaterialVariance AS tmv ON ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.avg_floor, cnt.total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.FLOOR, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.avg_floor, s1.total_rooms, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS access_level_deviation, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS avg_floor, NULL AS total_rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation, 'Floor2' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.department_name, s1.total_library_subjects_offered, s2.highest_avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, s1.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, s2.highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH iap_activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), year_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, iap_activities.TERM_START_DATE, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iap_activities.window_column, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_range, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_variance, year_enrollment_stats.variability_category FROM iap_activities JOIN year_enrollment_stats ON iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = year_enrollment_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_cte ON inner_cte1.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.window_column, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.enrollment_category, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.unique_subject_count FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH BuildingVariance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i), OrgDepartments AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS'), OrgRooms AS (SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, bv.area_stddev, bv.area_avg, bv.variance_category, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_ID, od.DLC_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, od.window_column FROM BuildingVariance AS bv JOIN OrgRooms AS orr ON bv.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = orr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN OrgDepartments AS od ON orr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH EngineeringStudents AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%') SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%'), Subjects2025FA AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte) SELECT es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM EngineeringStudents AS es JOIN Subjects2025FA AS s ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY es.FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6), subq1 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), rollup_cte AS (SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.window_column, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, r1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, r1.activity_count FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN rollup_cte AS r1 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = r1.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH max_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC), term_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats AS tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment AS mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = WITH dlc_org_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), EngineeringTipMaterials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, dsc.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, dsc.total_unique_subjects WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR (i.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SUM(i.total_tip_materials) > 0)) ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FO.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(FR.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, AVG(FR.AREA) AS avg_area, STDDEV(FR.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FO.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.num_rooms, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance, ROUND(tms.record_count_variance / NULLIF(ias.max_enrollment_variance, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance_ratio FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS tms JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, iap_counts.num_iap_activities, inner_cte.normalized_variance_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS num_iap_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS iap_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = iap_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = iap_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_variance_ratio DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.window_column, en.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, en.enrolled_range, en.enrolled_variance, es.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM EngineeringSubjects AS es JOIN EnrolledStats AS en ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = en.ACADEMIC_YEAR), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.enrolled_range, i.enrolled_variance, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, a.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dss.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS lrm JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), Subquery3 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s3.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s2.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Subquery3 AS s3 ON s3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s3.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.avg_materials_per_subject, ict.variance_materials_per_subject, ict.stddev_materials_per_subject, t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS ict JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ict.TERM_PARAMETER = atp.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON atp.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE AND ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ORDER BY ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, s.SUBJECT_ID, t.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON t.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d ON l.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_rank_in_dept, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, i.dense_rank_material_status, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS grad_course_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_grad, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_grad FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subjcode_stats AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_subjcode, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_subjcode FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_tbl AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.grad_course_count) AS grad_course_count, AVG(inner_cte.avg_enrolled_grad) AS avg_enrolled_grad, AVG(inner_cte.var_enrolled_grad) AS var_enrolled_grad, AVG(subjcode_stats.var_enrolled_subjcode) AS var_enrolled_subjcode, AVG(subjcode_stats.stddev_enrolled_subjcode) AS stddev_enrolled_subjcode FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subjcode_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = subjcode_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subjcode_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, grad_course_count, avg_enrolled_grad, var_enrolled_grad, var_enrolled_subjcode, stddev_enrolled_subjcode, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM rollup_tbl LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON rollup_tbl.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
