WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, suw.SUBJECT_ID, suw.SUBJECT_TITLE, suw.window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS dus JOIN (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) AS suw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = suw.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.COURSE = SUBSTRING(suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, 1, LOCATE('.', suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN) - 1) WHERE dus.units_range > 5 AND dus.units_variance > 2 ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, suw.SUBJECT_ID

AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, joined_stats AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, dev.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = dev.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school THEN NULL ELSE school END AS school, dept, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance, enrolled_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, AVG(avg_cip_code) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(cip_code_range) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(cip_code_variance) AS cip_code_variance, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance FROM joined_stats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort

t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = icte.SPACE_UNIT WHERE NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_ID, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.org_number_variance DESC

MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), regular_term_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, mry.num_subjects AS most_recent_year_num_subjects, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance, rts.num_subjects AS regular_term_num_subjects FROM most_recent_year_stats AS mry JOIN regular_term_stats AS rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, most_recent_year_avg_total_units, most_recent_year_total_units_range, most_recent_year_total_units_variance, most_recent_year_num_subjects, regular_term_avg_total_units, regular_term_total_units_range, regular_term_total_units_variance, regular_term_num_subjects FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(most_recent_year_avg_total_units), MAX(most_recent_year_total_units_range), VARIANCE(most_recent_year_total_units_variance), SUM(most_recent_year_num_subjects), AVG(regular_term_avg_total_units), MAX(regular_term_total_units_range), VARIANCE(regular_term_total_units_variance), SUM(regular_term_num_subjects) FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgSuperviseeStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgResearchVolume AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees, orv.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats AS os ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN OrgResearchVolume AS orv ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orv.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS d UNION ALL SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgInfo AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomInfo AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, (r.AREA - r.min_area_per_major_use) AS area_deviation FROM OrgInfo AS o JOIN RoomInfo AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR, inner_cte.area_deviation FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS ss ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subj_cnt, avg_enrolled_students, school_name, department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subj_cnt, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomWindow AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC) SELECT rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rw.ROOM_FULL_NAME, rw.AREA, rw.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev, sus.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM RoomWindow AS rw JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS sus ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, sus.org_number_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, MAX(o2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_org_number FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o2 ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.org_number_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC) AS ors JOIN (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) AS ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column ORDER BY inner_cte.area_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d2 WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL) ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL), space_avg AS (SELECT s.DLC_KEY, AVG(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT AS s WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY s.DLC_KEY), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS overall_avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT WHERE SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sa.avg_space_unit_key, CASE WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key > oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_SPACE' WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key < oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_SPACE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS space_size_category FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN space_avg AS sa ON d.DLC_KEY = sa.DLC_KEY CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, m.max_course_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS e JOIN (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_course_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS m ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38'), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS e JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COALESCE(s.subjects_with_required_materials, 0) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND t.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS s ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.var_total_units DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance AS duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, COALESCE(subject_count.subjects_offered, 0) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngDegreeCourses AS edc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptVariableUnits AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS variable_unit_count, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.window_column, dvu.variable_unit_count, ROUND(100.0 * dvu.variable_unit_count / NULLIF(dvu.total_subjects, 0), 2) AS percent_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN DeptVariableUnits AS dvu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dvu.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, mat_count.num_materials, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0d ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t0d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t0 ON t2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS mat_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mat_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat_count.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.avg_enrollment = m.max_avg_enrollment), MinYearTotalUnits AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_enrollment, t.min_academic_year, t.total_units_sum FROM MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS m CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits AS t ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptPhoneStats AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats AS dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.window_column * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < inner_cte.window_column * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, dms.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, dms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS dms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats AS e LEFT JOIN units_stats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units, lss.unique_faculty_count FROM inner_cte AS de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS unique_faculty_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS so ON l.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) AS lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lss.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), TopReservedSubjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TopReservedSubjects AS trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS soss ON trs.SUBJECT_TITLE = soss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = soss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearlyVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), MaxEnrolledSubject AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation, mes.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN YearlyVariation AS yv ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN MaxEnrolledSubject AS mes ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mes.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgWindowed AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS'), SpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t2.SQFT, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, sus.SQFT FROM OrgWindowed AS ow JOIN SpaceUnitStats AS sus ON ow.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, dr.subject_count AS department_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN DeptRanked AS dr ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dr.dept_rank = 1 WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomRanks AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 100), OrgStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC) SELECT rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, rr.window_column, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.avg_dept_code_old, os.var_dept_code_old FROM RoomRanks AS rr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN OrgStats AS os ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_dept_code_old) AS overall_avg_dept_code_old FROM (SELECT AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS sub) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.window_column, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.avg_dept_code_old, ic.var_dept_code_old, CASE WHEN ic.avg_dept_code_old > oa.overall_avg_dept_code_old * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG' WHEN ic.avg_dept_code_old < oa.overall_avg_dept_code_old * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectLectureUnits AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureUnits AS s JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults), DeptMaxTotalUnits AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, i.total_active_grad_students, d.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptMaxTotalUnits AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS hr_org_unit_title_from_hr, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS hr_org_unit_level_from_hr FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgLevel5Details AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), MaxSpaceUnitKey AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS max_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, m.max_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN OrgLevel5Details AS o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN MaxSpaceUnitKey AS m ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = m.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), DeptUnits AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment AS e JOIN DeptUnits AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_with_max_units FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) AS ccc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_enrollment DESC, icte.avg_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND NOT lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), dept_counts AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, dept_counts.num_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (dept_stats.dept_avg_total_units - inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_year_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), TopDepts AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), DeptTotals AS (SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS window_column, SUM(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.window_column, td.subject_count, NULL AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TopDepts AS td ON ic.join_dept_name = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dt.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dt.window_column, td.subject_count, dt.total_enrolled_students FROM DeptTotals AS dt JOIN TopDepts AS td ON dt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ProvostAreaDepts AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), FacilityOrgStats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM HR_ORG_UNIT AS h WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC), CombinedProvostFacility AS (SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM ProvostAreaDepts AS p JOIN FacilityOrgStats AS f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT * FROM CombinedProvostFacility) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.org_unit_count_range, i.org_unit_count_variance, i.org_unit_count_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'), dept_subjects AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects, MIN(icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS earliest_year, MAX(icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS latest_year FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON icte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON t2.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON t2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.unique_subjects, ds.earliest_year, ds.latest_year, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, SUM(ds.unique_subjects) OVER (ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS running_total_unique_subjects FROM dept_subjects AS ds LEFT JOIN dept_units_stats AS dus ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.unique_subjects DESC, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIMIT 5

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC), Floor2RoomAvgAccess AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), DLC_AvgAccess AS (SELECT DLC_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM Floor2RoomAvgAccess GROUP BY DLC_NAME) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev, f.BUILDING_ROOM, f.SPACE_USAGE, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (f.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN Floor2RoomAvgAccess AS f ON i.DLC_NAME = f.DLC_NAME JOIN DLC_AvgAccess AS d ON f.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME ORDER BY i.org_number_stddev DESC, f.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance AS ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(icte.subject_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Enrollment_per_TipMaterial FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) AS dtm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLCMechOrgs AS (SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE'), AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedOrgs AS (SELECT d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, 'DLC_MECHE' AS Reason FROM DLCMechOrgs AS d UNION ALL SELECT a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS window_column, a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.hr_org_unit_count, a.total_department_id, 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' AS Reason FROM AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS a) SELECT * FROM CombinedOrgs) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason, MAX(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS highest_hr_department_id FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.Reason

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance AS rcv JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc, dept, record_count_variance, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, SUM(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, MAX(enrolled_range) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY academic_year_sort, dept_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column AS math_window_column, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ic.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND ic.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.COURSE_NUMBER, pt.TERM_START_DATE
