WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.DLC_KEY, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NULL), org_counts AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, ic.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.DLC_NAME), org_rank AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS space_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.space_unit_name ORDER BY COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) DESC) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE NOT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT oc.space_unit_name, oc.org_count AS total_organization_count, oc.DLC_NAME, orr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS most_represented_organization, orr.space_unit_count AS space_unit_count_for_organization FROM org_counts AS oc LEFT JOIN org_rank AS orr ON oc.space_unit_name = orr.space_unit_name AND orr.org_rank = 1 ORDER BY oc.org_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.total_units_range, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS dtu JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtu.total_units_range > 0 AND NOT des.enrolled_students_variance IS NULL), avg_range_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) AS avg_total_units_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_range_cte AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.total_units_range > a.avg_total_units_range ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_offerings AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (so.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN subject_offerings AS so ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC, so.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) AS dmu JOIN (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, CASE WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate' WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Other' END AS COURSE_TYPE, CASE WHEN inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@mit.edu' THEN 'MIT_EMAIL' ELSE 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' END AS EMAIL_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), EngineeringSubjectsWithAvg AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CombinedResults AS (SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS icte UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng.window_column, eng.avg_enrolled_students, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjectsWithAvg AS eng) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_enrolled_students, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), DeptStats AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM OrgStats AS o JOIN DeptStats AS d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.org_window_column, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, CASE WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > icte.org_window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ORG_KEY' WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY < icte.org_window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ORG_KEY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS org_key_category FROM inner_cte AS icte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.running_enrollment_sum, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance, dsc.dept_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS dsc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dsc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dsc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC), TotalCoursesPerDeptYear AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, tc.total_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS dev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TotalCoursesPerDeptYear AS tc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), RoomAreaSummary AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.org_count, d.min_level3_code, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea AS d JOIN RoomAreaSummary AS r ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), MajorUseAvg AS (SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 200 GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, (i.window_column - m.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN MajorUseAvg AS m ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = m.MAJOR_USE_DESC

unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats AS um LEFT JOIN material_stats AS ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev, MIN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), space_unit_cv AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0), room_above_avg AS (SELECT zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.BUILDING_ROOM, zr.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_tbl ON zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = avg_tbl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL > avg_tbl.avg_access) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DESCRIPTION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ACCESS_LEVEL AS ROOM_ACCESS_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN space_unit_cv AS s ON i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN room_above_avg AS r ON i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH eng_dept_2021_summary AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, (CAST(e.total_enrollment AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(e.subject_count, 0)) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM eng_dept_2021_summary AS e JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev, avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment_per_subject > (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment_per_subject) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_hierarchy_stats AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC), top_space_units AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tsu.SPACE_UNIT, tsu.room_count, dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev, tsu.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM top_space_units AS tsu LEFT JOIN dept_hierarchy_stats AS dhs ON tsu.DLC_KEY = (SELECT DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY WHERE DLC_NAME = dhs.DLC_NAME LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tsu.room_count DESC) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SPACE_DETAIL AS sd ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10), ActivityEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC), ActivityAcademicYears AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS unique_academic_years FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev, aay.unique_academic_years FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN ActivityEnrollmentStats AS aes ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE LEFT JOIN ActivityAcademicYears AS aay ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aay.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), EngineeringDeptTips AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects AS d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips AS e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL AND UPPER(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME) LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME), DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN DeptRoomStats AS drs ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE drs.avg_room_area > 200 GROUP BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, drs.avg_room_area DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedGeometricMeans AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P'), AcademicYearVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), DepartmentCounts AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON t0.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, dc.num_departments FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN AcademicYearVariation AS ayv ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DepartmentCounts AS dc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL), eng_degree_courses AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), subject_course_counts AS (SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(edc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS degree_course_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN eng_degree_courses AS edc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), most_recent_course AS (SELECT edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY edc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM eng_degree_courses AS edc) SELECT scc.SUBJECT_CODE, scc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.degree_course_count, mrc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subject_course_counts AS scc LEFT JOIN most_recent_course AS mrc ON scc.SUBJECT_CODE = mrc.SUBJECT_CODE AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY scc.degree_course_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), dept_unit_benchmark AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN dept_unit_benchmark AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS dense_rank_within_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, LENGTH(d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION) AS activity_description_length FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), math_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.dense_rank_within_category, i.row_number_within_enrollment_type, i.activity_description_length, m.row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN math_cte AS m ON i.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND i.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(icte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024_12units, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, EXP(AVG(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN LN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) END)) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), OrgUnitTitleCounts AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE), RollupResults AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) AS total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM OrgUnitTitleCounts GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) > 0) SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DEPT_COUNT, ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, ic.avg_dept_count_within_group, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN RollupResults AS rr ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS course_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.course_dense_rank, tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_within_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Math_Courses_2014FA, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Avg_Enrolled_Students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON scd.COURSE = icte.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.SUBJECT_ID IN (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearDegreeStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), MathYearAvg AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > mya.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < mya.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS mc JOIN YearDegreeStats AS yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN MathYearAvg AS mya ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mya.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), math_enrollment_row_number AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank AS a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number AS m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_in_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math WITH ROLLUP HAVING (NOT ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL OR NOT ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NULL OR NOT MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL OR NOT dense_rank_within_category IS NULL OR NOT row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NULL) OR (ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL AND ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NULL AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND dense_rank_within_category IS NULL AND row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NULL) ORDER BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), GeomMeanMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN GeomMeanMaterials AS g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') ORDER BY i.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC), EOMaterialDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO'), EOCounts AS (SELECT eomd.TERM_PARAMETER, COUNT(*) AS eo_material_count FROM EOMaterialDetails AS eomd GROUP BY eomd.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN EOMaterialDetails AS eomd ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN EOCounts AS eoc ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eoc.TERM_PARAMETER WHERE eoc.eo_material_count > 5 ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats AS ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats AS sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC), OverallAvgArea AS (SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r WHERE r.AREA > 40) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_area, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_area > o.overall_avg_area * 1.1 THEN 'LARGE_AREA' WHEN i.avg_area < o.overall_avg_area * 0.9 THEN 'SMALL_AREA' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS area_size_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN OverallAvgArea AS o ORDER BY i.area_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentMaterialStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_2017SP FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC), DepartmentSubjectCounts AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev, dms.avg_materials_2017SP, dsc.subject_count FROM DepartmentMaterialStats AS dms JOIN DepartmentSubjectCounts AS dsc ON dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DeptAvgMaterials_2014plus AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_2014plus FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014) GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014) GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.material_count_range, icte.material_count_variance, icte.material_count_stddev, icte.subject_count, icte.avg_materials_2017SP, dam.avg_materials_2014plus, CASE WHEN icte.avg_materials_2017SP > dam.avg_materials_2014plus * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL' WHEN icte.avg_materials_2017SP < dam.avg_materials_2014plus * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS material_status FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptAvgMaterials_2014plus AS dam ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dam.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.material_count_range DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH employee_type_department_g AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_regular_terms AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM employee_type_department_g AS etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms AS msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation, s.room_count FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0) AS s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC), InstructorCounts AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, ic.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN InstructorCounts AS ic ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.TERM_CODE = ic.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL), DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS (SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY), DeptOrgCounts AS (SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), RankedDeptOrg AS (SELECT doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, doc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count DESC) AS OrgRank FROM DeptOrgCounts AS doc) SELECT dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dsc.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dsc.SpaceUnit_Count, rdo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Represented_Organization, rdo.Org_SpaceUnit_Count AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS dsc LEFT JOIN RankedDeptOrg AS rdo ON dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = rdo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rdo.OrgRank = 1 ORDER BY dsc.SpaceUnit_Count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC), LibSubjStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits AS a JOIN LibSubjStats AS l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o ORDER BY i.var_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), OrganizationStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gmd.DLC_KEY FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment AS gmd JOIN OrganizationStats AS os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON icte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean DESC, icte.organization_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.window_column, srv.record_count_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance AS srv ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
