WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), DepartmentCourseUnits AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsu.units_range, dsu.units_variance, dcu.total_units_range, dcu.total_units_variance, dcu.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 AS dsu JOIN DepartmentCourseUnits AS dcu ON dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dsu.units_range > 0 AND dcu.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY dsu.units_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev FROM EngDegreeCourses AS e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.window_column, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS room_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS r ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), DeptMaxUnits AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptMaxUnits AS dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS dsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS'), org_space_stats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.window_column, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance, h.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN org_space_stats AS oss ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsRowNumber AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber AS mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio, ROUND(AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT), 2) AS Avg_Max_Enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio ORDER BY inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_access_stats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), dept_spaceunit_stats AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code FROM org_access_stats AS oas JOIN dept_spaceunit_stats AS dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_access_level, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.avg_space_unit_code, inner_cte.var_space_unit_code, COUNT(zrl.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms_on_floor_2_or_higher FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zrl ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE zrl.FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_access_level, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.avg_space_unit_code, inner_cte.var_space_unit_code ORDER BY num_rooms_on_floor_2_or_higher DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, srf.SUBJECT_TITLE, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srf.window_column, tds.subject_count FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS srf JOIN (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) AS tds ON srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count, COALESCE(SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS material_status_row_number FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_info AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), school_counts AS (SELECT di.SCHOOL_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT di.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM dept_info AS di GROUP BY di.SCHOOL_CODE), school_ranked AS (SELECT sc.SCHOOL_CODE, sc.Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.Subject_Count DESC) AS school_rank FROM school_counts AS sc) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.material_status_row_number, di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sr.SCHOOL_CODE AS Most_Represented_School, sr.Subject_Count AS Subjects_From_School FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_info AS di ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = di.SUBJECT_ID JOIN school_ranked AS sr ON di.SCHOOL_CODE = sr.SCHOOL_CODE AND sr.school_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, org_window_column, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, room_window_column FROM CombinedResults), RoomTotals AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS org_window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS room_window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DESCRIPTION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.org_window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.room_window_column, NULL AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DESCRIPTION, r.SPACE_UNIT, r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.room_window_column, r.total_rooms FROM RoomTotals AS r ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), DepartmentUnitStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitStats AS dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at WHERE at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), RoomAreaWindow AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea AS dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow AS raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), avg_window_per_group AS (SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.window_per_org FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_window_per_group AS a ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = a.MAJOR_USE_DESC WHERE i.window_column > a.avg_window ORDER BY i.window_per_org DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), unique_subject_codes AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance, usc.unique_subject_codes_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN dept_units_stats AS dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN unique_subject_codes AS usc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = usc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = usc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), CombinedDeptInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > a.avg_total_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < a.avg_total_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subject_code_ranks AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), building_units_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM subject_code_ranks AS scr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN building_units_stats AS bus ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) FROM (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_avg)
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, ROUND(gmu.geometric_mean_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrolled_range, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_to_range_ratio FROM GeometricMeanUnits AS gmu JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.total_subjects_per_department FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio DESC, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS), HighTotalMaterialYears AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > (SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS sub)), RollupResults AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS, AVG(avg_record_count) AS avg_record_count, MAX(record_count_range) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(avg_record_count) AS record_count_variance, SUM(total_materials) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_materials) > 0) SELECT rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.TERM_STATUS, rr.avg_record_count, rr.record_count_range, rr.record_count_variance, rr.total_materials FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears AS h ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.record_count_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, COALESCE(tip_counts.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS tip_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window, td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, CASE WHEN ic.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > ic.window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < ic.window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON ic.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation, dept_count.total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_count ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE

inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE) AS bsu ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = bsu.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(d2.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d2 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c2 ON d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > (SELECT AVG(d2.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d2 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c2 ON d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC), DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, i.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, i.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular_terms, d.total_units_range AS total_units_range_regular_terms, d.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_regular_terms, d.max_total_units AS max_total_units_regular_terms FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_cip_code, ede.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS dgc JOIN EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS ede ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME), min_cip_avg AS (SELECT AVG(min_cip_code) AS avg_min_cip_code FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN min_cip_avg AS a ON i.min_cip_code < a.avg_min_cip_code ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptOrgVariance AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC), Top10DeptOrgCount AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.DLC_NAME, t.org_count, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev FROM Top10DeptOrgCount AS t JOIN DeptOrgVariance AS d ON t.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t.org_count DESC), avg_variance_cte AS (SELECT AVG(org_key_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.org_count, i.org_key_variance, i.org_key_stddev, CASE WHEN i.org_key_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_key_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_variance_cte AS a ORDER BY i.org_count DESC

AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), EnrolledStudentsVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = cs.total_units_stddev, cs.enrolled_students_variance FROM CombinedStats AS cs), MaxSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, i.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fs.window_column, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM FallSubjects AS fs JOIN AvgVarUnits AS avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avu.avg_total_units > 12 AND avu.var_total_units >= 10), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS fs JOIN (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 12 AND VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 10) AS avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION UNION ALL SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte) AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.window_column, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.avg_total_units, rr.var_total_units, rr.total_subjects FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), SubjectSummary AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, ss.window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectSummary AS ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ss.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Sub2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.join_dept_name FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.max_enrollment, icte.TERM_START_DATE, davg.dept_avg_units AS department_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > davg.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < davg.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS davg ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = davg.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) AS ade JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') AS s ON ade.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), RollupResults AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND NOT total_enrolled IS NULL) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), subject_record_count_variance AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY l.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance AS srv ON i.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomAreas AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200), OrgAverages AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), CombinedResults AS (SELECT ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ra.DLC_KEY, ra.window_column AS room_area_sum, oa.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oa.window_column AS org_key_avg, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM RoomAreas AS ra JOIN OrgAverages AS oa ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL THEN NULL ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS hr_org_unit_level, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY, room_area_sum, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, org_key_avg, HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 1 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS hr_org_unit_level_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 0 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 1 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 0 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY END AS hr_org_unit_key_sort, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY, SUM(room_area_sum) AS room_area_sum, MAX(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, AVG(org_key_avg) AS org_key_avg, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM CombinedResults GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY hr_org_unit_level_sort, hr_org_unit_key_sort) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RecordCountStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountStats AS rcs JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, subj_stats.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subj_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS s JOIN (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_rank_in_dept, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.dense_rank_material_status, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), DlcOrgStats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC), DlcSpaceUnitCounts AS (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_space_units FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, dsuc.total_space_units FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN DlcOrgStats AS dos ON icte.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN DlcSpaceUnitCounts AS dsuc ON icte.DLC_KEY = dsuc.DLC_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptOrgCounts AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5), DLCOrgStats AS (SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_organizations, s.DLC_NAME, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME AS school_area_name, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AS department_long_name FROM DeptOrgCounts AS d JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN DLCOrgStats AS s ON f.DLC_NAME = s.DLC_NAME GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_organizations, s.DLC_NAME, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, dlc_sort) = department THEN NULL ELSE department END AS department, total_organizations, dlc_name, avg_org_number, org_number_stddev, school_area_name, department_long_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, SUM(total_organizations) AS total_organizations, AVG(avg_org_number) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(org_number_stddev) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(school_area_name) AS school_area_name, MAX(department_long_name) AS department_long_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, dlc_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), dept_stats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), dept_instructors AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS num_unique_instructors FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, di.num_unique_instructors FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN dept_instructors AS di ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC), room_area_stats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, ras.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM room_area_stats AS ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column, icte.org_count_range, icte.org_count_variance, icte.org_count_stddev, org_room_counts.total_rooms_per_org FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms_per_org FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_room_counts ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org_room_counts.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives'), dept_avg AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), lib_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.enrolled_range, l.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN lib_stats AS l ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(catalog_key_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte), DeptEnrolledStddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC) SELECT COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT, des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, CASE WHEN NOT ic.catalog_key_variance IS NULL AND NOT vb.avg_variance IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance > vb.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance < vb.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END WHEN NOT des.enrolled_stddev IS NULL THEN 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' ELSE NULL END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStddev AS des ON ic.DEPARTMENT = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark AS vb UNION SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' AS variance_category FROM DeptEnrolledStddev AS des LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT WHERE ic.DEPARTMENT IS NULL ORDER BY DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostStats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), OrgSpaceStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats AS dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats AS oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS department, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH space_unit_access_stats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC), space_unit_org_window AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, zr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM space_unit_access_stats AS s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window AS s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), LibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC), MaxEnrollment AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, me.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN LibraryStats AS ls ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN MaxEnrollment AS me ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = me.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = me.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER
