WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), library_stats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), library_max_enroll AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_library_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, lm.max_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN library_stats AS ls ON i.join_dept_name = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN library_max_enroll AS lm ON i.join_dept_name = lm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS subject_window_column, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_12units, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_window_column, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.subject_title_2019fa, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_window_column, inner_cte.course_number, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_title_12units, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.course_window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipRQDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipRQDetails AS trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), EECSStudents AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_student_counts.student_count FROM EECSStudents AS eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS dept_student_counts ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_student_counts.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 AS sq2 JOIN Subquery1 AS sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT), unit_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.offering_count, ic.total_units, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN ic.total_units > ub.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.total_units < ub.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN unit_benchmark AS ub ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_unit_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC) AS dos ON icte.org_dlc_key = dos.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.org_dlc_key = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON icte.org_dlc_key = su.DLC_KEY AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, stats.avg_course_number_ascii, stats.var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC), OrganizationSpaceUnitStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT su.SPACE_UNIT IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC) SELECT drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.area_range, drs.area_variance, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM DepartmentRoomStats AS drs JOIN OrganizationSpaceUnitStats AS oss ON drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY drs.area_range DESC, oss.code_range DESC) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_range, icte.area_variance, icte.code_range, icte.code_variance, COALESCE(bldg_stats.building_count, 0) AS unique_building_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS bldg_stats ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = bldg_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.area_range DESC, icte.code_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), TermDeptWindow AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C') SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow AS tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, SUM(CASE WHEN cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.running_enrollment_sum, s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2.running_enrollment_sum DESC LIMIT 10), dept_avg AS (SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.running_enrollment_sum DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED)), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermSubjectInfo AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo AS tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EngDeptSubjects AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, a.total_active_grad_students FROM EngDeptSubjects AS e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN subject_count > 0 THEN CAST(total_enrollment AS FLOAT) / subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), BuildingStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats AS bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.subject_count FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc WHERE dsc.subject_count > (SELECT AVG(subject_count) FROM DeptSubjectCounts) ORDER BY dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t0.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentAggregates AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS unique_subject_code_descs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME), SchoolRollup AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(unique_courses) AS total_courses, SUM(unique_subject_code_descs) AS total_subject_code_descs FROM DepartmentAggregates GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_courses) > 0) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_courses, total_subject_code_descs FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), SpaceUnitVariation AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0), RoomUsageRanked AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(*) AS usage_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, icte.window_column, suv.coefficient_of_variation, rur.SPACE_USAGE AS most_frequent_space_usage, rur.usage_count AS usage_count_for_space_usage FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SpaceUnitVariation AS suv ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = suv.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = suv.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN RoomUsageRanked AS rur ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = rur.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = rur.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AND rur.rn = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_units_range_variance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), dept_avg_variance_units AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC) SELECT dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.units_range, dr.units_variance AS range_variance, da.avg_units, da.units_variance AS avg_variance FROM dept_units_range_variance AS dr JOIN dept_avg_variance_units AS da ON dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME), hass_mode AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, COUNT(*) AS hass_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND NOT ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.range_variance, icte.avg_units, icte.avg_variance, hm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS most_common_hass_attribute, hm.hass_count AS hass_attribute_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN hass_mode AS hm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hm.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), OrgSpaceStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.code_range, os.code_variance FROM RoomStats AS rs JOIN OrgSpaceStats AS os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = os.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.code_range >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE_RANGE' WHEN inner_cte.code_range < 10000 THEN 'SMALL_RANGE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_RANGE' END AS range_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC), DLCOrgStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev, dos.DLC_KEY FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats AS srs JOIN DLCOrgStddev AS dos ON srs.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.avg_room_sqft, inner_cte.stddev_room_sqft, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_orgs_per_dlc FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS DLCOrgCount ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = DLCOrgCount.DLC_KEY ORDER BY DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EngSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), TermSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column AS eng_window_row_number, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS term_dept_full_name, ts.SUBJECT_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ts.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM EngSubjects AS es JOIN TermSubjects AS ts ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE TOTAL_UNITS END AS TOTAL_UNITS, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE eng_window_row_number END AS eng_window_row_number, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS END AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE term_dept_full_name END AS term_dept_full_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE END AS SUBJECT_CODE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE_DESC END AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, eng_window_row_number, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, term_dept_full_name, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) IS NULL ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), dept_course_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), variable_units_count AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS variable_units_subjects_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, dcs.total_units_range, dcs.total_units_variance, dcs.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(vuc.variable_units_subjects_2022, 0) AS variable_units_subjects_2022 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_course_stats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN variable_units_count AS vuc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = vuc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.units_range DESC
