WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), engineering_subjects_window AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg_enrollment AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column, (t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - t3.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_avg_enrollment AS t3 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostStats AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), OrgSpaceStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats AS dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats AS oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.space_unit_count, icte.min_org_number, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_unique_space_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.space_unit_count, icte.min_org_number ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), SubjectCodeCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 'Degree Granting' ELSE 'Non-Degree Granting' END AS degree_granting_status, COUNT(SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(SUBJECT_CODE) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, degree_granting_status, subject_code_count FROM SubjectCodeCounts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC), MostPopularSubject AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, mps.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Represented_Subject, mps.total_enrolled AS Students_In_Most_Represented_Subject FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS dev ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostPopularSubject AS mps ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mps.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mps.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mps.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgRoomAreaVariance AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), DeptOrgNumberStats AS (SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_range DESC) SELECT d.department_name, d.org_number_range, d.org_number_variance, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_variance FROM DeptOrgNumberStats AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON d.department_name = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN OrgRoomAreaVariance AS o ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.org_number_range DESC, o.area_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.org_number_range, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.org_number_range, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.org_number_range DESC, inner_cte.area_variance DESC, total_room_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH space_unit_info AS (SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500), org_coeff_var AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation FROM space_unit_info AS s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var AS o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DEPT_COUNT, inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_SUPERVISION' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES < inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_SUPERVISION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS supervision_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38'), space_unit_stats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.OFFICE_LOCATION, r.FULL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS r LEFT JOIN space_unit_stats AS s ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON s.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY r.BUILDING_ROOM, s.org_unit_id_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DeptRoomStats AS d JOIN EngDegreeCourses AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(f.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f WHERE f.AREA > 40) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC), department_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, geometric_mean_record_count_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, department_count_cte.department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.min_enrolled_window, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.running_sum_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.GRADE_TYPE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats AS es JOIN UnitsVariance AS uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND NOT uv.total_units_variance IS NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, esc.window_column FROM inner_cte AS dmu JOIN (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON esc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column, sw.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(window_column) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(catalog_key_variance) AS catalog_key_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_depts JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY top_depts.avg_enrollment DESC, ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH department_enrollments AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10), library_subjects_summary AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM department_enrollments AS de JOIN library_subjects_summary AS lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollments, icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, so.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS so ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND NOT lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, subq2.num_terms FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), dept_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10) AS ts JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_grad, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_grad, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrolled_grad, i.min_enrolled_grad, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.max_enrolled_grad DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), Subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, i.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), RoomAreaWindow AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org FROM DeptProvostArea AS dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow AS raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.window_column, icte.window_per_org FROM inner_cte AS icte WHERE icte.window_column > 1000 ORDER BY icte.window_per_org DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL), access_level_variance AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME), access_level_avg_rooms AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance, aavg.avg_num_rooms, CASE WHEN icte.room_count > aavg.avg_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN icte.room_count < aavg.avg_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN access_level_variance AS av ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE LEFT JOIN access_level_avg_rooms AS aavg ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = aavg.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC, av.num_rooms_variance DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), org_geom_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME), org_total_research_volume AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.organization_count, i.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees, r.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN org_geom_supervisees AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN org_total_research_volume AS r ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY i.organization_count DESC, o.geometric_mean_supervisees DESC, r.total_research_volume DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS icte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, de.max_enrollment, de.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.total_subjects, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollment AS de JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, total_subjects, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT r.DEPT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC), OrgHRStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC) SELECT rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DEPT_CODE, rs.area_variance, rs.area_stddev, ohs.avg_dept_code_old, ohs.var_dept_code_old FROM RoomStats AS rs JOIN OrgHRStats AS ohs ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohs.ORGANIZATION_NAME), MostFrequentHRTitle AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS title_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hru ON fo.DLC_KEY = hru.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hru.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, icte.avg_dept_code_old, icte.var_dept_code_old, mfht.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS most_frequent_hr_org_unit_title, mfht.title_count AS hr_org_unit_title_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN MostFrequentHRTitle AS mfht ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mfht.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mfht.rn = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC) AS d1 JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) AS d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, course_counts.total_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS course_counts ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = course_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_row_number FROM (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) AS o JOIN (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) AS d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, org_window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dept_window_row_number FROM inner_cte WHERE LOWER(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) LIKE '%science%'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_number_window FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.CALENDAR_DATE, cte.row_number_window, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_window, CASE WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 THEN 'FULL' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 30 THEN 'LIMITED' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 30 THEN 'UNLIMITED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS enrollment_status FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC), max_enrollment_variance_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, mev.max_enrollment_variance FROM geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS gmr JOIN max_enrollment_variance_per_year AS mev ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, dept_counts.unique_department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = dept_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment AS gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate AS scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_enrollment, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_start_date, ssc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ssc.School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS School_Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON a.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS ssc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ssc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ssc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sf.FLOOR_NAME LIKE '%Floor%'
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME
SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS spring_subjects_with_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS ss ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND c.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND ss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_room_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME
SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA, AVG(fr.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE ORDER BY fr.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_area_window FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' ORDER BY ff.FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE, fr.AREA
SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment_number FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ((at.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020) OR ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ss.TERM_CODE
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2014%' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = 'Cline, Francesca' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH math_units_per_year AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_units) AS mean_units, STDDEV(total_units) AS stddev_units FROM math_units_per_year) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.total_units FROM math_units_per_year AS m CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE m.total_units > s.mean_units + s.stddev_units ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5
SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32')

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON tso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(dept_subject_count) - MIN(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s WHERE NOT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = stats.SCHOOL_CODE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3
WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME

SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fba.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES'
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ORDER BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
SELECT t1.COURSE, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.COURSE) AS window_column FROM CIP AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT fba.POSTAL_CODE) AS num_unique_postal_codes FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY num_unique_postal_codes DESC, fb.BUILDING_NAME LIMIT 10

SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID

SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT

WITH MaxPhones AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MaxPhones AS mp JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = mp.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY mp.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG

SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
