SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC
WITH dept_code_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), stats AS (SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts AS d CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY num_rooms_range DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC
SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE
SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t0.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY <> ''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units_math FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(dept_course_count.num_courses) / NULLIF(AVG(dept_course_count.num_courses), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE JOIN (SELECT c2.SCHOOL_NAME, c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c2 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s2 ON c2.COURSE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE NOT c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND NOT c2.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c2.SCHOOL_NAME, c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c2.COURSE) > 0) AS dept_course_count ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_course_count.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE NOT s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(dept_course_count.num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC
SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, (STDDEV(student_counts.num_students) / NULLIF(AVG(student_counts.num_students), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS student_counts ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = student_counts.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC
WITH building_stats AS (SELECT fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fba.CITY, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING avg_assignable_area > 0) SELECT CITY, STDDEV(avg_assignable_area) / AVG(avg_assignable_area) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM building_stats GROUP BY CITY

SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN scd.COURSE END) AS total_degree_granting_courses FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5
SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(course_counts.num_courses) - MIN(course_counts.num_courses) AS course_count_range, VARIANCE(course_counts.num_courses) AS course_count_variance FROM CIP AS c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE JOIN (SELECT c2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM CIP AS c2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s2 ON c2.PROGRAM_CODE = s2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE) AS course_counts ON c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE = course_counts.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE ORDER BY course_count_range DESC
SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) / AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES)) AS coeff_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0
WITH max_units_per_year AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING max_total_units > 9) SELECT muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR, muy.max_total_units, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM max_units_per_year AS muy JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = muy.max_total_units AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY muy.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT fba.CITY, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE IN ('ACADEMIC', 'RESIDENT') AND NOT fb.BUILDING_NAME IN ('Ray and Maria Stata Center', 'THE SIMONS BUILDING') AND NOT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IN ('32', '2') GROUP BY fba.CITY HAVING SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) > 20000
SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)
SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100

SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MIN(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS min_num_of_rooms, AVG(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS avg_building_height FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND ((fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS BETWEEN 10 AND 400) OR (fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT >= 30)) AND fba.STREET_NUMBER BETWEEN 40 AND 27000 GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH dept_max_enroll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll AS dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS num_historical_records, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC
SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6'
SELECT f.FLOOR_NAME, SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS d JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS f ON d.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY WHERE d.ROOM_NUMBER > 20 AND d.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> '13' AND d.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY f.FLOOR_NAME HAVING SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) > 0
SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS hass_attribute_code, (STDDEV_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM
SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS EARLIEST_DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND (msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' OR msd.DEPARTMENT = '17') GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY msd.DEPARTMENT, EARLIEST_DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(course_student_counts.num_students) AS avg_students_per_course, STDDEV(course_student_counts.num_students) AS stddev_students_per_course FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND scd2.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE) AS course_student_counts ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_student_counts.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_students_per_course DESC

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH subjects_per_term AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE), stats_per_year AS (SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(s.num_subjects) - MIN(s.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(s.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(s.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS s GROUP BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sp.range_num_subjects, sp.variance_num_subjects, sp.stddev_num_subjects FROM stats_per_year AS sp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sp.range_num_subjects, sp.variance_num_subjects, sp.stddev_num_subjects ORDER BY sp.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC

SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC

SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC
SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18'
SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE
SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC
SELECT fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS stddev_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' AND (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC
SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6)) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS mean_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST), res_buildings AS (SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.total_assignable_area FROM res_buildings AS rb CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE rb.total_assignable_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH schools_with_ps AS (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), subject_units AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH building_hist_stats AS (SELECT fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, fba.POSTAL_CODE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_USE, fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, GREATEST(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD), 0)) AS max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fba.CITY = 'Cambridge' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC') SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, max_num_of_rooms_3rows FROM building_hist_stats ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FISCAL_PERIOD

SELECT fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, MIN(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS min_building_number, AVG(ff.FLOOR) AS avg_floor_number FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND ((fb.BUILDING_NUMBER >= '14' AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <= 'E62') OR ff.FLOOR >= 2) AND ff.FLOOR BETWEEN 3 AND 16 GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NUMBER ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NUMBER

SELECT COUNT(*) AS research_center_large_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL JOIN SPACE_USAGE ON SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE SPACE_DETAIL.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = 32

SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3

SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VARIANCE(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT) AS course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count_range DESC

SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10
WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ((c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE BETWEEN 120000 AND 150000) OR (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH tip_counts AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID), per_year_stats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts AS tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH building_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas AS bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area
SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2023 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2023%' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G')
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ORDER BY area_range DESC
SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS max_hr_dept_code_old, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 500000
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE
SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC
SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC
WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, VARIANCE(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) AS subject_code_count_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE WHERE NOT SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 5
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2022_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND (ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' OR ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6
SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC
SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020)) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0
SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS min_student_year FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH schools_with_target_depts AS (SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics')), school_course_units AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') SELECT scu.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(scu.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM school_course_units AS scu WHERE scu.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_target_depts) GROUP BY scu.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scu.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS sqft_variance FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_COUNTER = 1 AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY sqft_variance DESC
